官鬼发动，祸事相近。
en: To take in a person, Wealth must show;
Output strong and Wealth thriving, it can be done;
Resource or Peer moving, it will not last;
Pressure moving, disaster draws near.

chapter: 求财买卖章 附交易
title: 交易：子动财明大吉；兄鬼爻摇合不成；父兴费尽力气

rule.yi: 买卖和交易：子孙动、财明现，最吉；兄弟、官鬼爻动摇，合不成；父母兴旺，费尽千钧之力也办不成。
rule.en: For trade and dealings: Output moving and Wealth showing is greatly auspicious; Peer or Pressure lines stirring, the deal cannot be joined; Resource rising, all one's strength is spent for nothing.

zh: 凡占买卖与交易，
子动财明为大吉。
兄鬼爻摇合不成，
父兴费尽千钧力。
yi: 凡占买卖和交易，
子孙动、财明现，最吉；
兄弟、官鬼爻动摇，合不成；
父母兴旺，费尽千钧之力。
en: For trade and dealings,
Output moving and Wealth showing is greatly auspicious;
Peer or Pressure lines stirring, the deal cannot be joined;
Resource rising, all one's strength is spent for nothing.

title: 求财六爻各主一样：初己身、二伴侣、三行李、四车门、五道路、六店舍

rule.yi: 求财占里，六个爻各代表一样：初爻是自己，二爻是同伴，三爻是行李，四爻是车门，五爻是道路，上爻是店舍。
rule.en: In a wealth divination each of the six lines stands for one thing: the first for oneself, the second for a companion, the third for baggage, the fourth for the carriage door, the fifth for the road, the top for the lodging.

note.yi: 这一对只是一张对照表，书里没有说怎么用；本库不替它编用法。同一本书在买卖章另有一张（见 DYTJ.11），两张不一样。
note.en: This is only a look-up list; the book does not say how to use it, and this library does not invent a use. The chapter on buying and selling has a second list (see DYTJ.11), and the two differ.

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
己身伴侣行李车门道路店舍
yi: 第一爻、第二爻、第三爻、第四爻、第五爻、第六爻，依次是：
自己、同伴、行李、车门、道路、店舍。
en: The first line, the second, the third, the fourth, the fifth, the sixth, in order, are:
oneself, a companion, baggage, the carriage door, the road, the lodging.

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
己身伴侣行李车马道路店舍

title: 辨君子小人求财：小人求财得乾卦，心里无良，行劫害之事

rule.yi: 辨君子和小人求财：小人求财，占到乾卦，心里没有善念，做的是抢夺伤害人的事。后面几句按巳酉丑、寅午戌、申子辰三组，说泰卦里的劫杀和驿马。
rule.en: On telling a gentleman from a petty person seeking wealth: a petty person who gets Qian has no goodness in the heart and does robbery and harm. The remaining lines take the three groups Si-You-Chou, Yin-Wu-Xu and Shen-Zi-Chen and speak of the Robbery star and the Post Horse in Tai.

note.yi: 这首歌诀省得很厉害，后四句怎么读，书里没有解释。整理本后面有今人写的注，把最后一句读作「贵人求财」；那段注文不是古籍，本库不引，也不跟着下结论，只照字译。原文里的「（1）」是整理本给那段注文编的号。
note.en: The verse is very terse and the book does not explain its last four lines. The transcription appends a modern note that reads the last line as a nobleman seeking wealth; that note is not a classic, so this library neither cites it nor draws the conclusion, and only translates the words. The '(1)' in the Chinese is the number the transcription gave to that note.

zh: 小人求财得乾卦，
心底无良行劫害（1），
巳酉丑兮卜得泰，
寅午戌兮劫杀害，
申子辰兮驿马寅，
财与寅兮六合亥。
yi: 小人求财，占到乾卦，
心里没有善念，做的是抢夺伤害人的事。
逢巳、酉、丑而占到泰卦，
逢寅、午、戌，劫杀带来祸害；
逢申、子、辰，驿马在寅；
财与寅，在亥上六合。
en: A petty person seeking wealth who gets the Qian hexagram:
no goodness in the heart, he does robbery and harm.
Meeting Si, You and Chou and getting Tai:
meeting Yin, Wu and Xu, the Robbery star brings harm;
meeting Shen, Zi and Chen, the Post Horse is at Yin;
Wealth and Yin form a six-harmony at Hai.

title: 有意还财否：世应相生、外生内卦、子孙财爻动生世，他有还意；相克又无财，再去也白去

rule.yi: 对方有没有还钱的意思：世应相生、外卦生内卦、子孙和财爻发动生世，他心里是想还的；世应相克又没有财，再去讨也白讨。
rule.en: Whether the other side means to repay: Self and Other generating each other, the outer trigram generating the inner, or Output and the Wealth line moving to generate the Self, all show that he means to pay; Self and Other controlling each other with no Wealth, to go again is in vain.

note.yi: 原文里的（2）（3）（4）是整理本给今人注文编的号，那些注文本库不引。
note.en: The (2), (3) and (4) in the Chinese are numbers the transcription gave to modern notes, which this library does not cite.

zh: 世应相生有意还，
虽道无财常准拟，
外生内卦有还心，
内外比和终有益（2）。
子与财爻动生世，
他心自来还有意（3），
相生无财意欲还，
相克无财徒再诣（4）。
yi: 世应相生，对方有还钱的意思，
嘴上说没有钱，其实常在筹划；
外卦生内卦，有还钱的心；
内外卦比和，终究有好处。
子孙和财爻发动生世，
他自己心里本来就有还的意思；
世应相生而卦里没有财，仍是想还；
世应相克而卦里没有财，再去也是白去。
en: Self and Other generating each other: he has the will to repay,
and though he says there is no money, he is often making ready;
the outer trigram generating the inner trigram: a heart to repay;
inner and outer trigrams in harmony: in the end there is benefit.
Output and the Wealth line moving to generate the Self:
in his own heart he already has the will to repay;
Self and Other generating each other with no Wealth, he still wants to repay;
Self and Other controlling each other with no Wealth, to go again is in vain.

title: 求财何日得：死财等财生的日月，生财不要拿财合当日期；空亡加退度，说得再多也要迟疑

rule.yi: 求财哪天到手：财爻衰死的，等财逢长生的日月才得；财爻得令的，不要拿合日当日期。上下相生的，可以取相克的时候；内克外的，白说合日；再遇空亡、退度，怎么说能得，也要迟疑。
rule.en: On which day the money arrives: for a dead Wealth, the day or month that gives it life; for a living Wealth, do not take the combining day as the date. When above and below generate each other one may take a time of control; when the inner controls the outer it is idle to speak of a combining day; with Void and a retreating degree added, however much one says it will come, hesitate.

dispute.yi: 《天玄赋》说「财合日辰，方能入手」，合日是入手的条件；这里说生财「财合莫为期」，合日不能当日期。两处不好并成一说：一处讲财与日辰合，一处讲财自己得令时的合日。整理本后面今人注把「财合」读成「入墓」，原文写的是「合」，本库照原文，不改。
dispute.en: The Tianxuan Fu says that when Wealth combines with the Day the money can be taken in hand, making the combining day a condition; this verse says that for a living Wealth 'Wealth combining' is not to be taken as the date. The two do not merge into one statement. A modern note in the transcription reads 'combining' as 'entering the tomb'; the original says 'combining', and this library follows the original.

note.yi: 「上下相生可克时」一句，字面很难落实；这里照字译，不加解释。原文里的（5）（6）是整理本给今人注文编的号。
note.en: The line about 'above and below generate each other, a time of control is possible' is hard to pin down from its words; it is translated literally here without explanation. The (5) and (6) in the Chinese are numbers the transcription gave to modern notes.

zh: 凡占求财何日得，
死财财生日月得（5），
生财财合莫为期，
以此推之必无惑（6）。
上下相生可克时，
克外徒言相合期，
更想空亡兼退度，
百般云得亦迟疑。
yi: 凡是占求财哪天能得，
死财，等财逢生的日月能得；
生财，财合的日子不要当日期，
照这样推，一定没有疑惑。
上下相生的，可以取相克的时候；
克外的，白白说相合的日期；
再想到空亡，加上退度，
怎么说能得，也要迟疑。
en: Whenever you divine on which day the money will come,
a dead Wealth comes on the day or month that gives it life;
a living Wealth: do not take the combining day as the date;
reasoned this way, there will be no doubt.
When above and below generate each other, the time of control may be taken;
when the inner controls the outer, it is idle to name the day of combining;
and think further of Void together with a retreating degree:
however one says it will come, still hesitate.

title: 出入财：内阴、外阴，财也阴的吉；纯阳的多散失

rule.yi: 看钱进钱出：内卦阳、财空、又变阳，不宜进财，多散失；内卦阴、财爻也变阴，如期变吉；外卦阴、财阴，出钱吉；外卦阳、财阳，宜藏好；总之逢阴为好，纯阳多散失。
rule.en: Money coming in and going out: an inner yang with Wealth void and changing to yang is no good for taking money in and mostly scatters; an inner yin whose Wealth line changes to yin turns auspicious on time; an outer yin with yin Wealth is good for spending; an outer yang with yang Wealth should be stored away; yin is always the good sign, pure yang mostly loses.

note.yi: 「财空还变阳」的断句，有的读作「财空、还变阳」，有的读作「财空还，变阳」；这里取前一种。原文里的（7）是整理本给今人注文编的号。
note.en: The phrase about Wealth void 'and again changing to yang' can be punctuated in more than one way; this entry takes the first. The (7) in the Chinese is a number the transcription gave to a modern note.

zh: 内阳财空还变阳，
不宜入财多散亡，
内阴财爻还变阴，
如期变吉不须吟（7）。
外阴财阴出财吉，
外阳财阳宜贮密，
但阴为好吉无疑，
若是纯阳多散失。
yi: 内卦是阳，财空，又变成阳，
不宜进财，多半散失；
内卦是阴，财爻也变成阴，
如期变吉，不必犹豫。
外卦阴、财也阴，出钱吉；
外卦阳、财也阳，宜藏好；
只要是阴就好，吉无疑；
若是纯阳，多半散失。
en: An inner trigram of yang, its Wealth void and changing to yang:
not fit for taking money in, it mostly scatters;
an inner trigram of yin, its Wealth line also changing to yin:
it turns auspicious on time, and there is no need to hesitate.
An outer yin with yin Wealth: spending is good;
an outer yang with yang Wealth: store it away;
as long as it is yin it is good, and auspicious without doubt;
if it is pure yang, most of it is lost.

title: 财库：入财时财库化成鬼，是折财耗害；如坎卦以火为财，火墓在戌

rule.yi: 进财时，财的库（墓）化成了鬼，是折本耗损之象；比如坎卦以火为财，火墓在戌，就是这个例子。
rule.en: When money is coming in but the store of Wealth turns into Pressure, that is loss of capital and wasting harm; take the Kan trigram, whose Wealth is Fire and whose Fire tomb is at Xu, as the example.

zh: 入财财库化为鬼，
此是折财耗害耳，
假令坎卦火为财，
火丧在戌此为是。
yi: 进财的时候，财的库化成了鬼，
这就是折本耗损。
比如坎卦，火是它的财，
火的墓在戌，就是这个例子。
en: When money is coming in and the store of Wealth turns into Pressure,
this is loss of capital and wasting harm.
Take the Kan trigram, whose Wealth is Fire:
the tomb of Fire is at Xu, and that is the case.

title: 海底眼：财旺相喜持世，有生扶可乘势；卖货要用神兴，开店要财爻安静

rule.yi: 海底眼说：占财，财旺相，喜欢它持世；财出现在卦上又有生扶，可以乘势而为；卖货求财要用神兴旺；开店要财爻安静才有利。
rule.en: The Eye at the Bottom of the Sea says: when divining for wealth, Wealth thriving is best when it holds the Self; Wealth showing and supported may be ridden while it lasts; for selling goods the Subject must be thriving; for opening a shop the Wealth line should be quiet.

note.yi: 这几句在《海底眼》原书里也有（见 HDY.01），第二句字面不同：这里作「出现生扶可乘势」，原书作「出现生扶司秉劳」。
note.en: These lines also stand in the Haidi Yan itself (see HDY.01), where the second line reads differently: here 'showing and supported one may ride the moment', there 'showing and supported it takes charge and does the work'.

zh: 占财旺相喜持世，
出现生扶可乘势，
脱货求财要用兴，
开店财爻安者利。
yi: 占财，财旺相，喜欢它持世；
财出现在卦上又有生扶，可以乘势；
卖货求财，要用神兴旺；
开店，财爻安静的有利。
en: Divining for wealth, Wealth thriving, it is glad to hold the Self;
Wealth showing and supported may be ridden while it lasts;
to sell goods for money the Subject must thrive;
for a shop, the one whose Wealth line is quiet profits.

title: 海底眼：财逢月破空亡不可凭，伏财被飞爻克制白留意；最后两句只看财生不生命

rule.yi: 财遇月破、空亡，不可凭信；伏着的财被飞爻克制，白白留意；最后「争困撼钱财」几个字含义不明，只能读出：看财有没有生到命上。
rule.en: Wealth meeting Month-break or Void cannot be relied on; a hidden Wealth controlled by its flying line is attended to in vain; the last two lines, with their unclear words about contending, being pressed and shaking money, can only be read as: look at whether Wealth generates the natal line.

note.yi: 「争困撼钱财」四个字，「撼钱」在本书别处（六爻俱静类）和「赌斗」放在一起，可能指赌斗得来的钱；「争」「困」两字含义不明。这里照字译，不解释。「命」按本书「随官入墓」一节里「命随鬼入墓」的用法，指问卜人生年地支所在的爻。
note.en: The words about contending, being pressed and shaking loose money are unclear. 'Shaking money' stands beside 'gambling and contests' elsewhere in this book (the section on six quiet lines) and may mean money won in contests; the other two words are unclear. They are translated literally without explanation. 'The natal line' follows the sense of 'the natal line following Pressure into the tomb' elsewhere in this book: the line of the asker's birth-year branch.

zh: 月破空亡未可凭，
飞爻克制徒留意，
若求争困撼钱财，
但看财生命者是。
yi: 财逢月破、空亡，不能凭信；
伏着的财被飞爻克制，白白留意；
如果是求争、困、撼一类的钱财，
只看财有没有生到命上就是了。
en: Wealth meeting Month-break or Void cannot be relied on;
a hidden Wealth controlled by the flying line is attended to in vain;
if the money sought is of the sort called contending, pressed or shaken loose,
look only at whether Wealth generates the natal line.

title: 博戏求财以财为本：子孙出现、世临它，再旺相无刑克，称心而归

rule.yi: 赌博求财，以财为本；子孙出现在卦上、世临着它，再加旺相、没有刑克，保管高高兴兴、称心而归。
rule.en: In gambling for wealth Wealth is the stake; with Output showing and the Self sitting on it, and thriving with no punishment or control, you will surely come home glad and satisfied.

zh: 博戏求财财是本，
子孙出现世临之，
更乘旺相无刑克，
管取欢欣称意归。
yi: 赌博求财，财是本钱；
子孙出现，世临着它；
再加旺相、没有刑克，
保管欢欢喜喜、称心而回。
en: Gambling for wealth, Wealth is the stake;
Output showing and the Self sitting on it;
thriving as well, with no punishment or control:
you will come home glad and satisfied.

title: 博戏又云：世上出现鬼、被应爻克，纵有财神也输；福德休囚陷伏，白费功夫

rule.yi: 赌博的另一首：世爻上见鬼、又被应爻克，纵然有财也是输；福德休囚、又都陷伏，来回白下功夫。
rule.en: Another verse on gambling: the Self showing Pressure and controlled by the Other loses even with Wealth present; Output weak and hidden everywhere, one goes back and forth and works in vain.

zh: 又云：
世出现鬼应爻克，
纵有财神也是输，
福德休囚皆陷伏，
往来空去下功夫。
yi: 书里又有一首说：
世上出现鬼，被应爻克，
纵然有财神也是输；
福德休囚，又都陷伏，
来来往往白下功夫。
en: The book also has another verse, which says:
with Pressure showing on the Self and controlled by the Other,
even with Wealth present you lose;
Output weak and all of it sunk or hidden:
coming and going, you work in vain.

title: 买卖六爻各主一样：初货物、二己身、三伴侣、四中途、五店舍、六地头

rule.yi: 买卖占里六个爻各代表一样：初爻是货物，二爻是自己，三爻是同伴，四爻是半路，五爻是店舍，上爻是买卖的地方。
rule.en: In a divination on buying and selling the six lines each stand for one thing: the first for goods, the second for oneself, the third for a companion, the fourth for the road midway, the fifth for the lodging, the top for the place of the trade.

note.yi: 「地头」是买卖发生的那个地方。《阐奥歌章》求财买卖章里，外卦是「地头」，内卦是「人」（见 CA.15）。
note.en: 'The local ground' is the place where the trade happens. In the Chan'ao Gezhang's verse on seeking wealth and trade the outer trigram is 'the local ground' and the inner is 'the person' (see CA.15).

zh: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
货物己身伴侣中途店舍地头
yi: 第一爻、第二爻、第三爻、第四爻、第五爻、第六爻，依次是：
货物、自己、同伴、半路、店舍、地头。
en: The first line, the second, the third, the fourth, the fifth, the sixth, in order, are:
goods, oneself, a companion, the road midway, the lodging, the local ground.

hits.text: 初爻二爻三爻四爻五爻六爻
货己身伴侣中途店舍地头

title: 郭璞论买卖：财爻克世最好，身旺相与财并、无煞不空；贞旺悔囚先赢，悔旺贞休后赢

rule.yi: 贩运买卖，财爻克世最好；卦身旺相又与财并，再没有凶煞，不落空亡，就能成；贞旺悔囚，起初买卖就赢，悔旺贞休，要后来才赢；卦里上下互相刑克，即使有财爻，也只是空有名声。「贞」「悔」指内外卦还是本卦之卦，见「打架」。
rule.en: For trading goods, a Wealth line controlling the Self is best; the Body thriving and joined with Wealth, with no baleful stars and not falling Void, it succeeds; Zhen thriving and Hui imprisoned, the first trades win, Hui thriving and Zhen resting, the win comes later; if above and below punish and control each other, even with a Wealth line it is only a name. Whether Zhen and Hui mean the inner and outer trigrams or the original and resulting hexagrams: see the dispute.

dispute.yi: 这首歌里的「贞」「悔」，有两种读法。一种是内卦为贞、外卦为悔；一种是本卦为贞、之卦为悔。《易林补遗》两种都记：有动爻时，本卦是贞、之卦是悔；爻都静、没有之卦时，才取内卦为贞、外卦为悔，并且「以贞为始，以悔为终」。歌诀自己没有说是哪一种。「贞旺悔囚初买卖，悔旺贞休后始赢」里的「初」和「后」有先后，和「以贞为始，以悔为终」对得上；但这不是歌诀的明文，本库不裁。
dispute.en: 'Zhen' and 'Hui' in this verse can be read in two ways: the inner trigram as Zhen and the outer as Hui, or the original hexagram as Zhen and the resulting hexagram as Hui. The Yilin Buyi records both: when there is a moving line, the original hexagram is Zhen and the resulting hexagram is Hui; only when all lines are still and there is no resulting hexagram does it take the inner trigram as Zhen and the outer as Hui, and 'Zhen is the beginning and Hui is the end.' The verse itself does not say which. The words 'first' and 'later' in 'Zhen thriving and Hui imprisoned, the first trades; Hui thriving and Zhen resting, only later a win' have a before and after that fits 'Zhen is the beginning, Hui the end'; but that is not the verse's own statement, and this library does not decide.

note.yi: 「更看役此无诸煞」的「役此」字义不明，可能有讹字；这里照字面译作「这件事上」，不确定。
note.en: The words 'yi ci' in the third line are unclear and may be miscopied; they are translated loosely as 'in this matter', without certainty.

zh: 兴贩财爻克世精，
兼身旺相与财并，
更看役此无诸煞，
不落空亡有所成。
贞旺悔囚初买卖，
悔旺贞休后始赢，
卦中上下相刑克，
纵有财爻空有声。
yi: 贩运买卖，财爻克世最好；
卦身旺相，又和财并在一起；
再看这件事上有没有各种凶煞；
不落空亡，就有成就。
贞旺、悔囚，起初的买卖有利；
悔旺、贞休，后来才赢；
卦中上下互相刑克，
纵有财爻，也只是空有名声。
en: In trading goods, a Wealth line controlling the Self is best;
the Body thriving and joined with Wealth;
then see whether any baleful stars attend the matter;
not falling Void, there is success.
Zhen thriving and Hui imprisoned: the first trades profit;
Hui thriving and Zhen resting: the win comes later;
if above and below in the hexagram punish and control each other,
even with a Wealth line there is only a name and no substance.

zh: 凡有动爻，便有之卦。
以本卦为贞，之卦为悔，
凡爻静无之者，便取内卦为贞，外卦为悔，
以贞为始，以悔为终。
yi: 凡是有动爻，就有之卦；
以本卦为贞，之卦为悔；
凡是爻都静、没有之卦的，就取内卦为贞、外卦为悔；
以贞为开始，以悔为终结。
en: Wherever there is a moving line, there is a resulting hexagram;
the original hexagram is Zhen, the resulting hexagram is Hui;
where the lines are all still and there is no resulting hexagram, the inner trigram is Zhen and the outer trigram is Hui;
Zhen is the beginning and Hui is the end.

title: 卜筮元龟：财持世克世得利；财旺买的货贵、休囚买的货贱；卖看财与世应，见三金得宝，无财鬼克身防偷

rule.yi: 财爻持世、克世都得利；财旺，买来的货贵如金玉；财休囚，买来的货贱如尘土；卖货看财、世应旺相；买货遇上休囚，货多有益；卦里三个金得宝多，见离象没有不吉的；卦里没有财、鬼克身，丢东西多半是遇上偷的人；内外卦相生有气、财与龙德并，金银加倍。
rule.en: Wealth holding or controlling the Self brings profit; with Wealth thriving what is bought is as precious as gold and jade, with it weak what is bought is cheap as dust; in selling, Wealth and the Self and Other thriving are solid; in buying, meeting Wealth weak, goods are plentiful and profitable; three Metal lines in the hexagram bring many treasures and the Li image is always auspicious; a hexagram without Wealth and Pressure controlling the Body: what is lost is probably taken by a thief; the trigrams generating each other and having qi, Wealth joined with the Dragon Virtue, gold and silver double.

note.yi: 「龙德」是一颗神煞，书里没有在这一条里解释。「卜筮元龟」是《断易天机》转引的书名，原书这里没有另收。
note.en: 'The Dragon Virtue' is a spirit-star that this passage does not explain. 'Bushi Yuangui' is a book the Duanyi Tianji quotes; this library has no separate copy of it.

zh: 财爻持世兼克世，
此皆得利自然真，
财旺买物金玉贵，
休囚买必贱如尘。
卖财世应旺相实，
买遇休囚货盈益，
卦有三金得宝多，
离象见之无不吉。
凡卦无财鬼克身，
遗忘应是遇偷人，
贞悔相生都有气，
财并龙德倍金银。
yi: 财爻持世，又克世，
这都是得利之象，一定是真的；
财旺，买来的东西贵如金玉；
财休囚，买来的东西必定贱如尘土。
卖货，财和世应旺相就实在；
买货，遇上休囚，货物多、有益；
卦里有三个金，得的宝物多，
见到离象，没有不吉的。
凡是卦里没有财、鬼克着身，
丢了东西，多半是遇上了偷东西的人；
贞悔相生，都有气，
财再和龙德并在一起，金银加倍。
en: Wealth holding the Self and also controlling it:
these are all signs of profit, sure and true;
Wealth thriving, what is bought is precious as gold and jade;
Wealth weak, what is bought will be cheap as dust.
In selling, Wealth and the Self and Other thriving is solid;
in buying, meeting them weak, goods are plentiful and profitable;
three Metal lines in the hexagram, the treasures gained are many,
and where the Li image is seen there is nothing that is not auspicious.
Whenever a hexagram has no Wealth and Pressure controls the Body,
what is lost is probably taken by a thief;
Zhen and Hui generating each other and both having qi,
with Wealth joined to the Dragon Virtue, gold and silver are doubled.

title: 四五处求财买卖，哪处得财：财旺相不空为吉，财初动克身居首；无财放弃；鬼化财易得，财化鬼失财；财化兄弟克，兄弟化财得，化子孙无忧

rule.yi: 几处都想求财做买卖，看哪处得财：财爻旺相、不落空亡就吉；财爻刚发动又克身，这处最好；卦里没有财（如遁、蹇一类），说白了就是放弃；鬼化为财，财容易得；财化为鬼，有失财之忧；财化兄弟，终究被克；兄弟化财，终究能得；化为子孙，也没有忧。
rule.en: With four or five places in mind for seeking wealth and trade, which one gets the money: Wealth thriving and not falling Void is auspicious; a Wealth line just moving and controlling the Body makes that place the first; a hexagram without Wealth, such as Dun or Jian, says plainly to give it up; Pressure changing into Wealth, the money is easy to get; Wealth changing into Pressure, worry over losing it; Wealth changing to Peer is finally controlled, Peer changing to Wealth is finally gained, and changing to Output is free of worry.

note.yi: 题目的「四五处」就是四五个候选的地方；「财爻初动」可读作「财爻刚发动」，也可读作「初爻上的财发动」，原文没有分明，这里取前一种。
note.en: The heading's 'four or five places' means four or five candidate places. 'The Wealth line first moving' can be read as 'just beginning to move' or as 'the Wealth on the first line moving'; the text does not settle it, and this entry takes the first.

zh: 欲得财爻临旺相，
不落空亡便为吉，
财爻初动兼克身，
此处得云为第一。
卦里无财遁蹇流，
直说须云抛却休，
鬼化为财财易得，
财化为鬼失财忧。
财化兄弟终言克，
兄弟化财终可得，
化为子位亦无忧，
以此推之必无惑。
yi: 想得财，要财爻临着旺相，
不落空亡就是吉；
财爻刚发动，又克身，
这个地方说是第一。
卦里没有财，像遁、蹇这一类，
直说就是：放弃算了；
鬼化为财，财容易得；
财化为鬼，有失财之忧；
财化兄弟，终究说是被克；
兄弟化财，终究能得；
化成子孙，也没有忧；
照这样推断，一定没有疑惑。
en: To get the money, the Wealth line must sit on a thriving state,
and not falling Void is auspicious;
a Wealth line just moving and controlling the Body:
that place is called the first.
A hexagram with no Wealth, of the Dun and Jian kind,
says in plain words: give it up;
Pressure changing into Wealth, the money is easy to get;
Wealth changing into Pressure, there is worry over losing it;
Wealth changing into Peer, it is in the end said to be controlled;
Peer changing into Wealth, it can in the end be gained;
changing into Output, there is likewise no worry;
reasoned this way, there will be no doubt.

title: 本宫财与鬼并，忧失财：求财遇萃必折本，世与鬼并同断，要防盗贼和自己损耗

rule.yi: 本宫里财和鬼并在一起，怕失财：求财遇到萃卦，一定折本；世和鬼并在一起的，也这样断；要谨慎防备，把它当作禳解，担心遇上盗贼，或者自己损耗。
rule.en: When in the home palace Wealth and Pressure are joined, fear losing the money: seeking wealth and meeting Cui means a sure loss of capital, and the Self joined with Pressure is judged the same; be careful and guard against it as if by a rite, for fear of thieves or of one's own waste.

zh: 求财遇萃必折本，
世与鬼并即此论，
须当防慎以为禳，
忧逢盗贼自侵损。
yi: 求财遇到萃卦，一定折本；
世和鬼并在一起，就照这样断；
应当防备谨慎，当作禳解；
担心遇上盗贼，或者自己损耗。
en: Seeking wealth and meeting the Cui hexagram, capital is surely lost;
the Self joined with Pressure is judged the same way;
one should guard and be careful, as if performing a rite;
for fear of meeting thieves, or of one's own waste.

title: 求财买卖往哪个方向：避开本宫绝命和墓绝之方，走生气、长生和世爻旺处

rule.yi: 求财买卖往哪个方向走吉：本宫的绝命方、入墓的方位、加上鬼的墓在同一边，墓绝的方位最凶，想经营就避开这条路；生气、长生的方位吉，世爻旺的地方好，八卦的方位都照这个定，终身没有病也没有灾。
rule.en: Which direction is auspicious for seeking wealth and trade: the Life-severing direction of the home palace, the tomb direction, and the tomb of Pressure on the same side, the directions of tomb and severance are the worst, and one who means to run a business avoids that road; the directions of Vital Qi and Long Life are auspicious, a place where the Self is thriving is good, and the directions of the eight trigrams are all fixed this way; then one has no illness and no calamity for life.

note.yi: 「绝命」「生气」是八宅游年里的方位名；本书没有在这一条里讲怎么排，本库不补。「无秧」的「秧」可能是「殃」的误字，原文如此。
note.en: 'Life-severing' and 'Vital Qi' are direction names from the house-facing system; this passage does not explain how they are laid out and this library does not add it. 'Yang' in the last line may be a miscopy of 'calamity'; the original reads as given.

zh: 本宫绝命及入墓，
兼之鬼墓同厢顾，
墓绝之方最为凶，
若欲经营避此路。
生气长生是吉方，
世爻旺处即为良，
八卦之方同此定，
终身无病亦无秧。
yi: 本宫的绝命方，以及入墓的方位，
再加上鬼的墓也在同一边，
墓、绝的方位最凶，
想经营就要避开这条路。
生气、长生的方位是吉方，
世爻旺的地方就是好的；
八卦的方位都照这个来定，
终身没有病，也没有灾。
en: The Life-severing direction of the home palace, and the tomb direction,
together with the tomb of Pressure on the same side:
the directions of tomb and severance are the worst;
if you mean to run a business, avoid that road.
The directions of Vital Qi and Long Life are the auspicious ones;
where the Self is thriving is good;
the directions of the eight trigrams are all fixed this way,
and for life there is no illness and no calamity.

title: 求财无鬼：兄弟争权，替别人趁财，财也薄；鬼是财之主，财旺也要有主张才聚得起来

rule.yi: 求财而卦里没有鬼：兄弟一定来争权，等于在别人手下赚钱，钱也少；鬼是财的主人，财再旺也要有人作主才聚得起来，没有鬼就没有主，一定破耗多端、钱聚不起来。
rule.en: Seeking wealth with no Pressure in the hexagram: the Peer lines will surely contend for control, which means earning under another's hand, and the money is thin; Pressure is the master of Wealth, and however thriving Wealth is it needs someone in charge before it can gather, so with no Pressure there is no master, and there will surely be many kinds of waste and the funds will not gather.

zh: 求财无鬼，
兄弟必争权；
主在他人手下趁财，
财亦薄。
yi: 求财而卦里没有鬼，
兄弟一定来争权；
主要是在别人手下赚钱，
所得的钱也很少。
en: Seeking wealth with no Pressure in the hexagram:
the Peer lines will surely contend for control;
it means chiefly earning under another person's hand,
and the money is thin.

zh: 鬼者，
财之主也。
财虽旺，
必有主张，
然后能聚；
无鬼无主也，
必主破耗多端、资财不聚。
yi: 鬼这个东西，
是财的主人。
财即使旺，
也必须有人作主，
然后才聚得起来；
没有鬼就是没有主人，
一定破耗多端、钱聚不起来。
en: As for Pressure,
it is the master of Wealth.
Even if Wealth is thriving,
it must have someone in charge,
and only then can it gather;
with no Pressure there is no master,
and there will surely be many kinds of waste and the funds will not gather.

hits.text: 必主破耗多端、资财不聚
必主破耗多端、资财不聚

title: 绝处逢生：求财遇妻财绝处逢生，财易求，利厚，不比旺相之财有限

rule.yi: 用爻被日辰绝了，又有生它的爻发动来相生，叫绝处逢生。求财遇到财爻绝处逢生，钱容易求、利也厚；不像旺相的财有个限度，新生出来的财没有穷尽。
rule.en: When the Subject line is cut off by the Day but a line that gives it life moves to generate it, that is 'meeting life where there was severance'. In seeking wealth, Wealth meeting life where it was cut off is easy to seek and its profit is rich; unlike a thriving Wealth, which has a limit, newly born Wealth has none.

note.yi: 「生乃之财」的「乃」字疑为「迺」或别的字，意思是刚生出来的财；这里照这个意思译。
note.en: The word 'nai' in 'sheng nai zhi cai' may be a miscopy; the sense is newly born Wealth, and it is translated that way.

zh: 且如申日占，卦遇用爻属木，
木见申则绝，木爻无用矣。
此同无也。
若得水爻发动，水长生动来相生，木爻仍复有用。
譬如人当困穷之际，得遇贵人扶持，
必有寒谷回春之象，此乃是绝处逢生也。
yi: 比如在申日占卦，卦里遇到的用爻属木，
木遇到申就绝了，木爻没有用了；
这等于没有。
如果有水爻发动，水在申长生，动来相生，木爻又重新有用了。
就像人在穷困的时候，遇上贵人扶持，
一定有寒谷回春的样子，这就是绝处逢生。
en: Suppose the divination is on a Shen day and the Subject line is Wood:
Wood meets Shen and is cut off, and the Wood line is of no use;
this is the same as having none.
But if a Water line moves, Water being born at Shen and coming to generate it, the Wood line is useful again.
It is like a person at a time of poverty and hardship who meets a noble patron's help:
there is surely the look of spring returning to a cold valley; this is 'meeting life where there was severance'.

hits.text: 且如申日占卦，遇用爻属木
木见申则绝，木爻无用矣
若得水爻发动来相生，木爻仍复有用
譬人当困穷之际，得遇贵人扶持
必有寒谷回春之象，此乃是绝处逢生也

zh: 求财：
遇妻财绝处逢生，
其财易求，
利殊厚，
非比旺相之财有限，
生乃之财无穷也。
yi: 求财这件事上：
遇到妻财绝处逢生，
这笔财容易求，
得利很丰厚，
不像旺相的财有个限度，
新生出来的财没有穷尽。
en: Seeking wealth:
when Wealth meets life where it was cut off,
that money is easy to seek,
and its profit is rich;
unlike a thriving Wealth, which has a limit,
newly born Wealth is without end.

title: 合处逢冲：占财遇之，财将入手而不得

rule.yi: 卦里本来世应相生、六爻相合，事事可成，却在冲它的日子占到，叫合处逢冲；占财遇到，钱将要到手却拿不到。
rule.en: When a hexagram in which Self and Other generate each other and the six lines combine, so that everything can succeed, is divined on a day that clashes it, that is 'meeting a clash where there was combination'; in divining for wealth, the money is about to come to hand and is not gained.

note.yi: 书里紧接着说：占讼和占病遇到合处逢冲反而好，因为合则事成、冲则灾散。这一条只取求财。
note.en: The book goes on to say that in divining a lawsuit or an illness, this same pattern is welcome, since combination brings the matter about and a clash scatters the calamity. This entry takes only wealth.

zh: 且如占得雷地豫卦。
世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也。
却在子日占得，
子冲应上午、害世上未，
此乃合处逢冲也。
yi: 比如占到雷地豫卦。
世应相生，六爻相合，吉利没有不顺的，是事事可成的样子。
却是在子日占到的，
子冲应爻上的午、又害世爻上的未，
这就是合处逢冲。
en: Suppose the divination gets the Yu hexagram, Thunder over Earth.
Self and Other generate each other and the six lines combine; all is auspicious and nothing goes against it; it is the look of everything succeeding.
But it is got on a Zi day,
and Zi clashes the Wu on the Other line and harms the Wei on the Self line;
this is 'meeting a clash where there was combination'.

hits.text: 世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也
世应相生，六爻相合，吉无不利，乃事事可成之象也

zh: 占财遇之，
财将入手而不得。
yi: 占财遇到这种情形，
钱将要到手却拿不到。
en: In divining for wealth, meeting this:
the money is about to come to hand and is not gained.

title: 随官入墓：求财遇之，勤劳备历，终归他人

rule.yi: 身随鬼入墓、世随鬼入墓、命随鬼入墓，这三种不管占什么事都不是吉兆；求财遇到，辛辛苦苦什么劳碌都尝遍了，钱最后归了别人。
rule.en: The Body, the Self or the natal line following Pressure into the tomb: whatever is divined, none of the three is an auspicious sign; in seeking wealth one goes through every kind of toil and the money in the end goes to someone else.

note.yi: 原书给这三种各举了一个卦例（丑日得解卦、未日得大畜、未日得复等），那是卦例，不是判据，本库不收。「命」指问卜人出生地支所在的爻。
note.en: For each of the three kinds the book gives an example hexagram; those are cases, not rules, and this library does not include them. 'The natal line' is the line at the asker's birth branch.

zh: 随官入墓，其目有三：
有身随鬼入墓，
有世随鬼入墓，
有命随鬼入墓。
yi: 随官入墓，分作三种：
有卦身跟着鬼入墓，
有世爻跟着鬼入墓，
有本命跟着鬼入墓。
en: 'Following Pressure into the tomb' has three kinds:
the Body following Pressure into the tomb,
the Self following Pressure into the tomb,
and the natal line following Pressure into the tomb.

zh: 以上三墓，
不问占何事，
皆非吉兆。
yi: 以上三种入墓，
不管占什么事，
都不是吉兆。
en: Of these three tombs,
whatever is being divined,
none is an auspicious sign.

zh: 求财遇之，
勤劳备历，
终归他人。
yi: 求财遇到这种情形，
辛苦劳碌样样尝遍，
钱最后归了别人。
en: Seeking wealth and meeting it:
one goes through every kind of toil,
and in the end the money goes to someone else.

title: 逢冲暗动：求财遇之，吉则利厚，凶则防暗中破财、被人劫骗而不觉

rule.yi: 静爻被日辰冲到，叫暗动，有吉有凶；求财遇到暗动，吉的，所求的利益很厚；凶的，要防暗中破财，或者暗地里被人劫骗，自己毫无察觉。
rule.en: A still line clashed by the Day is called a hidden movement, and it can be auspicious or ominous; in seeking wealth, if it is auspicious the profit sought is very rich, and if ominous one must guard against hidden waste of money or being robbed and cheated in secret without being able to notice.

zh: 且如六爻安静，不遇冲则不动。
若日辰相冲，名曰暗动。
暗动者，有吉有凶，
各有所用焉，不可一概而论。
yi: 六爻都安静的时候，不遇到冲就不动。
如果被日辰冲到，叫作暗动。
暗动有吉有凶，
各有各的用处，不能一概而论。
en: When the six lines are all quiet, without a clash they do not move.
If the Day clashes a line, it is called a hidden movement.
A hidden movement may be auspicious or ominous,
each with its own use, and not to be judged all alike.

hits.text: 且如六爻安静，不遇冲则不动
各有所用，不可一概而论
且如六爻安静，不遇冲则不动
各有所用，不可一概而论

zh: 求财遇之，
吉则言求之利益殊厚；
凶则言须防凶暗费财，
或阴中被人劫骗，
罔可知觉。
yi: 求财遇到暗动，
吉的，就说所求的利益很厚；
凶的，就说要防暗中破财，
或者暗地里被人劫骗，
自己毫无察觉。
en: Seeking wealth and meeting a hidden movement:
if auspicious, say the profit sought is very rich;
if ominous, say to guard against hidden waste of money,
or being robbed and cheated in secret,
without being able to notice it.

title: 助鬼伤身：求财遇鬼带大小耗，财到手后非官即病，耗散费用

rule.yi: 能生助官鬼的只有妻财；它不宜发动，一动，衰鬼变成旺鬼，旺鬼更凶。求财遇到鬼带大耗、小耗，这笔财到手以后，不是惹官司就是生病，钱都花耗了。
rule.en: The only line that can generate and help Pressure is Wealth; it should not move, for once it moves a weak Pressure becomes strong and a strong Pressure becomes more fierce. In seeking wealth, meeting Pressure carrying the Great or Small Waste stars, after this money is gained there is either a lawsuit or an illness and the money is spent away.

note.yi: 书里这一节的末了说：若有子孙发动、解神来救，可以反凶成吉。这一条只取求财。
note.en: At the end of this section the book adds that if Output moves and a relieving spirit comes to the rescue, the ominous can turn auspicious. This entry takes only wealth.

zh: 生助官鬼者，不过妻财也。
不宜发动，
动则衰鬼变成旺鬼。
旺鬼遇之，其势愈凶。
yi: 能生助官鬼的，只有妻财。
它不宜发动，
一动，衰弱的鬼就变成旺鬼。
旺鬼再遇到它，来势更凶。
en: The only line that can generate and help Pressure is Wealth.
It should not move,
for once it moves a weak Pressure becomes a strong one.
A strong Pressure meeting it grows more fierce.

hits.text: 生助官鬼者，不过妻财也
生助官鬼者，不过妻财也

zh: 求财遇鬼带大小耗，
必主此财求得之后，
非官即病，
耗散费用。
yi: 求财遇到鬼带着大耗、小耗，
一定是这笔财求到手以后，
不是惹官司就是生病，
钱都花耗掉了。
en: Seeking wealth and meeting Pressure carrying the Great or Small Waste stars:
surely after this money has been gained,
there is either a lawsuit or an illness,
and the money is spent and dissipated.

chapter: 出现伏藏·占财伏兄、鬼、父子
title: 占财伏：伏兄口舌，伏鬼买卖遭殃，伏父母得半，伏子孙有气必满；出现旺相长久，伏藏只利一时

rule.yi: 用神出现在卦上而旺相的，主长久；伏藏而有气的，只有一时的好处。财伏在兄弟下有口舌，伏在世下旺相可成；财伏在鬼下买卖遭殃，除非日辰是福德；财伏在父母下旺相只得一半；财伏在子孙下有气就一定圆满。
rule.en: A Subject showing in the hexagram and thriving lasts long and far; one that is hidden but has qi profits only for a while. Wealth hidden under Peer meets quarrels, but under the Self line, if thriving, it can succeed; hidden under Pressure, trade meets disaster unless the Day is Output; hidden under Resource, thriving, it gets half; hidden under Output, with qi, it is surely full.

note.yi: 「日辰福德」可读作「日辰是福德」，也可读作「日辰、福德（有一个来）」；书里没有断开，这里取前一种。这四句都是歌诀，书里没有讲用法。
note.en: 'The Day, Output' can be read as 'the Day is Output' or as 'the Day or Output (one of them comes)'; the book does not punctuate it, and this entry takes the first. All four passages are verse and the book does not explain how to apply them.

zh: 出现旺相，为久为远；
伏藏有气，只利暂时。
yi: 出现在卦上而旺相的，主长久、久远；
伏藏着但有气的，只有一时的好处。
en: One that shows in the hexagram and thrives lasts long and far;
one that is hidden but has qi profits only for a while.

zh: 用财伏兄，口舌相侵；
若在世下，旺相可成。
yi: 用财伏在兄弟爻下，口舌来侵；
如果伏在世下，旺相就能成。
en: A Subject Wealth hidden under Peer is invaded by quarrels;
if it lies under the Self and is thriving, it can succeed.

zh: 财伏鬼乡，买卖遭殃；
日辰福德，方始荣昌。
yi: 财伏在鬼的地方，买卖遭殃；
日辰是福德，才会兴旺。
en: Wealth hidden in Pressure's place, trade meets disaster;
only if the Day is Output does it flourish.

zh: 财伏父母，旺相得半；
财伏子孙，有气必满。
yi: 财伏在父母爻下，旺相只得一半；
财伏在子孙爻下，有气就一定圆满。
en: Wealth hidden under Resource, if thriving, gets half;
Wealth hidden under Output, with qi, is surely full.

title: 六爻都静：将本求财须用神静，脱货占来动才正；放债抽拈、买卖停场、赌斗撼钱，用爻宜静，有气为先

rule.yi: 六爻都安静的卦：带本钱去求人，用神要静；卖货来占，用神动才正；放债、抽拈、买卖歇了场、赌斗博钱这几样，用爻都宜静，有气最要紧。
rule.en: In a hexagram with all six lines quiet: to go to someone with capital, the Subject should be still; in divining on selling goods, movement is the proper sign; for lending, drawing lots, trade gone quiet, and gambling or contests for money, the Subject line should be still, and having qi comes first.

note.yi: 这一行接着还列了赴试、见官、投谒、娶妾、屋宅坟田、失物等，本库只取求财这几样。「抽拈」「停场」「撼钱」的确切含义书里没有解释，这里照字面译；「撼钱」和「赌斗」连在一起，可能指赌来的钱。原文里的（2）是整理本给今人注文编的号。
note.en: The line goes on to list sitting an exam, seeing an official, visiting a patron, taking a wife or concubine, houses, graves and lost things; this library takes only the wealth items. The exact senses of 'drawing lots', 'stopping the market' and 'shaking money' are not explained and are translated literally; 'shaking money' stands beside 'gambling and contests' and may mean money won by gambling. The (2) in the Chinese is a number the transcription gave to a modern note.

zh: 将本谒人须用静，
脱货占来动是贞（2）。
yi: 带本钱去求人，用神要静；
卖货来占，动才正。
en: To go to someone with capital, the Subject should be still;
in divining on selling goods, movement is the proper sign.

zh: 将本营运，
放债抽拈，
买卖停场，
赌斗撼钱，
yi: 带本钱经营，
放债、抽拈，
买卖歇了场，
赌斗博钱，
en: running a business with capital,
lending at interest, drawing lots,
trade gone quiet,
gambling or contests for money,

zh: 用爻宜静，
有气为先。
yi: 用爻宜静，
有气最要紧。
en: the Subject line should be still,
and having qi comes first.

title: 子孙独发：为退为散，若乘旺相，亦可求财

rule.yi: 子孙一爻独自发动，是退、是散；如果乘着旺相，也可以求财。
rule.en: Output moving alone means retreat and dispersal; if it rides a thriving state, one may also seek wealth.

note.yi: 第二段是书里子孙类标题下的小注，同一个意思。
note.en: The second passage is the small note under the heading for Output, saying the same thing.

zh: 子孙独发，
为退为散；
若乘旺相，
亦可求财。
yi: 子孙一爻独自发动，
是退、是散；
如果乘着旺相，
也可以求财。
en: Output moving alone:
it means retreat and dispersal;
if it rides a thriving state,
one may also seek wealth.

zh: （为喜爻，
若独发，
宜散事，
旺相利求财）
yi: （它是喜爻，
如果独自发动，
宜于散事，
旺相就利于求财。）
en: (It is the Joy line;
if it moves alone,
it suits dispersing matters;
thriving, it favours seeking wealth.)

title: 兄弟独发：为诈为虚，旺相则财破；兄弟是劫财之神，宜隐伏，最怕化鬼爻

rule.yi: 兄弟一爻独自发动，是诈、是虚，旺相时钱财破耗；兄弟是劫财的神，最好隐伏，发动主虚假诈骗不实之事，旺相主口舌忧疑破财，出现发动还要看变成什么，最怕化成鬼爻。
rule.en: Peer moving alone means fraud and emptiness, and when thriving the money is broken; Peer is the spirit that robs Wealth and had best lie hidden; moving, it stands for false, deceitful and untrue matters; thriving, for quarrels, worry, doubt and loss of money; showing and moving, look at what it changes into, and most of all fear a change into a Pressure line.

note.yi: 第二段是本节后面缩排的小注，不是歌诀；书里没有标注者。
note.en: The second passage is an indented small note following the section, not part of the verse; the book does not name its author.

zh: 兄弟独发，
为诈为虚；
若乘旺相，
财破嗟吁。
yi: 兄弟一爻独自发动，
是诈、是虚；
如果乘着旺相，
钱财破耗，只有叹息。
en: Peer moving alone:
it means fraud and emptiness;
if it rides a thriving state,
the money is broken and there is only sighing.

zh: 兄弟为劫财之神，
大宜隐伏。
动发主虚诈不实之事，
凶不凶、吉不吉。
若旺相，主口舌忧疑破财，
如出现发动，更看变得何如，
大怕化鬼爻，凶。
yi: 兄弟是劫财的神，
最好隐伏。
一发动，主的是虚假、诈骗、不实的事，
凶又不凶、吉又不吉。
如果旺相，主口舌、忧疑、破财；
如果出现在卦上并且发动，还要看变成了什么；
最怕化成鬼爻，凶。
en: Peer is the spirit that robs Wealth,
and had best lie hidden.
Moving, it stands for false, deceitful and untrue matters,
neither truly ominous nor truly auspicious.
If thriving, it means quarrels, worry and doubt, and loss of money;
if it shows in the hexagram and moves, look also at what it changes into;
what is most feared is a change into a Pressure line: ominous.

title: 父母用·求财：（父母）发动是绝源杀，只许一度，再难求，也主艰辛

rule.yi: 求财里，父母爻发动，是断绝财源的煞：只许求到一次，再求就难，也主辛苦艰难。
rule.en: In seeking wealth, a Resource line that moves is the star that cuts off the source: the money can be gained only once, after that it is hard to seek, and it also means hardship.

note.yi: 这一行在「父母用」一节里，主语是父母爻，句子本身没有写出来；译文里的括号是补的。
note.en: This line stands in the section on Resource as Subject, and its subject, the Resource line, is not written in the sentence itself; the brackets in the translation supply it.

zh: 求财：
发动，
为绝源杀，
只许一度，
再难求，
亦主艰辛。
yi: 求财里：
（父母）发动，
是断绝财源的煞，
只许有一次，
再想求就难了，
也主辛苦艰难。
en: In seeking wealth:
[Resource] moving
is the star that cuts off the source;
the money can be gained only once,
after that it is hard to seek again,
and it also means hardship.

title: 兄弟用·求财：（兄弟）是恶客；在世发动财必难求，旁爻发动与人同求还行

rule.yi: 求财里，兄弟爻是恶客：在世爻上发动，钱一定难求；在旁的爻上发动，和别人一起求财还可以，不然就不是十全十美的利。
rule.en: In seeking wealth the Peer line is a bad guest: moving on the Self line, the money is sure to be hard to seek; moving on another line, seeking wealth together with another is possible, otherwise the profit is not wholly fine.

note.yi: 这一行在「兄弟用」一节里，主语兄弟没有写出来；「在世」原文没有写「爻」，这里按世爻译。
note.en: This line stands in the section on Peer as Subject, and its subject is not written; the words 'on the Self' are given without the word 'line' in the original and are read as the Self line.

zh: 求财：为恶客。
在世发动，
财必难求；
旁爻发动，
与人同求财可，
不然非全美之利。
yi: 求财里：（兄弟）是恶客；
在世爻上发动，
钱一定难求；
在旁的爻上发动，
和别人一起求财还行，
不然就不是十全十美的利。
en: In seeking wealth, [Peer] is a bad guest;
moving on the Self line,
the money is sure to be hard to seek;
moving on another line,
seeking wealth together with another is possible,
otherwise the profit is not wholly fine.

title: 子孙用·求财：（子孙）是主顾又是财源；旺相发动经营可久，落空亡或不上卦是无主顾

rule.yi: 求财里，子孙爻是主顾，又是财源：旺相发动，经营可以长久，绵绵不断；落空亡或者不上卦，就是没有主顾；妻财再旺也只许一次，再难成就，好比水没有源头。
rule.en: In seeking wealth the Output line is the customer and also the source of wealth: thriving and moving, the business can last, endlessly; falling Void or not appearing in the hexagram, there are no customers; even a thriving Wealth allows only one time, after which it is hard to bring about, like water with no source.

note.yi: 这一行在「子孙用」一节里，主语子孙没有写出来。
note.en: This line stands in the section on Output as Subject, and its subject is not written.

zh: 求财：为主顾，又为财源。
旺相发动，经营可久，绵绵不绝。
或落空亡，或不上卦，乃无主顾也；
妻财纵旺，只许一度，再难成就，譬如水之无源。
yi: 求财里，（子孙）是主顾，又是财源。
旺相发动，经营可以长久，连绵不断。
或者落空亡，或者不上卦，就是没有主顾；
妻财再旺，也只许一次，再难成就，好比水没有源头。
en: In seeking wealth, [Output] is the customer and also the source of wealth.
Thriving and moving, the business can last, without a break.
Falling Void or not appearing in the hexagram, there are no customers;
even a thriving Wealth allows only one time, after which it is hard to bring about, like water with no source.

title: 妻财用·求财：财是用爻、一卦的主宰，宜生世克世，大吉；无气必难求；诸事逢之皆吉，遇兄弟有损，遇福德更佳

rule.yi: 妻财是我克的那个六亲，诸事遇到它没有不吉的，只有占父母、文书不宜见它；遇兄弟有损，遇福德更好，遇官鬼泄我的气；动静都吉。占求财，它是用爻，一卦的主宰，宜生世、克世，大吉，没有气就一定难求。
rule.en: Wealth is the relation that I control; in all matters meeting it is auspicious, and only in divining about parents or documents is it unwelcome; meeting Peer it suffers loss, meeting Output it is better still, meeting Pressure it drains my qi; moving or still, it is auspicious. In divining for wealth it is the Subject line and the master of the hexagram, best when it generates or controls the Self, greatly auspicious; with no qi the money is sure to be hard to seek.

zh: 妻财者，我克者谓之妻财也。
诸事逢之，无不为吉。
惟占父母及文书，不宜见之。
值兄弟则有损，
遇福德则愈佳，
逢官鬼则泄我之气也。
动静皆吉。
yi: 妻财，就是我克的那个六亲。
各种事遇到它，没有不吉的；
只有占父母和文书时，不宜见到它；
遇到兄弟就有损，
遇到福德就更好，
遇到官鬼就泄我的气。
动也吉，静也吉。
en: Wealth is the relation that I control.
In all matters, meeting it is always auspicious;
only when divining about Resource, that is parents and documents, is it unwelcome;
meeting Peer it suffers loss,
meeting Output it is better still,
meeting Pressure it drains my qi.
Moving or still, it is auspicious.

hits.text: 妻财：我克者谓之妻财也
惟占父母及文书不宜见之
妻财我克者谓之妻财也
惟占父母及文书不宜见之

zh: 占求财：为用爻。
一卦是主宰，
宜生世克世，大吉。
无气，必难求。
yi: 占求财：它是用爻。
整个卦以它为主宰，
宜于生世、克世，大吉；
没有气，一定难求。
en: In divining for wealth, it is the Subject line.
The whole hexagram takes it as master;
it suits generating or controlling the Self, and is greatly auspicious;
with no qi, it is sure to be hard to seek.

title: 官鬼用·求财：（官鬼）是牙人；落空亡或不上卦，必无说合之人

rule.yi: 占求财，官鬼爻是牙人（说合买卖的中间人）；如果落空亡，或者不上卦，一定没有人来说合。
rule.en: In divining for wealth the Pressure line is the broker who brings the parties together; if it falls Void or does not appear in the hexagram, there is surely no one to arrange it.

note.yi: 这一行在「官鬼用」一节里，主语官鬼没有写出来。
note.en: This line stands in the section on Pressure as Subject, and its subject is not written.

zh: 占求财：为牙人。
若落空亡及不上卦，
必无说合之人。
yi: 占求财：（官鬼）是牙人。
如果落空亡或者不上卦，
一定没有说合的人。
en: In divining for wealth, [Pressure] is the broker.
If it falls Void or does not appear in the hexagram,
there is surely no one to bring the parties together.

title: 六亲变用：妻财宜旺相出现；兄弟为隔神；子孙为散神，旺相生世可求财，休囚发动只宜散财

rule.yi: 妻财宜旺相、出现在卦上，伏在世下的要生世；动而不当，宜脱货；兄弟叫隔神，忌动而不当；子孙叫散神，旺相生世可以求财，休囚发动就只宜散财。
rule.en: Wealth should be thriving and showing in the hexagram, and if hidden under the Self it should generate the Self; if it moves out of place, sell off goods; Peer is called the Separating spirit and should not move out of place; Output is called the Scattering spirit, and thriving and generating the Self one may seek wealth, but weak and moving it suits only scattering money.

note.yi: 「动不中」的确切含义书里没有解释，这里译作「动而不当」。
note.en: The exact sense of 'moving without hitting the mark' is not explained in the book and is rendered as 'moving out of place'.

zh: 妻财宜旺相出现，伏世下，宜生世。
动不中，宜脱货。
兄弟，此谓之隔神，
忌动不中。
子孙谓之散神，旺相生世可求财，
忌休囚发动，只宜散财。
yi: 妻财宜旺相、出现在卦上，伏在世下的，要生世。
动而不当，宜于脱手货物。
兄弟，叫作隔神，
忌讳动而不当。
子孙叫作散神，旺相生世，可以求财；
忌讳休囚发动，只宜散财。
en: Wealth should be thriving and showing in the hexagram; if hidden under the Self, it should generate the Self.
If it moves out of place, sell off the goods.
Peer is called the Separating spirit,
and should not move out of place.
Output is called the Scattering spirit; thriving and generating the Self, one may seek wealth;
weak and moving, it suits only scattering money.

title: 用财六看：世下财有无、日辰生扶、伏在哪一爻下、忌兄弟持世、独发要生世

rule.yi: 用财（以财为用神）的几个要点：财伏在世下，忌伏官；要妻财或生财的子孙值日；财喜伏在子、父之下，忌伏在鬼、兄之下；忌兄弟持世，须日辰旺相、用爻透出才不怕；用财旺相，伏动都要生世。
rule.en: Points for using Wealth as the Subject: Wealth hidden under the Self should not be hidden under Pressure; the Wealth line or Output that gives it life should rule the day; Wealth likes to be hidden under Output or Resource and dislikes being hidden under Pressure or Peer; Peer holding the Self is to be avoided unless the Day is thriving and the Subject shows; a thriving Wealth, hidden or moving, must generate the Self.

note.yi: 这一节原来官、财并说，本库只取用财的句子。「为子孙生财吉」的例子是子水为财、申金值日，因为金生水。「亦费力中得」后面紧接着「六看一爻独发」，两行在整理本里连在一起，这里在「亦费力中得」处断开。「用财伏世下，忌伏官」一句里的「官」指官鬼。
note.en: The section originally speaks of Pressure and Wealth together; this library takes only the sentences about Wealth. In the example, Zi Water is Wealth and Shen Metal rules the day because Metal generates Water. The line ending 'and even then it is gained by effort' runs straight into 'Sixth, look at a single line moving' in the transcription, and this entry breaks it there. The 'official' in 'Wealth hidden under the Self should not be hidden under the official' means Pressure.

zh: 用财伏世下，
忌伏官。
yi: 用财伏在世下，
忌讳伏在官下。
en: Wealth as the Subject hidden under the Self:
it should not be hidden under Pressure.

zh: 用财要妻财直日，或子孙直日生财。
假令子爻为财，如申金旺相直日，为子孙生财吉。
yi: 用财，要妻财值日，或者子孙值日来生财。
比如子水是财，申金旺相值日，就是子孙生财，吉。
en: For Wealth as the Subject, the Wealth line should rule the day, or Output should rule the day and generate Wealth.
For instance, if the Wealth is Zi Water and thriving Shen Metal rules the day, that is Output generating Wealth: auspicious.

zh: 用财喜伏子父之下，
忌伏鬼兄之下。
yi: 用财喜欢伏在子孙、父母之下，
忌讳伏在鬼、兄之下。
en: Wealth as the Subject likes to be hidden under Output or Resource,
and should not be hidden under Pressure or Peer.

zh: 用财忌兄弟持世，
须是日辰旺相，
透出用爻，
方不畏，
亦费力中得
yi: 用财忌讳兄弟持世，
须是日辰旺相，
让用爻透出来，
才不用怕，
也是费了力气才得。
en: For Wealth as the Subject, Peer holding the Self is to be avoided;
the Day must be thriving,
letting the Subject line show,
and only then is there nothing to fear,
and even then it is gained by effort.

zh: 用财旺相，
伏动要生世。
yi: 用财旺相，
无论伏着还是动着，都要生世。
en: For Wealth as the Subject thriving,
whether hidden or moving, it must generate the Self.

title: 官用取官，私用取财：占买卖、家事、奴婢、求财、婚姻，都看财爻

rule.yi: 公家的事用官爻，私人的事用财爻；占买卖钱财、家里的事、奴婢的事、求财的事、婚姻的事，这些都看财爻。
rule.en: For public matters take the Pressure line and for private matters take the Wealth line; for buying and selling, household affairs, servants, seeking wealth and marriage, look in every case at the Wealth line.

note.yi: 这一行前半说的是占病、占失物、求官、官司、占婚问夫，都看官爻；婚姻在两边都出现，问夫看官爻、问妻看财爻。
note.en: The first half of the line says that for illness, lost things, seeking office, lawsuits and asking about a husband one looks at the Pressure line; marriage appears on both sides, the Pressure line for a husband and the Wealth line for a wife.

zh: 阴阳男女，次第推排；
官用取官，
私用取财。
yi: 阴阳男女，依次推排；
公家的事，用官爻；
私人的事，用财。
en: Yin and yang, man and woman, are laid out in order;
for public matters, take the Pressure line;
for private matters, take Wealth.

zh: 占买卖财，占家事，占奴婢事，占求财事，占婚姻事，
以上皆看财爻。
yi: 占买卖钱财，占家里的事，占奴婢的事，占求财的事，占婚姻的事，
以上这些都看财爻。
en: Divining buying and selling, household affairs, servants, seeking wealth, and marriage:
in all of these look at the Wealth line.

hits.text: 占买卖财，占家事，占婚婢事，占求财事，占婚姻事

title: 妻财类：不伏鬼下，乘旺独发，三分得一

rule.yi: 财爻不伏在鬼下，乘着旺相独自发动，所求的钱财三分能得一分。
rule.en: A Wealth line not hidden under Pressure, riding a thriving state and moving alone, gains one part in three of the money sought.

note.yi: 这是书里「妻财类」标题下的小注。「三分得一」书里没有解释，可能指所求的钱得到三分之一；这里照字译。
note.en: This is the small note under the heading for the Wealth class. 'One part in three' is not explained in the book and may mean that a third of the money sought is gained; it is translated literally.

zh: （为财爻，
不伏鬼下，
乘旺独发，
三分得一）
yi: （这是财爻，
不伏在鬼下，
乘着旺相独自发动，
三分能得一分。）
en: (This is the Wealth line;
if it is not hidden under Pressure,
riding a thriving state and moving alone,
one part in three is gained.)

title: 来情·冲克妻财爻：所问多是是非、占财、铺店丝绵买物，或阴人和合事，金银铜铁器交易

rule.yi: 看来意：妻财爻被冲克，所问的多是是非、占财、开铺店、丝绵、买东西，也可能是有女人参与的合作事，或者金银铜铁器的交易。
rule.en: To tell what the visit is about: when the Wealth line is clashed or controlled, the matter asked is often disputes, wealth, shops, silk floss and buying things, and it may be a partnership involving a woman, or a trade in gold, silver, copper and iron ware.

note.yi: 「冲克即是非占财」这一句读法不定：可读作「冲克即是：是非、占财」，这里就是这样译的；但《海底眼》同一句作「冲妻即是系占财」（见 HDY.13），意思是「关系到占财」，那样读更顺。「非」和「系」哪一个是原字，书里没有别的证据，本库不改原文，也不裁。「阴人」原指女子，「和合事」指结合、合作的事，这里译得宽。
note.en: How to read 'a clash or control is disputes and divining wealth' is not settled: it can be read as a list, which is how it is translated here; but the Haidi Yan has the same line as 'a clash on Wealth is tied to divining wealth' (see HDY.13), which reads more smoothly. The books give no further evidence about whether 'disputes' or 'tied to' is the original character, and this library neither changes the original nor decides. 'A yin person' means a woman and 'union' is rendered loosely as a joint matter.

zh: 冲克妻财爻：
冲克即是非占财，
铺店丝绵买物来，
或有阴人和合事，
金银铜铁器和交。
yi: 冲克妻财爻：
冲克它，就是：是非、占财，
铺店、丝绵、买东西的事，
或者有女人参与的合作事，
金银铜铁器的交易。
en: The Wealth line clashed or controlled:
a clash or control means: disputes, and divining wealth,
shops, silk floss, the buying of things,
or a joint matter involving a woman,
the trading of gold, silver, copper and iron ware.

title: 期日章·求财：财从长生到帝旺，再加墓库同归；空手求财看鬼爻同断；博戏看生旺

rule.yi: 求财的应期：财爻从长生到帝旺的时候，再加上墓库、同归的时候；空手求财，鬼爻也照这样断；博戏，看生旺也是这样推。
rule.en: The date for wealth: from Long Life to Emperor's Prime, and in addition the times of the tomb and of returning together; for seeking wealth with empty hands, judge the Pressure line the same way; for gambling, the thriving state is reckoned in the same way.

note.yi: 「同归」书里没有解释，这里照字译。这首歌诀后面还有行人、病、失物、婚姻、求官、官司、阴宅、药、天时各条，属于别的问题域。原文里的（1）是整理本给今人注文编的号。
note.en: 'Returning together' is not explained in the book and is translated literally. The verse goes on with travellers, illness, lost things, marriage, seeking office, lawsuits, graves, medicine and weather, which belong to other domains. The (1) in the Chinese is a number the transcription gave to a modern note.

zh: 求财长生至帝旺，
更加墓库及同归，
空手鬼爻同此断，
博戏生旺亦同推（1）。
yi: 求财，（财爻）从长生到帝旺，
再加上墓库和同归的时候；
空手求财，鬼爻也照这样断；
博戏，看生旺也这样推。
en: For wealth, [Wealth] from Long Life through to Emperor's Prime,
and in addition the times of the tomb and of returning together;
for seeking wealth with empty hands, the Pressure line is judged the same way;
for gambling, the thriving state is reckoned in the same way.

title: 六神临财：朱雀有弊、白虎损病忧、玄武忧盗贼、青龙吉庆、螣蛇损失、勾陈勾留

rule.yi: 六神临在财爻上：朱雀有弊，白虎主损失、生病、忧愁，玄武要忧盗贼，青龙就是吉庆，螣蛇主损失，勾陈遇上羁留、不是争财就是互相嫉妒。
rule.en: The six spirits on the Wealth line: the Vermilion Bird is a defect, the White Tiger brings loss, illness and worry, the Dark Tortoise means fear of thieves, the Azure Dragon is auspicious and joyful, the Coiling Snake means loss, and Hook Earth meets detention, being either a fight over money or mutual jealousy.

note.yi: 「非论」两字含义不明，可能是「不必说」，也可能是「不只是」；这里译作「不用多说」，不确定。「鰧」是「螣」的异体。
note.en: The two words 'fei lun' are unclear: they may mean 'need not be argued' or 'not only'; they are rendered as 'no need to argue', without certainty. The character in 'Coiling Snake' is a variant form.

zh: 非论朱雀临财弊，
白虎临财损病忧，
玄武临财忧盗贼，
青龙临财即吉庆，
鰧蛇临财主损失，
勾陈临财遇勾留，
若不争财相嫉妒。
但能如此与人占，
万事吉凶无一失。
yi: 不用多说，朱雀临在财上有弊，
白虎临在财上，主损失、生病、忧愁，
玄武临在财上，忧盗贼，
青龙临在财上就是吉庆，
螣蛇临在财上，主损失，
勾陈临在财上，遇上羁留，
如果不是争财，就是互相嫉妒。
只要能这样给人占卦，
万事吉凶都不会有一点差错。
en: No need to argue: the Vermilion Bird on Wealth is a defect;
the White Tiger on Wealth brings loss, illness and worry;
the Dark Tortoise on Wealth, worry over thieves;
the Azure Dragon on Wealth is at once auspicious and joyful;
the Coiling Snake on Wealth means loss;
Hook Earth on Wealth meets detention;
if it is not a fight over money, it is mutual jealousy.
One who can divine for people this way
will make no mistake about the fortune of any matter.

title: 青龙临财：交易田地不须疑；青龙进钱财，出入求财当大获

rule.yi: 青龙与卦身、应爻相合，临在财爻上，交易田地不用怀疑；青龙主进钱财，出门入门求财该有大收获。
rule.en: With the Azure Dragon combining with the Body and the Other and sitting on the Wealth line, buying and selling land need not be doubted; the Azure Dragon brings in money, and going out and coming in to seek wealth there should be a great haul.

zh: 青龙入水身应合，
必定求官事事宜，
若临财爻妻有孕，
交易田地不须疑。
yi: 青龙落在水爻上，和卦身、应相合，
求官必定事事相宜；
如果临在财爻上，妻子有孕，
交易田地不必怀疑。
en: The Azure Dragon entering a Water line, combining with the Body and the Other:
in seeking office everything is sure to be fitting;
if it sits on the Wealth line, the wife is with child,
and buying and selling land need not be doubted.

zh: 青龙进钱财，
住宅婚姻进口来，
出入求财当大获，
造作添修不入灾。
yi: 青龙主进钱财，
住宅、婚姻，人口物件都进来；
出门入门求财，该有大收获；
建造修缮不遇灾。
en: The Azure Dragon brings in money;
for house and marriage, people and goods come in;
going out and coming in to seek wealth, there should be a great haul;
building and repairs meet no calamity.

title: 玄武临财：贼来到、口舌烦恼，退失是寻常；玄武入火终失资财；值金有财须外得

rule.yi: 玄武临在财上，盗贼要来、口舌烦恼，须要防备，损失是常事；玄武落在火爻上，终究失掉资财；落在金爻上有财，要在外面得，否则是人送来、盗贼拿走。
rule.en: The Dark Tortoise on Wealth: thieves arrive and quarrels and trouble come, and one must guard, since loss is common; the Dark Tortoise entering Fire ends in losing one's property; entering Metal, if there is money it must be gained outside, otherwise it is delivered by people and taken by thieves.

note.yi: 「牛猪空亡玄武当」等句是说六畜，本库不收。「人送盗将来」的确切意思不明，这里译作「人送来、盗贼拿走」，不确定。
note.en: The lines about oxen and pigs falling Void under the Dark Tortoise concern livestock and are not included here. The exact sense of 'people deliver, thieves bring it away' is unclear and is rendered loosely.

zh: 玄武本来失财位，
奸淫口舌起。
yi: 玄武本来就是失财的位置，
奸淫、口舌由此而起。
en: The Dark Tortoise is by nature the place of losing wealth,
and lewdness and quarrels arise from it.

zh: 玄武临财贼来到，
口舌欲烦恼。
玄武临财须用防，
退失是寻常。
yi: 玄武临在财上，贼来到，
口舌、烦恼将至；
玄武临在财上要用心防备，
损失是寻常的事。
en: The Dark Tortoise on Wealth, thieves arrive,
and quarrels and trouble are coming;
the Dark Tortoise on Wealth must be guarded against,
for loss is common.

zh: 玄武入水忧贼寇，
入火终是失资财。
yi: 玄武落在水爻上，忧盗贼；
落在火爻上，终究失掉资财。
en: The Dark Tortoise entering Water: fear of bandits;
entering Fire, one ends by losing property.

zh: 值金有财须外得，
不然人送盗将来。
yi: 落在金爻上有财，要在外面得；
不然是人送来、盗贼拿走。
en: Entering Metal, if there is money it must be gained outside;
otherwise it is delivered by people and taken away by thieves.

title: 螣蛇临外财：在外州做买卖后回来

rule.yi: 螣蛇临在外面的财上，是到外州去做买卖再回来。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake sitting on an outer Wealth means going to another prefecture to trade and then returning.

note.yi: 「外财」可指外卦上的财，也可指外地的财；书里没有分开，这里译作「外面的财」。
note.en: 'Outer Wealth' can mean the Wealth in the outer trigram or money from outside; the book does not distinguish, and it is rendered 'outer Wealth'.

zh: 若见鰧蛇临外财，
经纪外州回。
yi: 如果见到螣蛇临在外面的财上，
是到外州做买卖后回来。
en: If the Coiling Snake is seen on an outer Wealth,
it means going to another prefecture to trade, and returning.

title: 父母发动克子孙，买卖劳心利不存；父化财，交易利

rule.yi: 父母爻发动克子孙，做买卖劳心费力、利钱留不住；父母化成财，交易有利，只是家里长辈不安宁、求人办事不顺。
rule.en: Resource moving and controlling Output means that in trade one wears out the mind and no profit remains; Resource changing into Wealth, dealing profits, though the elders of the house are uneasy and seeking help goes badly.

note.yi: 这首七言歌诀把病、婚姻、考试、行人、官司、失物等一并说完，本库整首收下，求财只在其中一两句；书里的今人[译文]不引。
note.en: This seven-character verse covers illness, marriage, exams, travellers, lawsuits and lost things together; this library takes the whole verse, of which only a line or two concerns wealth, and does not cite the modern translation printed after it.

zh: 父动当头克子孙，
病人无药主沉昏；
婚姻子息应难得，
买卖劳心利不存。
yi: 父母爻发动，当头克子孙，
病人没有药可用，昏沉不醒；
婚姻、子嗣难得；
做买卖，劳心费力，没有利。
en: Resource moving and squarely controlling Output:
the sick have no medicine and sink into stupor;
marriage and offspring are hard to get;
in trade one wears out the mind and no profit remains.

zh: 父化财兮交易利，
家长不宁求事拙。
yi: 父母化成财，交易有利；
家里长辈不安宁，求人办事不顺。
en: Resource changing into Wealth, dealing profits;
the elders of the house are uneasy and seeking help goes badly.

title: 子孙发动伤官鬼，行人买卖身康泰；子化财宜守旧，托人办事人心不一

rule.yi: 子孙发动，伤克官鬼，出门的人和做买卖的人都平安康泰；子孙化成财，宜于守旧，托人办事，对方心不在一处。
rule.en: Output moving and harming Pressure leaves the traveller and the trader safe and well; Output changing into Wealth suits keeping to the old, and if one entrusts a favour, the other is not of one mind.

note.yi: 这首七言歌诀把病、婚姻、考试、行人、官司、失物等一并说完，本库整首收下，求财只在其中一两句；书里的今人[译文]不引。
note.en: This seven-character verse covers illness, marriage, exams, travellers, lawsuits and lost things together; this library takes the whole verse, of which only a line or two concerns wealth, and does not cite the modern translation printed after it.

zh: 子孙发动伤官鬼，
占病求医身便痊；
行人买卖身康泰，
婚姻喜美是姻缘。
yi: 子孙发动，伤克官鬼，
占病求医，身体就痊愈；
出门的人和做买卖的人，平安康泰；
婚姻喜庆美满，是好姻缘。
en: Output moving and harming Pressure:
in divining illness and seeking a doctor, the body is cured;
the traveller and the trader are safe and well;
a marriage is happy and fair, a good match.

zh: 子化财兮宜守旧，
托用人情不一心。
yi: 子孙化成财，宜于守旧；
托人办事，对方心不在一处。
en: Output changing into Wealth suits keeping to the old;
entrusting a favour, the other is not of one mind.

title: 财爻发动，买卖交官财吉利；财化子好望财，财化兄财少成

rule.yi: 财爻发动，克文书，应试求官都落空，做买卖、结交官府对财有利；财化成子孙有望得财，化成兄弟钱财少成、熟人之间要避嫌；财化成官鬼要防走失，化成文书办事和谐。
rule.en: The Wealth line moving and controlling documents: exams and office come to nothing, but trading and dealing with officials favour the money; Wealth changing into Output gives hope of gaining money, into Peer little money is made and with acquaintances one should avoid suspicion; into Pressure guard against loss, into Resource matters go smoothly.

note.yi: 这首七言歌诀把病、婚姻、考试、行人、官司、失物等一并说完，本库整首收下，求财只在其中一两句；书里的今人[译文]不引。
note.en: This seven-character verse covers illness, marriage, exams, travellers, lawsuits and lost things together; this library takes the whole verse, of which only a line or two concerns wealth, and does not cite the modern translation printed after it.

zh: 财爻发动克文书，
应举求官总是虚；
买卖交官财吉利，
亲姻如意乐无虞。
yi: 财爻发动，克父母文书，
应试求官，总是落空；
做买卖、结交官府，对财有利；
婚姻亲事如意，快乐无忧。
en: The Wealth line moving and controlling the document line:
sitting exams and seeking office always come to nothing;
trading and dealing with officials favour the money;
marriages and family ties go as wished, glad and free of worry.

zh: 财化子兮好望财，
财化财兮妇主灾；
财化官兮防走失，
财化文书用可谐。
财化兄兮财少成，
相知脱嫌勿交亲；
yi: 财化成子孙，有望得财；
财化成财，妇人有灾；
财化成官，要防走失；
财化成文书，办事可以和谐；
财化成兄弟，钱财少成；
熟识的人之间，要避嫌，不要走得太近；
en: Wealth changing into Output, there is hope of gaining money;
Wealth changing into Wealth, the woman meets calamity;
Wealth changing into Pressure, guard against loss and straying;
Wealth changing into Resource, what is needed goes smoothly;
Wealth changing into Peer, little money is made;
among acquaintances, avoid suspicion and do not grow too close;

title: 兄弟发动克财，货物经商消折本；兄化兄家不足，兄化财财反复

rule.yi: 兄弟发动，克了财，货物、经商亏本，官司和暗中的盗贼耗损钱财；兄弟化成兄弟，家里钱不足；兄弟化成财，钱财反复。
rule.en: Peer moving and controlling Wealth means that goods and trade lose capital and lawsuits and secret thieves waste money; Peer changing into Peer, the household is short; Peer changing into Wealth, the money comes and goes.

note.yi: 这首七言歌诀把病、婚姻、考试、行人、官司、失物等一并说完，本库整首收下，求财只在其中一两句；书里的今人[译文]不引。
note.en: This seven-character verse covers illness, marriage, exams, travellers, lawsuits and lost things together; this library takes the whole verse, of which only a line or two concerns wealth, and does not cite the modern translation printed after it.

zh: 兄弟交重克了财，
病人难愈未离灾；
应举雷同为大忌，
官非阴贼耗钱财。
若带吉神为有助，
出路行人尚未来；
货物经商消折本，
买婢求妻事不谐。
yi: 兄弟发动，克了财，
病人难好，灾还没有走；
应考遇到雷同，是大忌；
官司和暗中的盗贼，耗损钱财。
如果带着吉神，就有帮助；
出门在外的人还没有回来；
货物、经商，亏了本；
买婢女、求妻，事不和谐。
en: Peer moving and controlling Wealth:
the sick are hard to cure and the calamity has not left;
in an exam, meeting the same rivals is a great taboo;
lawsuits and secret thieves waste money.
if it carries an auspicious spirit, there is help;
the traveller on the road has not yet come home;
goods and trade lose capital;
buying a maid or seeking a wife does not go smoothly.

zh: 兄化兄兮家不足，
兄化财兮财反复；
yi: 兄弟化成兄弟，家里钱不足；
兄弟化成财，钱财反复。
en: Peer changing into Peer, the household is short;
Peer changing into Wealth, the money comes and goes.

title: 官鬼发动克兄弟，买卖财轻赌博输；官化财，财自得，赌博抽拈却输

rule.yi: 官鬼发动克兄弟，做买卖财利微薄，赌博输；官鬼化成财，钱财自己到手，但赌博、抽拈反而输。
rule.en: Pressure moving and controlling Peer means that trade brings slight profit and gambling loses; Pressure changing into Wealth, the money comes of itself, but gambling and drawing lots lose all the same.

note.yi: 这首七言歌诀把病、婚姻、考试、行人、官司、失物等一并说完，本库整首收下，求财只在其中一两句；书里的今人[译文]不引。
note.en: This seven-character verse covers illness, marriage, exams, travellers, lawsuits and lost things together; this library takes the whole verse, of which only a line or two concerns wealth, and does not cite the modern translation printed after it.

zh: 官鬼发动克兄弟，
婚姻未就生滞疑；
病困门庭祸祟来，
更改动身皆不吉。
出外逃亡定见灾，
词讼官非有囚系；
买卖财轻赌博输，
失物难寻多暗昧。
yi: 官鬼发动，克兄弟，
婚姻还没成，生出停滞和疑虑；
家里病困，灾祸作祟；
改动、动身，都不吉；
出外、逃亡，一定遇灾；
打官司，有被拘禁的事；
做买卖财利微薄，赌博输；
失物难找，多是暗昧不明。
en: Pressure moving and controlling Peer:
a marriage not yet made meets delay and doubt;
illness besets the household and misfortune haunts it;
changing plans or setting out are both inauspicious;
going abroad or fleeing surely meets calamity;
a lawsuit brings confinement;
in trade the profit is slight, and in gambling one loses;
lost things are hard to find and mostly obscure.

zh: 官化财兮财自得，
赌博抽拈却主输；
yi: 官鬼化成财，钱财自然到手；
赌博、抽拈，却主输。
en: Pressure changing into Wealth, the money comes of itself;
gambling and drawing lots, however, lose.

title: 六畜爻位：初爻鸡鸭，二爻猫犬；遇青龙旺盛，加白虎两难全

rule.yi: 六畜里，鸡鸭在初爻，猫犬在二爻；遇到青龙就四季旺盛，加上白虎就鸡鸭猫犬两样难保全。注：初爻带鬼或落空亡，难养鸡鸭，加大小耗有狐狸黄鼠伤害，临青龙大吉；二爻的猫犬，寅动克戌是虎伤犬，戌克二爻是犬伤猫，猫爻带吉煞善捕鼠，带鬼煞家有恶犬，逢空不利，加白虎必有伤，带青龙必旺相。
rule.en: Among the six kinds of livestock, chickens and ducks are on the first line and cats and dogs on the second; meeting the Azure Dragon they thrive through the four seasons, and with the White Tiger added the two cannot both be kept. The commentary adds: the first line with Pressure or Void makes chickens and ducks hard to keep, with the Great and Small Waste stars foxes and weasels hurt them, and on the Azure Dragon it is greatly auspicious; for cats and dogs on the second line, Yin moving against Xu is the tiger hurting the dog, Xu controlling the second line is the dog hurting the cat, a cat line with an auspicious star catches rats well, with Pressure and a baleful star the house has a fierce dog, falling Void is bad, with the White Tiger added there is surely harm, and with the Azure Dragon added it surely thrives.

note.yi: 第一段是《天玄赋》的歌诀，第二段是紧接着的括号小注（《断易天机》这一节里没有另外标注者）。「寅爻旁动克戌爻」是说寅木克土（戌）；「杀带鬼」原文如此。
note.en: The first passage is the verse of the Tianxuan Fu and the second the bracketed small note that follows it (this section of the Duanyi Tianji names no other author). 'Yin moving beside Xu' is Wood controlling Earth; 'a baleful star carrying Pressure' is the original wording.

zh: 鸡鸭原在初爻，
遇青龙则四时旺盛，
猫犬端居二位，
加白虎则两件难全。
yi: 鸡鸭原本在初爻，
遇到青龙，就四季旺盛；
猫犬居在二爻，
加上白虎，两样都难保全。
en: Chickens and ducks are originally on the first line;
meeting the Azure Dragon, they thrive through the four seasons;
cats and dogs sit on the second line;
with the White Tiger added, the two cannot both be kept.

zh: （初爻鸡鸭位。
带鬼或空亡，难为鸡鸭。
加大小耗，必有狐狸黄鼠所伤。
若临青龙，大吉。
二爻为猫犬。
寅爻旁动克戌爻，虎伤犬。
戌爻克二爻，犬伤猫。
猫爻若加吉杀，必善捕鼠。
杀带鬼，家有恶犬。
逢空不利，
旺空有犬无猫，有猫无犬，不能两全。
加白虎必然有伤，带青龙必然旺相。
yi: （初爻是鸡鸭的位置。
带鬼或者落空亡，难养鸡鸭；
加大耗、小耗，必有狐狸、黄鼠狼伤害；
如果临青龙，大吉。
二爻是猫犬。
寅爻在旁边动，克戌爻，是虎伤犬；
戌爻克二爻，是犬伤猫。
猫爻如果加吉煞，一定善于捕鼠；
煞带着鬼，家里有恶犬。
逢空不利，
旺相而空的，有犬无猫，有猫无犬，不能两全。
加白虎，必定有伤；带青龙，必定旺相。
en: (The first line is the place of chickens and ducks.
With Pressure or Void, chickens and ducks are hard to keep;
with the Great or Small Waste stars, foxes and weasels will surely hurt them;
if it sits on the Azure Dragon, greatly auspicious.
The second line is cats and dogs.
Yin moving beside and controlling Xu is the tiger hurting the dog;
Xu controlling the second line is the dog hurting the cat.
A cat line with an auspicious star will surely catch rats well;
with a baleful star carrying Pressure, the house has a fierce dog.
Falling Void is bad;
thriving but Void, there is a dog and no cat, or a cat and no dog, and not both.
With the White Tiger added there is surely harm; with the Azure Dragon it surely thrives.

title: 三四爻猪羊怕官杀兄弟；五六爻牛马喜福德妻财；各爻带什么看盈亏

rule.yi: 三爻猪、四爻羊，怕见官杀、兄弟；五爻牛、六爻马，喜遇福德、妻财。注：猪带子孙妻财必旺，带兄弟不长，带官逢空有损；羊带财福旺，带鬼杀损失，逢空无羊；牛带子孙有子母牛，遇青龙财福吉，遇鬼杀白虎凶；驴马一爻照牛爻断。
rule.en: The third line is the pig and the fourth the sheep, which fear Pressure, baleful stars and Peer; the fifth is the ox and the sixth the horse, which like Output and Wealth. The commentary adds: a pig with Output or Wealth thrives, with Peer does not grow, with Pressure and Void suffers loss; a sheep with Wealth or Output thrives, with Pressure or baleful stars suffers loss, falling Void there is no sheep; an ox with Output has cow and calf, is auspicious with the Azure Dragon, Wealth or Output, and ominous with Pressure, baleful stars or the White Tiger; the last line for donkey and horse is judged like the ox line.

note.yi: 第一段是《天玄赋》的歌诀，第二段是紧接着的括号小注。「胎养临爻」的「胎」「养」是长生十二宫里的胎、养两位。「子日冲午爻」是子冲午。
note.en: The first passage is the verse of the Tianxuan Fu and the second the bracketed small note that follows it. 'Womb' and 'Nurture' are two of the twelve stages of the life cycle. 'A Zi day clashing the Wu line' is Zi clashing Wu.

zh: 三四猪羊，
怕见官杀兄弟；
五六牛马，
喜逢福德妻财。
yi: 三爻猪、四爻羊，
怕遇上官杀、兄弟；
五爻牛、六爻马，
喜欢遇上福德、妻财。
en: The third and fourth lines are the pig and the sheep,
which fear meeting Pressure, baleful stars and Peer;
the fifth and sixth lines are the ox and the horse,
which like to meet Output and Wealth.

zh: （三爻为猪。
带子孙妻财，必旺。
带兄弟，猪不长。
带官逢空，猪有损失。
带子孙胎爻，其家猪有胎。
若见申酉二爻动，或克三爻，猪决有损失。
四爻为羊。
带财福则旺，带鬼杀则损失，逢空无羊。
胎养临爻则羊母旺，劫杀临爻则羯羊多。
朱雀临大杀，在兑宫、乾宫动，羊生臊口。
遇青龙动则吉，白虎动则凶。
五爻为牛。
带子孙，其家有子母牛，
带胎爻，其家牛有胎。
凡遇青龙财福则吉，鬼杀白虎则凶。
青龙临爻，多是水牛。
勾陈螣蛇，多是黄牛。
若五爻带金鬼，主牛夜啼。
水鬼败肚，
木鬼脚痛，
火鬼因触热，土鬼时气发瘴。
兄弟化兄弟，与人相合牛只。
旺相墓库老牛，胎养小牛。
六爻为驴马。
带财福则吉，带鬼杀则凶。
如子日冲午爻，主走热饮水，火动则无妨。
此一爻依牛爻断之。
yi: （三爻是猪。
带子孙、妻财，一定旺；
带兄弟，猪不长；
带官又逢空，猪有损失；
带子孙、胎爻，家里的猪有胎；
如果见到申、酉二爻发动，或者克三爻，猪一定有损失。
四爻是羊。
带财福就旺，带鬼杀就损失，逢空就没有羊；
胎养临爻，母羊旺；劫杀临爻，羯羊多；
朱雀临大杀，在兑宫、乾宫动，羊生臊口；
遇青龙动吉，白虎动凶。
五爻是牛。
带子孙，家里有母牛带小牛；
带胎爻，家里的牛有胎；
凡遇青龙、财福就吉，鬼杀、白虎就凶。
青龙临爻，多是水牛；
勾陈、螣蛇，多是黄牛；
如果五爻带金鬼，牛夜里叫；
水鬼，肚子败坏；
木鬼，脚疼；
火鬼，是因为中了暑热；土鬼，时气发瘴。
兄弟化成兄弟，是和别人合养的牛；
旺相墓库是老牛，胎养是小牛。
六爻是驴马。
带财福吉，带鬼杀凶；
如果子日冲午爻，主走热了要饮水，火动就无妨。
这一爻照牛爻来断。
en: (The third line is the pig.
With Output and Wealth it surely thrives;
with Peer, the pig does not grow;
with Pressure and Void, the pig suffers loss;
with Output and the womb line, the household's sow is in young;
if the Shen or You line moves, or controls the third line, the pig surely suffers loss.
The fourth line is the sheep.
With Wealth or Output it thrives, with Pressure or baleful stars it suffers loss, and falling Void there is no sheep;
with Womb or Nurture on the line the ewes thrive, with the Robbery star on the line the wethers are many;
the Vermilion Bird on a great baleful star, moving in the Dui or Qian palace, the sheep get sores in the mouth;
meeting the Azure Dragon moving is auspicious, the White Tiger moving is ominous.
The fifth line is the ox.
With Output, the household has a cow with her calf;
with the womb line, the household's cow is in calf;
meeting the Azure Dragon, Wealth or Output is auspicious, meeting Pressure, baleful stars or the White Tiger is ominous.
The Azure Dragon on the line, mostly water buffalo;
Hook Earth or the Coiling Snake, mostly yellow oxen;
if the fifth line carries a Metal Pressure, the ox bellows at night;
with Water Pressure, the belly is spoiled;
with Wood Pressure, the foot aches;
with Fire Pressure, from heat; with Earth Pressure, the season's miasma breaks out.
Peer changing into Peer, it is an ox kept jointly with another;
thriving or in the tomb it is an old ox, at Womb or Nurture a young one.
The sixth line is donkey and horse.
With Wealth or Output it is auspicious, with Pressure or baleful stars ominous;
if a Zi day clashes the Wu line, it has run hot and wants water, and if Fire moves there is no harm.
This line is judged like the ox line.

title: 最嫌本命逢冲，须忌分宫受克；六畜本命：丑牛、寅虎（作猫）、午马、未羊、酉鸡、戌犬、亥猪

rule.yi: 最怕的是六畜的本命爻逢冲，也忌分宫爻受克。注：丑爻是牛，寅爻是虎（也当猫爻断），午马、未羊、酉鸡、戌犬、亥猪；本命怕遇鬼煞、大小耗相刑相克，也嫌空亡，都主损伤；另一说，初鸡鸭、二猫犬、三猪、四羊、五牛、六马和驴骡，是分宫；本命上卦以分宫为主，吉神来生则吉，凶煞来克则凶，日辰扶持亦吉，日辰刑冲则凶。
rule.en: What is most disliked is the livestock's natal line meeting a clash, and the line of its own palace being controlled. The commentary says: Chou is the ox, Yin the tiger (also judged as the cat line), Wu the horse, Wei the sheep, You the chicken, Xu the dog, Hai the pig; the natal line fears Pressure, baleful stars and the Great and Small Waste stars punishing and controlling it, and dislikes Void, all of which mean damage; another saying gives first chicken and duck, second cat and dog, third pig, fourth sheep, fifth ox, sixth horse, donkey and mule as the palace division; when the natal line is in the hexagram, the palace division is the main thing, an auspicious spirit coming to generate it is auspicious, a baleful one coming to control it is ominous, the Day's support is auspicious and the Day's punishment or clash is ominous.

note.yi: 第一段是《天玄赋》的歌诀，第二段是紧接着的括号小注。「分宫」指六爻各主一种牲畜（初鸡鸭……），「本命」指这种牲畜的生肖地支所在的爻，两者在这段注里并用。
note.en: The first passage is the verse of the Tianxuan Fu and the second the bracketed small note that follows it. 'The palace division' assigns each line to one animal (first line chickens and ducks, and so on) and 'the natal line' is the line at the animal's own branch; the note uses the two side by side.

zh: 最嫌本命逢冲，
须忌分宫受克。
yi: 最嫌的是本命爻逢冲，
也忌分宫的爻受克。
en: What is most disliked is the natal line meeting a clash,
and the line of its own palace being controlled.

zh: （丑爻为牛，寅爻为虎，亦作猫爻断。
午爻为马，未爻为羊，酉爻为鸡，戌爻为犬，亥爻为猪。
以上六畜之本命，怕逢鬼杀、大小耗相刑相克，
又嫌本命空亡，皆主损折狸伤。
一云：
初鸡鸭，二猫犬，三猪，四羊，五牛，六马及驴骡，
以上乃分宫也。
如本命上卦，当看分宫为主。
若吉神动来相生则吉，
凶杀动来克害则凶。
更得日辰扶持亦吉，
若日辰刑冲则凶。
能依此断，万无一失。
yi: （丑爻是牛，寅爻是虎，也当猫爻来断。
午是马，未是羊，酉是鸡，戌是犬，亥是猪。
以上六畜的本命，怕遇上鬼煞、大小耗相刑相克，
又嫌本命空亡，都主损伤折失。
又一种说法：
初爻鸡鸭，二爻猫犬，三爻猪，四爻羊，五爻牛，六爻马以及驴骡，
以上是分宫。
如果本命上了卦，就要以分宫为主。
吉神动来相生就吉，
凶煞动来克害就凶。
再得日辰扶持也吉，
如果日辰刑冲就凶。
能照这样断，万无一失。
en: (Chou is the ox, Yin is the tiger, and is also judged as the cat line.
Wu is the horse, Wei the sheep, You the chicken, Xu the dog, Hai the pig.
The natal lines of these livestock fear meeting Pressure, baleful stars and the Great and Small Waste stars punishing and controlling them,
and dislike the natal line falling Void, all of which mean damage and loss.
Another saying:
first line chickens and ducks, second cats and dogs, third pigs, fourth sheep, fifth oxen, sixth horses, donkeys and mules,
which is the palace division.
If the natal line is in the hexagram, the palace division is the main thing.
An auspicious spirit moving to generate it is auspicious,
a baleful star moving to control and harm it is ominous.
The support of the Day is also auspicious,
and if the Day punishes or clashes it, it is ominous.
One who judges this way will not fail.

title: 命逢生旺当别吉凶；爻值刑冲须分表里：旺处逢冲则损，绝处逢冲则散，空处逢冲则不空

rule.yi: 本命逢生旺，要分吉凶：临财福、旺相则吉，临鬼煞、大小耗则凶，反不如不旺；分宫爻遇刑冲，也要分表里：会财福、青龙逢刑冲则凶，临鬼煞、白虎逢刑冲反吉；旺处逢冲则损，绝处逢冲则散，空处逢冲则不空。
rule.en: When the natal line meets a thriving state one must tell auspicious from ominous: on Wealth or Output and thriving it is auspicious, on Pressure, baleful stars or the Great and Small Waste stars it is ominous and worse than not thriving; when the palace line meets punishment or clash one must tell the outside from the inside: joined with Wealth, Output or the Azure Dragon it is ominous, on Pressure, baleful stars or the White Tiger it is on the contrary auspicious; thriving and clashed it is damaged, severed and clashed it is scattered, Void and clashed it is no longer Void.

note.yi: 第一、三段是《天玄赋》的歌诀，第二、四段是紧接着的括号小注。「表里」书里没有解释，注里的意思是：会财福、青龙的遇刑冲看似吉而实凶，临鬼煞、白虎的遇刑冲看似凶而实吉。
note.en: The first and third passages are verses of the Tianxuan Fu, the second and fourth the bracketed small notes that follow. 'Outside and inside' is not glossed; in the note it means that what joins Wealth, Output or the Azure Dragon looks auspicious but is really ominous when punished or clashed, while what sits on Pressure, baleful stars or the White Tiger looks ominous but is really auspicious.

zh: 命逢生旺，
当别吉凶；
yi: 本命遇到生旺，
要分吉凶；
en: When the natal line meets a thriving state,
one must tell auspicious from ominous;

zh: （生旺若逢本命，本为吉兆，
却看临财福旺相则吉，临鬼杀、大小耗则凶，反不如不旺。
凡吉神扶命，旺处六畜必盛，
若加鬼杀，得是休囚，庶几损折亦轻。
凡本命旺临财福，却加大小杀于其上，
此主孳生虽盛，损失亦多，得失相半之兆。
不可概论，而断其吉凶。
yi: （生旺遇到本命，本来是吉兆，
要看它是不是临财福：旺相就吉，临鬼煞、大小耗就凶，反而不如不旺。
凡是吉神扶持本命，旺的地方六畜必兴盛；
如果加了鬼煞，倒是休囚了好，损伤也轻些。
凡本命旺临财福，却加了大小杀在上面，
这主繁殖虽然兴盛，损失也多，是得失各半的兆头。
不能一概而论，要分别断它的吉凶。
en: (A thriving state meeting the natal line is originally an auspicious sign,
but look at whether it sits on Wealth or Output: thriving it is auspicious, on Pressure, baleful stars or the Great and Small Waste stars it is ominous, worse than not thriving.
Whenever an auspicious spirit supports the natal line, where it thrives the livestock surely flourish;
if Pressure or baleful stars are added, it is better that it be weak, and the loss is lighter.
When the natal line is thriving on Wealth or Output but the Great and Small baleful stars are added upon it,
it means that breeding flourishes but the losses are many, a sign of gain and loss in equal halves.
It cannot be judged all alike, and its good and ill must be told apart.

zh: 爻值刑冲，
须分表里。
yi: 分宫的爻遇到刑冲，
要分表里。
en: When the palace line meets punishment or clash,
one must tell the outside from the inside.

zh: （分宫若日辰刑冲，或动爻刑冲，当有吉凶之辨，表里之分。
凡分宫会财福、青龙，若逢刑冲则凶。
若临鬼杀、白虎，逢刑冲反吉，
必主前虽损失，以后必然旺盛。
大凡旺处逢冲则损，绝处逢冲则散，空处逢冲则不空。
yi: （分宫的爻如果被日辰刑冲，或者被动爻刑冲，就有吉凶之辨、表里之分。
凡分宫会上财福、青龙，如果逢刑冲就凶；
如果临鬼煞、白虎，逢刑冲反而吉，
必定是先前虽有损失，以后一定旺盛。
大凡旺处逢冲就损，绝处逢冲就散，空处逢冲就不空。
en: (If the palace line is punished or clashed by the Day, or by a moving line, there is a distinction of good and ill and of outside and inside.
When the palace line joins Wealth, Output or the Azure Dragon, meeting punishment or clash is ominous;
when it sits on Pressure, baleful stars or the White Tiger, meeting punishment or clash is on the contrary auspicious,
and surely, though there was loss before, later it will surely flourish.
In general, a thriving line meeting a clash is damaged, a severed one meeting a clash is scattered, and a Void one meeting a clash is no longer Void.

title: 洞林秘诀·六畜：以生肖和财鬼推；有财之卦畜财旺，无财六畜衰，忌刀砧

rule.yi: 六畜牛马看生肖，以财爻、鬼爻推；生肖看哪一爻动：初爻鸡鸭，二爻犬猫，三爻猪，四爻羊，五爻牛，六爻马；从卦上看，乾震是马，巽是鸡，离是雉，兑是羊，艮是狗，坤是牛，离也兼牛，坎是猪；有财的卦畜财旺，无财六畜衰；占畜忌刀砧卦，离是屠杀，乾坤也主破散。
rule.en: For cattle and horses look at the animal's sign and judge by the Wealth and Pressure lines; the sign is found by which line moves: first line chickens and ducks, second dogs and cats, third pigs, fourth sheep, fifth oxen, sixth horses; by trigram, Qian and Zhen are horses, Xun is the chicken, Li the pheasant, Dui the sheep, Gen the dog, Kun the ox with Li also sharing it, Kan the pig; a hexagram with Wealth means the herd prospers, without Wealth the livestock decline; in divining livestock avoid the Knife-and-Block hexagram, since Li means slaughter and Qian and Kun also mean breaking up.

note.yi: 原文最后的（1）是整理本给今人注文编的号，那段注（刀砧：春亥子，夏寅卯……）本库不引。「以远先推乾震马」的「以远」含义不明，这里译作「从卦上说」，不确定；「刀砧」在书里指金在木上（刀在砧上）等，见断易天机今人注，本库不引。
note.en: The (1) at the end of the Chinese is a number the transcription gave to a modern note (on the Knife-and-Block hexagram: spring Hai and Zi, summer Yin and Mao, and so on), which this library does not cite. The words 'yi yuan' in the fourth couplet are unclear and are rendered loosely as 'by trigram', without certainty.

zh: 六畜牛马生肖奇，为财为鬼便推之，
生肖要看哪爻动，初爻鸡鸭二犬猫。
三猪四羊五牛地，六爻为马可推之，
以远先推乾震马，鸡居巽卦雉居离。
兑卦为羊艮为狗，坤卦为牛离兼之，
坎为豚豕看财鬼，若值无财绝不宜。
有财之卦畜财旺，卦若无财六畜衰，
占畜忌逢刀砧卦，刀居砧上不通医。
离为屠杀归铛镬，乾坤亦主破分离，
更加六神时下看，占畜余皆仿此推（1）。
yi: 六畜牛马看生肖，为财为鬼便可推断；
生肖要看哪一爻动，初爻鸡鸭，二爻犬猫，
三爻猪，四爻羊，五爻牛，六爻马，都可以这样推；
从远处说，先推乾、震是马，巽卦是鸡，离卦是雉；
兑卦是羊，艮卦是狗，坤卦是牛，离也兼着牛；
坎是猪，看财、鬼，如果没有财，就绝不相宜；
有财的卦，畜类的财旺，卦里无财，六畜就衰；
占畜忌遇刀砧卦，刀在砧上，医治不了；
离是屠杀，归到铛镬，乾、坤也主破散分离；
再加上六神、时下来看，占畜其余的都照这样推。
en: For the six kinds of livestock, cattle and horses, look at the animal's sign, and judge by whether it is Wealth or Pressure;
the sign is found by which line moves: the first line chickens and ducks, the second dogs and cats,
the third pigs, the fourth sheep, the fifth oxen, the sixth horses, all judged this way;
by trigram, first Qian and Zhen are horses, Xun is the chicken, Li is the pheasant;
Dui is the sheep, Gen the dog, Kun the ox, and Li shares in the ox;
Kan is the pig, look at Wealth and Pressure, and if there is no Wealth it is in no way fitting;
in a hexagram with Wealth the livestock's wealth thrives, in one without Wealth the livestock decline;
in divining livestock avoid the Knife-and-Block hexagram: with the knife above the block it cannot be cured;
Li is slaughter, ending in the pot and cauldron, and Qian and Kun also mean breaking up and parting;
add to that the six spirits and the present moment, and for the rest divine livestock the same way.

title: 买牛买马只宜财；大怕兄兴鬼发；父摇空费力；子孙发动佳

rule.yi: 买牛买马，只要财爻好；最怕兄弟兴旺、官鬼发动；父母动了是空费力气；子孙发动最好。
rule.en: In buying oxen and horses only Wealth matters; what is most feared is Peer thriving and Pressure moving; Resource moving is wasted effort; Output moving is best.

zh: 买牛买马只宜财，
大怕兄兴鬼发来，
若是父摇空费力，
子孙发动是佳哉。
yi: 买牛买马，只宜有财；
最怕兄弟兴旺、鬼发动；
如果是父母动，是白费力气；
子孙发动，最好。
en: In buying oxen and horses, only Wealth is fitting;
what is most feared is Peer thriving and Pressure moving;
if Resource moves, the effort is wasted;
Output moving is best.

title: 周公断牛马歌：占牛马怕泰卦倒装，夬强，益怕刀，离遭屠，坎入镬，噬嗑颐需咸入鼎，坤艮分散；刀砧分上下，无杀始昌

rule.yi: 占牛马怕得泰卦，坤在上乾在下是倒装；夬卦力强不畏热；益卦怕刀伤；离卦遭屠宰；坎卦重爻入镬汤；噬嗑、颐、需、咸入鼎；坤、艮怕被分散；再看刀砧上下，没有各种煞才昌盛。
rule.en: In divining oxen and horses, fear getting Tai, with Kun above and Qian below, an upside-down placing; Guai is strong and does not fear heat; Yi fears the knife; Li means slaughter; Kan with a doubled line goes into the cauldron; Shi He, Yi, Xu and Xian go into the tripod; fear meeting Kun and Gen and being split up; then tell the Knife and Block above and below, and only with none of the baleful stars does it prosper.

note.yi: 原文里的（1）（2）（3）和一处误排的「（（2）」是整理本给今人注文编的号，那些注文本库不引。「坤腹乾头」是说泰卦是坤上乾下。「离为虚市」的「虚市」字义不明，这里译作「空市」。
note.en: The (1), (2) and (3), and a stray '((2)', in the Chinese are numbers the transcription gave to modern notes, which this library does not cite. 'Kun belly, Qian head' says that in Tai Kun is above and Qian below. The words 'xu shi' are unclear and are rendered 'an empty market'.

zh: 但占牛马泰成殃，
坤腹乾头是倒装（1），
夬是力强宁畏热，
若逢益卦怕刀伤。
离为虚市遭屠杀，
坎卦重爻入镬汤，
噬嗑頥需咸入鼎，
怕逢坤艮被分张（（2）。
更以刀砧分上下，
若无诸杀始为昌（3）。
yi: 占牛马，泰卦成殃，
坤在上是腹、乾在下是头，是倒装；
夬卦力强，不怕热；
如果遇到益卦，怕刀伤。
离卦是空市，遭屠宰；
坎卦重爻，入镬汤；
噬嗑、颐、需、咸，入鼎；
怕遇上坤、艮，被分散。
再用刀砧来分上下，
如果没有各种煞，才昌盛。
en: In divining oxen and horses, Tai brings calamity,
with Kun above as the belly and Qian below as the head, an upside-down placing;
Guai is strong and does not fear heat;
if Yi is met, fear the knife.
Li is an empty market and means slaughter;
Kan with a doubled line goes into the cauldron;
Shi He, Yi, Xu and Xian go into the tripod;
fear meeting Kun and Gen and being split up.
Then tell Knife and Block above and below,
and only if none of the baleful stars is there does it prosper.

title: 姜太公论渔猎：外卦为物内为人；内克外得千斤；物克人无所得；财爻旺相最亨

rule.yi: 占渔猎，外卦是猎物，内卦是人；内卦能克外卦，能得千斤；猎物克人，一无所得；财爻旺相最亨通；打猎宜金，捕鱼宜水；财爻、鬼爻兴旺一定称心；相克哪里还会有；杀鬼交重收获丰厚。
rule.en: In divining fishing and hunting the outer trigram is the quarry and the inner is the person; the inner controlling the outer gains a thousand catties; the quarry controlling the person gains nothing; a thriving Wealth line is most favourable; Metal suits hunting and Water suits fishing; with Wealth and Pressure lines thriving one is sure to be satisfied; if they control each other, how could there be a catch; with the killing and Pressure stars doubled the gain is rich.

note.yi: 原文里的（1）到（6）是整理本给今人注文编的号，那些注文本库不引。「财鬼爻」在原文里连写，读作财爻、鬼爻。「杀鬼交重厚获金」的「杀」指后面说的天罡杀，书里在今人注里才解释，这里只照字译。
note.en: The (1) to (6) in the Chinese are numbers the transcription gave to modern notes, which this library does not cite. 'Wealth and Pressure lines' run together in the original and are read as two lines. The 'killing star' in the last line is explained only in the modern note (the Tiangang star), so it is translated by its words only.

zh: 外卦为物内为人（1），
内能克外得千斤（2），
物若克人无所得（3），
财爻旺相最为亨（4）。
金宜获兽鱼宜水（5），
财鬼爻兴定称心，
若逢相克哪能有，
杀鬼交重厚获金（6）。
yi: 外卦是猎物，内卦是人；
内卦能克外卦，能得千斤；
猎物如果克人，一无所得；
财爻旺相，最为亨通。
打猎宜金，捕鱼宜水；
财爻、鬼爻兴旺，一定称心；
如果相克，哪里还会有收获；
杀与鬼交重发动，收获丰厚。
en: The outer trigram is the quarry and the inner is the person;
the inner able to control the outer gains a thousand catties;
if the quarry controls the person, nothing is gained;
a thriving Wealth line is most favourable.
Metal suits hunting beasts and Water suits fishing;
with Wealth and Pressure lines thriving, one is sure to be satisfied;
if they control each other, how could there be a catch;
with the killing star and Pressure doubled and moving, the gain is rich.

title: 洞林秘诀·渔猎：内卦世爻旺相克外，世克应，得青龙勾陈，吉神临动财爻，无空亡，多得渔猎之财

rule.yi: 内卦的世爻旺相，克外卦，外卦休囚，世爻克应爻，六神又得青龙、勾陈，吉神临在动的财爻上，又没有空亡，主多得财，得渔猎的财物。
rule.en: With the Self line in the inner trigram thriving and controlling the outer, the outer trigram weak, the Self controlling the Other, the six spirits also giving the Azure Dragon and Hook Earth, an auspicious spirit on a moving Wealth line, and no Void, much wealth is gained, the fruits of fishing and hunting.

note.yi: 这一段后面还接着「诗云」和「又云」几段，其中夹着今人的[虎易注]，字句不全，本库只收这一段完整的。
note.en: After this passage come 'the poem says' and 'again it says' passages interleaved with a modern editor's remarks and with gaps in the text; this library takes only this complete passage.

zh: 内卦世爻旺相克他，
外卦休囚，
世爻克应爻，
六神又得青龙、勾陈，
吉神临财爻动，
又无空亡，
主多得财，
得渔猎财物也。
yi: 内卦的世爻旺相，克着对方，
外卦休囚，
世爻克应爻，
六神里又得到青龙、勾陈，
吉神临在动的财爻上，
又没有空亡，
主多得财，
得到渔猎的财物。
en: The Self line in the inner trigram thriving and controlling the other side,
the outer trigram weak,
the Self line controlling the Other line,
the six spirits also giving the Azure Dragon and Hook Earth,
an auspicious spirit on a moving Wealth line,
and no Void:
much wealth is gained,
the fruits of fishing and hunting.

title: 占财：财旺相喜持世，出现有生扶，卖货要用神兴，开张生意得利；最忌空亡临财、飞爻克伏

rule.yi: 占求财：财旺相，喜欢它持世；出现在卦上又有生扶，就掌了权、出了力；卖货求财，用神要兴旺；开张做生意才得利。眉批说：最忌空亡临在财上、伏着的财被飞爻克制，那样只是白费力。
rule.en: Divining for wealth: Wealth thriving is glad to hold the Self; showing in the hexagram and supported, it takes charge and does the work; to sell off goods for money the Subject must thrive; in opening a business there is profit. The marginal comment says: most to be avoided are Void on Wealth and a hidden Wealth controlled by its flying line, where the effort is only wasted.
