凡是碰上旬空、月破，凶；
旺相，生扶卦身，又……（「死世」读不通，下面的解说的是「旺来克世」，疑是「克世」之误）；
金银加倍到手，利润无穷；
财源不断增加，是福德发动的时候；
资本亏伤，是兄弟发动的时候；
父母发动，帮着兄弟去克子孙；
生意有开头，一定没有结果。
en: Seeking profit with capital, Wealth is the Subject;
whenever it meets Void or Month-break, ill;
strong, generating the Body, and also 'dead Self' (probably a slip for 'controlling the Self', as the commentary below reads it);
gold and silver come in double and the profit has no end;
the source of wealth grows when Output moves;
the capital is wounded when Peer moves;
Resource moving helps Peer to control Output;
the business will have a beginning and surely no end.

zh: 将本求财，以财为用，不可空无，
如遇旬空月破，不但无利，本亦亏折。
如若旺来克世者，利息津津。
生世者，财源滚滚。
若得子孙发动，乃生财之神，财如源水流而不竭，
故经云：子动会青龙，乃生财之大道，
若兄动而子不动者，本利俱无，
若父动而兄不动更加白虎，乃在克子孙元神，财无生助，
故经云：父兴临白虎，为绝利之根源也。
yi: 有本钱求财，以财爻为用神，不能落空或没有；
碰上旬空、月破，不但没有利润，本钱也要亏掉。
如果财旺来克世，利息滚滚而来；
生世的，财源滚滚。
如果子孙发动，那是生财的神，财就像源头的水流个不停；
所以经上说：子孙动而会青龙，是生财的大道；
如果兄弟动而子孙不动，本钱和利润都没有；
如果父母动、兄弟不动，再加白虎，那是克伤子孙这个元神，财得不到生助，
所以经上说：父母兴旺而临白虎，是断绝利润的根源。
en: Seeking money with capital, Wealth is the Subject and must not be void or absent;
if it meets Void or Month-break, there is no profit and the capital is lost too.
If a strong Wealth comes to control the Self, the interest flows in;
if it generates the Self, the source of wealth rolls on.
If Output moves, it is the spirit that gives birth to Wealth, and money is like water from a spring that never runs dry;
so the classic says: 'Output moving and meeting the Azure Dragon is the great road to wealth';
if Peer moves and Output does not, neither capital nor profit remains;
if Resource moves and Peer does not, and the White Tiger is added, it controls Output, the Support of Wealth, and Wealth has nothing to feed it,
so the classic says: 'Resource rising on the White Tiger cuts the root of profit.'

title: 空拳问利：以官为主，官旺生合世为大吉；财是元神不可空；子孙动伤官，父母动空拳无害

rule.yi: 空手（没本钱）问利，是九流、工匠、靠手艺吃饭一类人的事：以官爻为主，要旺相并生世、合世，又喜财爻兴旺来扶助，最吉；财爻是官的元神，不能空；子孙发动伤官，用神就没用了；父母发动，空手求财没有妨碍，有本钱的却遭殃。
rule.en: Seeking profit empty-handed is for the trades, craftsmen and people who work for their food: Pressure is the chief; it must be strong and generate or combine with the Self, and it is best of all if a strong Wealth comes to support it; Wealth is the Support of Pressure and must not be void; Output moving hurts Pressure and leaves the Subject useless; Resource moving does the empty-handed no harm but is a curse to those with capital.

zh: 空拳问利宜官旺，
财作元神莫犯空，
反怪子兴来制鬼，
不嫌父母值兴隆。
yi: 空手问利，宜官爻旺相；
财爻是它的元神，不要落空；
反倒要怪子孙兴旺来制住官鬼；
不嫌父母兴旺。
en: Seeking profit empty-handed, Pressure should be strong;
Wealth is its Support and must not fall void;
on the contrary, blame Output rising to hold Pressure in check;
Resource being strong is no objection.

zh: 空拳问利者，九流之辈。
工匠餐食之流，皆名白手求财，
以官为主，须要兴隆生世合世，又喜财爻兴旺而来扶助，此为大吉。
犯忌子孙动，动则伤官，而用无用也。
父母发动，空拳无害，将本为殃。
将本为殃，有资本者遭殃。
yi: 空手问利的，是九流一类的人。
工匠、靠做饭卖吃食过日子的这类人，都叫白手求财，
以官爻为主，要兴旺并且生世、合世，又喜财爻兴旺来扶助，这样最吉。
忌讳子孙发动，一动就伤官，用神就没用了。
父母发动，空手求财没有妨碍，有本钱的却成了祸害。
说「将本为殃」，就是有本钱的人遭殃。
en: Those who seek profit empty-handed are people of the trades.
Craftsmen and people who make their living from food are all said to make money with bare hands;
Pressure is the chief; it must be strong and generate or combine with the Self, and it is a joy if Wealth is strong and comes to support it: this is greatly auspicious.
Output moving is taboo: moving, it hurts Pressure and the Subject becomes useless.
Resource moving does no harm to the empty-handed but is a curse to those with capital.
'A curse to those with capital' means that those who have capital suffer.

title: 衙门：官为用爻，只怕官伤世；再加白虎，有刑罚之忧

rule.yi: 在衙门当差求财：官爻是用爻，旺相为好，只怕官爻伤世；若再加白虎，一定有刑罚之忧。
rule.en: Earning money from a post in a government office: Pressure is the Subject line and should be strong; the only fear is Pressure hurting the Self, and with the White Tiger added there is surely the worry of punishment.

zh: 衙门但怕官伤世，
yi: 衙门里当差，只怕官爻伤世；
en: In a government office, the only fear is Pressure hurting the Self;

zh: 公门之役，
官为用爻但不可伤世，
若加白虎，必有刑之忧。
yi: 在公门当差的，
官爻是用爻，只是不能伤世；
如果再加白虎，一定有刑罚之忧。
en: For those who serve in a government office,
Pressure is the Subject line but must not hurt the Self;
if the White Tiger is added, there is surely the worry of punishment.

title: 店肆：最愁六冲；一冲，顾客聚不拢，货物销不动

rule.yi: 开店做买卖最怕六冲卦：一冲，主顾聚不拢，货物销不动。
rule.en: A shop and its business fear a Six-Clash hexagram above all: with a clash, customers are hard to gather and the goods do not move.

note.yi: 「主雇」在这本书里是主顾、来雇你或买你东西的人。「货物不岂」的「岂」疑是「起」字之误，译作销不动。
note.en: 'Zhu gu' in this book means the patrons who hire you or buy from you. 'The goods do not rise' is written with a character that is probably a slip for 'rise', and is translated as 'do not move'.

zh: 店肆惟愁卦六冲，
yi: 开店的，最愁卦是六冲；
en: For shops, the only worry is a Six-Clash hexagram;

zh: 店肆肄业，切忌六冲，
冲则主雇难聚，货物不岂。
yi: 开店经营，切忌六冲，
一冲，主顾就难聚拢，货物销不动。
en: A shop and its business must above all avoid a Six-Clash;
with a clash, customers are hard to gather and the goods do not move.

title: 走水：官衰无险厄，风浪不险全靠官爻衰

rule.yi: 走江湖水路求利：官爻衰弱就没有险难，风浪不凶险，全靠官爻衰。
rule.en: Seeking profit on rivers and lakes: a weak Pressure means no danger; that the wind and waves are not dangerous depends wholly on Pressure being weak.

zh: 走水官衰无险厄，
yi: 走水路的，官爻衰弱就没有险难；
en: For travel by water, a weak Pressure means no danger;

zh: 若涉江湖而觅利，风波不险全赖官衰。
yi: 如果渡江湖去求利，风浪不凶险，全靠官爻衰弱。
en: If you cross rivers and lakes to seek profit, that the waves are not dangerous depends wholly on Pressure being weak.

title: 祝巫：鬼旺有神通；官旺合真人之应，鬼空则道不通彻

rule.yi: 圆光召将、画符念咒的太保、师巫这类人求财，一定靠官鬼兴旺，灵验才像回声一样快；官旺合真人之应，法术高明；官鬼落空，就没有野祟那样的灵验，道法不通透。
rule.en: For crystal-gazers who summon spirit generals and for the Taibao and shamans who draw talismans and utter spells, everything rests on Pressure being strong, and then the response is as prompt as an echo: a strong Pressure fits the response of a true adept and the art is lofty; with Pressure void there is none of the efficacy of the wild spirits and the art is not fully effective.

note.yi: 「请师来巫水祈延术、蓍龟之卜」一句列举的行当，原文断句不明，这里是照字面拆开译的；「通撤」疑是「通彻」之误。
note.en: The list 'inviting masters, shamans, water prayers, extension arts, milfoil and tortoise divination' is punctuated unclearly in the source and is split literally here; 'not thoroughly effective' translates a phrase whose last character is probably a slip.

zh: 祝巫鬼旺有神通。
yi: 祝巫一类，官鬼旺相就有神通。
en: For priests and shamans, a strong Pressure means spirit power.

zh: 惟有圆光召将、施符设咒太保师巫等类，必仗官兴鬼旺，其应如音。
经云：请师来巫水祈延术、蓍龟之卜，官旺合真人之应，法必高明。
鬼空，无野祟之灵道非通撤。
yi: 只有圆光召将、画符念咒的太保、师巫这一类人，一定要靠官鬼兴旺，灵验才像回声一样快。
经上说：请师、请巫、水中祈祷、延请法术、蓍龟占卜这一类，官爻旺相，才合真人的灵验，法术一定高明；
官鬼落空，就没有野祟那样的灵验，道法不通透。
en: Only for the likes of crystal-gazers who summon spirit generals, and Taibao and shamans who draw talismans and utter spells, everything rests on Pressure being strong, and then the response is as prompt as an echo.
The classic says: for inviting masters, shamans, water prayers, extension arts and milfoil-and-tortoise divination, a strong Pressure fits the response of a true adept, and the art is surely lofty;
with Pressure void, there is none of the efficacy of the wild spirits, and the art is not fully effective.

title: 血财：父母交重克害子孙，牲畜养不大，财利轻

rule.yi: 养六畜这类血财：最怕父母交重去克害子孙，那样牲畜养不大，财利也薄。
rule.en: For living-goods money such as livestock: the great fear is Resource moving to harm Output, and then the animals do not thrive and the profit is small.

zh: 血财更虑文书发，
yi: 血财更担心文书（父母）发动；
en: For living-goods money, the further worry is the document line, Resource, stirring;

zh: 若是收养六畜，
偏怪父母交重而克害子孙者，
则畜不长而财利轻。
yi: 如果是养六畜，
偏怕父母交重去克害子孙的，
那牲畜就养不大，财利也轻。
en: If it is raising livestock,
what is most feared is Resource moving to harm Output;
then the animals do not thrive and the profit is small.

title: 顿货：财爻衰弱才可买进囤置，利反而厚

rule.yi: 囤货：偏偏要财爻衰弱才可以买进，衰的时候买，利润反而更厚。
rule.en: Stocking goods: it is precisely a weak Wealth line that allows buying, and buying when it is weak makes the profit richer.

zh: 顿货财衰利转浓，
yi: 囤货，财衰，利反而更厚；
en: For stocking goods, a weak Wealth makes the profit richer, not poorer;

zh: 顿货偏要财爻衰弱而可置。
yi: 囤货偏偏要财爻衰弱，才可以买进。
en: For stocking goods, it is precisely a weak Wealth line that makes buying possible.

title: 脱物：用爻宜发动，财旺而动最易脱手

rule.yi: 脱手货物：用爻宜发动，最适宜财旺而发动，一动就容易把货泄出去（卖掉）。
rule.en: Selling off goods: the Subject line should move; best is a strong Wealth that moves, for moving it lets the goods flow out easily.

zh: 脱物用爻宜发动，
yi: 脱手货物，用爻宜发动；
en: For selling off goods, the Subject line should move;

zh: 脱货最宜财旺而动则易泄。
yi: 脱货最适宜财旺而发动，一动就容易泄出去。
en: For selling goods, the best is a strong Wealth that moves, for moving it lets the goods flow out easily.

title: 开张：主象不要交重，财爻安静才稳，一动必败或搬走

rule.yi: 开张店业：用神不要交重（发动）；只要财爻安静，如果发动，一定败坏或迁移。
rule.en: Opening a shop: the chief image must not be moving; all that is needed is a still Wealth, and if it moves it will surely fail or have to move away.

zh: 开张主象莫交重。
yi: 开张店铺，主象不要交重。
en: In opening a shop, the chief image should not be moving.

zh: 开张店业，只要财静，
纵若举动必定败移。
yi: 开张店业，只要财爻安静，
如果发动，一定败坏或搬走。
en: In opening a shop, all that is needed is Wealth still;
if it moves, it will surely fail or have to move away.

title: 梨园：不忌官和兄弟；官鬼是用爻，兄弟是伴侣，两个都动才全美

rule.yi: 戏班、走戏、傀儡这类行当：不是一两个人做得了的事，又要有主顾来找；兄弟是他们的伙伴，官鬼是用爻，两个都发动才十全十美，所以说不怕官兴、兄发。
rule.en: For theatre troupes, touring players and puppet shows: it is not work for one or two people and patrons must come to hire them; Peer is their companion and Pressure the Subject line, and only if both move is it perfect, hence the saying that there is no fear of Pressure rising and Peer moving.

zh: 梨园不忌官和弟，
yi: 戏班不忌讳官和兄弟；
en: A theatre troupe does not mind Pressure or Peer;

zh: 搬演走戏、傀儡偶儿等类，不是二人所为之事，
又要主雇来寻，
兄弟为之伴侣，官鬼为用爻，
若得两动，方为全美，故云不怕官兴兄发。
yi: 搬演、走戏、傀儡偶人这一类，不是一两个人做得了的事，
又要有主顾来找，
兄弟是他们的伙伴，官鬼是用爻，
如果两个都动，才算十全十美，所以说不怕官兴兄发。
en: Staging plays, touring performances and puppet shows are not the work of one or two people,
and patrons must come looking for them;
Peer is their companion and Pressure is the Subject line;
if both move, that is perfection, hence the saying: no fear of Pressure rising and Peer moving.

title: 搏戏：嫌官鬼、兄弟兴旺；兄隆鬼旺必全输

rule.yi: 下棋赌钱、争采取胜，是钱财往来来决输赢的事：兄弟耗财，官鬼克削，兄弟隆盛、官鬼旺相，必然输光。
rule.en: Board games, betting and contests for prizes are matters where money passes back and forth and decides who wins: Peer wastes money and Pressure strips it, and with Peer thriving and Pressure strong you will lose everything.

zh: 搏戏犹嫌鬼兴兄，
yi: 赌博还是嫌官鬼和兄弟兴旺；
en: In gambling, Pressure and Peer rising are still unwelcome;

zh: 博弈赌钱关采争胜，乃系财物往来而决输赢，
兄弟耗财，官鬼克剥，
若值兄隆鬼旺，必致全输。
yi: 下棋赌钱、争采取胜，是钱财往来来决输赢的事；
兄弟耗财，官鬼克削；
如果兄弟隆盛、官鬼旺相，必然输光。
en: Board games, betting and contests for the prize are matters where goods and money pass back and forth and decide who wins;
Peer wastes money and Pressure strips it;
if Peer is thriving and Pressure strong, you will lose everything.

title: 屠户：官爻宜临白虎，要见血

rule.yi: 屠宰这一行要见血：官爻要骑在白虎上。
rule.en: The slaughtering trade must see blood: Pressure must ride the White Tiger.

zh: 屠户官宜临白虎，
yi: 屠户，官爻宜临白虎；
en: For butchers, Pressure should sit on the White Tiger;

zh: 屠宰之流须见血，必得官骑白虎，
yi: 屠宰这一行要见血，一定要官爻骑着白虎，
en: The slaughtering trade must see blood, so Pressure must ride the White Tiger,

title: 空门：出家修道要安稳，子孙要带青龙

rule.yi: 出家修道求安稳：子孙要骑青龙。
rule.en: For those who take up the religious life and need peace: Output must ride the Azure Dragon.

zh: 空门子要带青龙。
yi: 出家人，子孙要带青龙。
en: For those who have left the world, Output must carry the Azure Dragon.

zh: 空门修道要安然，惟祈子跨青龙者也。
yi: 出家修道要安稳，只求子孙骑着青龙。
en: Those who take up the religious life need peace, and can only pray that Output rides the Azure Dragon.

title: 抽丰：喜财官旺；官旺、官生、官合，对方慷慨厚赠，再有财动助鬼，称心如意

rule.yi: 向人求资助（抽丰）：以官爻为用神，只喜官旺相、被生、被合，对方一定慷慨厚赠；再有财发动来帮官鬼，就称心如意。
rule.en: Soliciting gifts (choufeng): Pressure is the Subject; all that is wanted is Pressure strong, generated and combined, and then he will give generously; if Wealth also moves to help Pressure, the heart is content.

note.yi: 「官旺官生官合」读作官爻旺相、又被生、被合（或者是官去生世、合世，原文没有说明宾语），这里照字面译。
note.en: 'Pressure strong, generated, combined' is translated literally; the source does not say whether Pressure is being generated and combined or is generating and combining with the Self.

zh: 抽丰却喜财官旺，
yi: 抽丰，却喜财和官都旺；
en: For soliciting gifts, it is a joy if Wealth and Pressure are both strong;

zh: 抽丰者，晋眉侯门餐食伊利，
以官为用，
惟喜官旺官生官合，彼必慨然厚赠，
又得财动助鬼，则积心遂意。
yi: 抽丰的人，去到侯门大户那里，靠他们的好处吃饭（「晋眉」二字不明），
以官为用神，
只喜官旺、官生、官合，那人一定慷慨厚赠，
又有财发动来帮官鬼，就称心如意了。
en: Those who solicit gifts go to the gates of the great and eat off their bounty ('jin mei' here is unclear),
with Pressure as the Subject;
all that is wanted is Pressure strong, Pressure generated, Pressure combined, and he will surely give generously;
and if Wealth moves to help Pressure as well, the heart is content.

title: 合会：忌世应空；应生合世易成，应空、应被冲破、兄弟动冲，被人阻挠；世应两空或六冲，彼此灰心

rule.yi: 合会（亲友凑钱互助）：怕世应落空。应爻生世、合世，容易成、容易得；应空则对方推却；应被日冲月破或兄弟动来冲，被人搅扰办不成；世空，自己起不来；世应两空或六冲，双方灰心，事情难成。
rule.en: Pooling money with kin and friends (a savings society): what is feared is the Self or the Other void. The Other generating or combining with the Self makes it easy to form and to receive; the Other void, and he declines; the Other clashed by the Day or broken by the Month, or Peer moving to clash it, and someone interferes and blocks it; the Self void, and I cannot get it going; both void or a Six-Clash, and both sides lose heart and the affair fails.

zh: 合会须忧世应空，
yi: 合会，要担心世应落空；
en: For a savings society, the worry is the Self or the Other going void;

zh: 而回合会者，纠集亲朋凑财济急以世空为主，
但得应爻生世合世，乃易成易得，
若应空他人见却，
应被日冲月破、或兄弟动冲，皆主被人扰阻不成。
若世空，我不能兴，虽兴物难入手。
若世应两空或值六冲，则彼此灰心难济其事，
yi: 至于合会，是纠集亲友凑钱救急，以世落空为要点，
只要应爻生世、合世，就容易成、容易得；
如果应空，别人就推辞；
应被日冲、月破，或兄弟发动来冲，都是被人搅扰阻挠，办不成。
如果世空，我自己起不来，即使起来，钱也难到手。
如果世应两空或遇六冲，那么彼此灰心，事情难成，
en: As for pooling money, gathering kin and friends to raise funds in an emergency, the main thing to watch is the Self going void;
as long as the Other generates or combines with the Self, it is easy to form and easy to receive;
if the Other is void, others decline;
if the Other is clashed by the Day or hit by Month-break, or clashed by a moving Peer, someone interferes and blocks it, and it does not happen.
If the Self is void, I cannot get it going, and even if it starts the money is hard to get into my hand.
If Self and Other are both void or meet a Six-Clash, then both sides lose heart and the affair is hard to accomplish,

title: 开矿淘沙取藏：取伏财为用，要有气才可获

rule.yi: 开矿、淘沙、掘藏：地下的宝物藏而不露，只取伏着的财为用神，伏财要有气才能得到，福神成双跟着来；劈山开矿、破石寻珍，是同一个道理。
rule.en: Mining, panning sand and digging for buried treasure: treasure in the ground lies hidden, so take the hidden Wealth as the Subject; it must have breath to be had, and Output follows alongside; splitting mountains, opening mines and breaking rock to find gems are judged by the same principle.

note.yi: 「沙内之金乃理而禾吐必得」一句字有讹误，读不通，译文只译出能读的部分并标出。「财隐旺土动而变化淘之方」也很省，这里照字面译。
note.en: The sentence about gold in the sand is corrupt and cannot be read; only the readable part is translated and marked. 'Wealth hidden under a strong Earth ... the method of washing' is also terse and is translated literally.

zh: 开矿淘沙兼取藏，伏财有气福骈从。
yi: 开矿、淘沙，还有掘藏，伏着的财有气，福神成双跟着来。
en: Mining, panning sand and digging for buried treasure: hidden Wealth with breath, and Output follows alongside.

zh: 地中宝乃藏而不露，但只取伏财为用，须要有气可获。
沙内之金乃理而禾吐必得。
财隐旺土动而变化淘之方，
有劈山开旷破石寻珍以此无异，一理同推。
yi: 地下的宝物是藏着不露的，只取伏财为用神，伏财要有气才能得到。
沙里的金子，（「理而禾吐」读不通，这句有讹）一定能得。
财隐伏在旺相的土下面，土动而变化，是淘取的办法；
劈山开矿、破石寻珍，和这个没有两样，同一个道理去推。
en: Treasure in the ground lies hidden and does not show, so take the hidden Wealth as the Subject; it must have breath to be had.
The gold in the sand (the words 'put in order and grain spits out' cannot be read; the sentence is corrupt) is surely obtained.
Wealth hidden under a strong Earth, the Earth moving and changing: that is the method of washing it out;
splitting mountains, opening mines and breaking rock to find gems are no different, all judged by the same principle.

title: 何日得钱财：日辰生合财爻的那天就是日期；财合日辰才能入手

rule.yi: 求财想知道哪一天到手：看日辰生合财爻的那一天。经上说，财爻合日辰，才能入手。
rule.en: To know on what day money arrives in any money question: it is the day on which the Day generates or combines with the Wealth line. The classic says: only when Wealth combines with the Day can it come into the hand.

zh: 又云欲知何日得钱财，
但逢合处定欢谐。
yi: 又说：想知道哪一天得到钱财，
只要碰上合的地方，一定欢喜顺遂。
en: It also says: to know on what day money is obtained,
just meet the place of combining and all will be joyful and smooth.

zh: 凡一应求财，要知何日到手，但以日辰生合财爻是期矣！
经云：财合日辰，方能入手。
yi: 凡是各种求财，想知道哪天到手，只看日辰生合财爻的那一天就是日期！
经上说：财合日辰，才能入手。
en: For every kind of money question, to know the day it arrives, it is the day on which the Day generates or combines with the Wealth line!
The classic says: only when Wealth combines with the Day can it come into the hand.

title: 财爻死绝要等日辰生它，太旺太多要等墓日

rule.yi: 财爻落在衰、绝之地，要日辰来生扶，那一天才是能得到的日期；财爻太旺太多，必定要到墓日才有。经上说，财逢墓库便可归还，多财反复，必须墓库收藏。
rule.en: Wealth in decline or extinction needs the Day to generate or support it, and that day is when it can be had; Wealth too strong and too many comes on a tomb day. The classic says: Wealth meeting the tomb-store can be brought home; abundant Wealth is unsteady and needs the tomb-store to hold it.

note.yi: 「决定墓日免有」的「免」疑是「方」（然后）之误，译成「一定要到墓日才有」。
note.en: 'Exempt from having' in 'it is decided that on a tomb day there is exemption' is probably a slip for 'then there is', and is translated as 'it will be on a tomb day that there is any'.

zh: 死绝财爻生日得，
太旺财爻死墓来。
yi: 死绝的财爻，逢生它的日子才得；
太旺的财爻，要到死墓的日子才来。
en: A dead or extinct Wealth line gets its money on the day that generates it;
an over-strong Wealth line comes on the day of death or tomb.

zh: 财爻逢衰绝之地，必得日辰生扶，乃可得之期。
若财爻太旺太多，决定墓日免有。
故经云：财逢墓库便可归还，
又云多财反覆，必须墓库以收藏。
yi: 财爻落在衰、绝之地，一定要日辰来生扶，才是能得到的日期；
如果财爻太旺太多，一定要到墓日才有。
所以经上说：财逢墓库，便可以归还（到手）；
又说：多财反复，必须用墓库收藏。
en: When Wealth is in decline or extinction, the Day must generate or support it, and that is the day it can be had;
if Wealth is too strong and too many, it will be on a tomb day that there is any.
So the classic says: Wealth meeting the tomb-store can be brought home;
and again: abundant Wealth is unsteady and needs the tomb-store to hold it.

title: 卦中有福无财：等财星值日才到手

rule.yi: 卦里有福神（子孙）而没有财：六爻里没有财出现，即使有子孙也还得不到，一定要遇到财爻当值的日子，钱才进口袋。
rule.en: A hexagram with Output but no Wealth: with no Wealth appearing among the six lines, even Output gives nothing yet; only on the day the Wealth line is on duty does the money go into the purse.

zh: 卦中有福无财者，
财星值日也开怀。
yi: 卦里有福神而没有财的，
财星当值的日子，也能开怀。
en: In a hexagram with Output but no Wealth,
the day the Wealth star is on duty still brings joy.

zh: 六爻无财出现，虽有子孙尚未可获，
必逢财爻值日，物乃归囊。
yi: 六爻里没有财出现，即使有子孙也还不能得到，
一定要遇到财爻当值的日子，钱才进了口袋。
en: With no Wealth appearing among the six lines, even with Output there is nothing yet to be had;
only when the day of the Wealth line comes will the money enter the purse.

title: 开张（有本钱）：卦内财福齐全，福德临门、妻财持世为吉；财子两全，兄动世克财则终无利息

rule.yi: 有本钱开张：卦里要财和福都齐全，福德临门则顾客盈门，妻财持世则利润绵绵；以财为用神，财子两全，财旺则财源无穷，子孙动则顾客不断；不宜兄弟动又世克财，那样即使勤谨也终无利息。
rule.en: Opening a shop with capital: the hexagram needs Wealth and Output both complete; Output at the gate fills the shop with customers and Wealth on the Self brings unbroken profit. Wealth is the Subject and Wealth and Output must both be there: Wealth thriving, its source is endless; Output moving, customers keep coming; but Peer moving while the Self controls Wealth is bad, and even a diligent person ends with no interest. With capital, Wealth and Pressure each want to be still.

note.yi: 《天玄赋》里同一句作「世克动财若赶沙场之马」，这里是「越」，一个字之差。
note.en: The Tianxuan Fu has the same line as 'like chasing a horse across a battlefield of sand'; here the verb is 'cross' - one character apart.

zh: (将本以财爻为主，福德为凭。
空拳以官爻为主，财象为凭。)
yi: （有本钱去求财的，以财爻为主，以福德为凭；
空手求财的，以官爻为主，以财象为凭。）
en: (With capital: Wealth is the chief and Output the evidence;
empty-handed: Pressure is the chief and the image of Wealth the evidence.)

zh: 开张口诀无多语，
卦内须求财福全，
福德临门人济济，
妻财持世利绵绵，
yi: 开张店铺的口诀没有多少话：
卦里要求财和福都齐全；
福德临门，人来人往，热闹兴旺；
妻财持世，利润绵绵不断；
en: The rhyme for opening a shop has few words:
look in the hexagram for Wealth and Output both complete;
Output at the gate, and the people come in crowds;
Wealth on the Self, and the profit flows on unbroken;

zh: 将本财官各要安。
yi: 有本钱的，财和官各自要安静。
en: With capital, Wealth and Pressure each want to be still.

zh: 开张店业亦有二端：
将本求财者，以财为用，
须要财子两全，财兴则财源炽盛无穷。
子动则主雇络纭不绝，
但不宜兄动又值世克财者，纵是勤谨之人，终无利息。
故经云：世克动财若越沙场之马。
yi: 开张店铺也有两种：
有本钱求财的，以财为用神，
要财和子孙两样齐全，财兴旺，财源就旺盛无穷；
子孙动，顾客络绎不绝；
只是不宜兄弟动，又碰上世克财，即使是勤勤恳恳的人，最终也没有利息。
所以经上说：世克发动的财，好比要越过沙场的马。
en: Opening a shop has two cases:
with capital, Wealth is the Subject;
Wealth and Output must both be present; when Wealth thrives its source flows without end;
when Output moves, customers keep coming;
but it is bad if Peer moves and the Self also controls Wealth: even a diligent person ends with no interest;
so the classic says: 'the Self controlling a moving Wealth is like a horse crossing a battlefield of sand.'

title: 开张（空拳）：以官为主，财鬼并值，财动助鬼、鬼动发财；空拳问利官爻喜遇兴隆

rule.yi: 空手开张：以官爻为主，一定要财和官鬼同时有；财动就帮官鬼，官鬼动就发财；九流的手艺无中生有、空手得财，所以经上说，空手问利，官爻喜欢遇到兴旺。
rule.en: Opening a shop empty-handed: Pressure is the chief; both Wealth and Pressure must be present; Wealth moving helps Pressure and Pressure moving makes money; the skills of the trades make something from nothing, so the classic says: empty-handed, Pressure is glad to meet a thriving state.

zh: 空拳财鬼皆宜动，
yi: 空手开张的，财和官鬼都宜发动；
en: Empty-handed, Wealth and Pressure should both move;

zh: 空拳问利者，以官为主，
必得财鬼并值，财动则助鬼，鬼动则发财。
九流之术，无中生有，空手得财，
故经云：空拳问利，官爻喜遇兴隆。
yi: 空手问利的，以官爻为主，
一定要财和官鬼同时有，财动就帮官鬼，官鬼动就发财；
九流的手艺，无中生有，空手得财，
所以经上说：空手问利，官爻喜欢遇到兴旺。
en: Empty-handed, Pressure is the chief;
Wealth and Pressure must both be present: Wealth moving helps Pressure, and Pressure moving makes money;
the skills of the trades create something out of nothing and gain money with empty hands,
so the classic says: 'empty-handed, Pressure is glad to meet a thriving state.'

title: 开张遇六冲兄弟发，开不满一年

rule.yi: 开张遇六冲又兄弟发动，一定开不满一年：卦是六冲，不论有本钱还是空手，到头来成不了，成了也不长久；只有兄弟发动，有本钱的还嫌不好，空手的没有妨碍。
rule.en: A Six-Clash with Peer moving means the shop will not last a year: in a Six-Clash hexagram, with capital or empty-handed, it comes to nothing or does not last; with only Peer moving, it is still unwelcome with capital but no taboo for the empty-handed.

zh: 若遇六冲兄弟发，
定是开张不满年。
yi: 如果遇到六冲，兄弟又发动，
一定是开张不满一年。
en: If you meet a Six-Clash with Peer moving,
the shop surely will not last a year.

zh: 卦值六冲，不论将本空拳者，
毕竟不成，成来不久，岂有利禄哉？
若兄弟独发，将本犹嫌，空拳无忌。
yi: 卦是六冲，不论有本钱的还是空手的，
到头来成不了，成了也不长久，哪里会有利禄？
如果只有兄弟发动，有本钱的还嫌不好，空手的没有妨碍。
en: A Six-Clash hexagram, whether with capital or empty-handed,
will come to nothing in the end, or if it succeeds it will not last: how could there be profit?
If only Peer moves, it is still unwelcome with capital, but no taboo for the empty-handed.

title: 世动则己心多变，应动则伙伴怀反背，应空无能不久；应克世更要防欺害分离

rule.yi: 世代表自己，不宜发动，一动心里变化多端；应代表伙伴，也宜安静，一动就怀了背叛的心，空就没有能力也不长久，动而克世，更要防被欺害、分离；应空，合伙的人还是换掉为好。
rule.en: The Self stands for oneself and should not move: moving, the mind changes in many ways. The Other stands for the partner and should also be still: moving, he harbors a heart of betrayal; void, he has no ability and will not last; moving and controlling the Self, expect to be cheated and harmed and to part. With the Other void, the partner should be replaced.

zh: 又云世动己心多改易，
应空夥伴再宜更。
yi: 又说：世动，自己的心多有改变；
应空，合伙的人还是换掉为好。
en: It also says: if the Self moves, one's own mind changes often;
if the Other is void, the partner should be replaced.

zh: 世为自己，岂宜发动，动则心有变多端。
应为伴夥，亦宜安静，动则怀反背之心，
空则无能亦不久远，
若动而克世者，尤当欺害而分离。
yi: 世代表自己，怎么宜于发动？一动，心里就有很多变化；
应代表伙伴，也宜安静，一动就怀了背叛的心；
空就没有能力，也不能长久；
如果动而克世，更是要被欺害而分离。
en: The Self stands for oneself; how could it be right for it to move? Moving, the mind changes in many ways;
the Other stands for the partner and should also be still; moving, he harbors a heart of betrayal;
void, he has no ability and will not last;
if he moves and controls the Self, all the more will he cheat and harm you and you will part.

title: 财是根本不可变：化鬼化兄则耗散无结果，化子孙则利禄津津

rule.yi: 财是根本，不能变动：化成官鬼、变成兄弟，财就被耗散，两条路都没有好处，终究难有结果；财化成子孙，则利禄滚滚，永远没有边际。
rule.en: Wealth is the root and must not change: turning into Pressure or Peer, Wealth is consumed and scattered, neither way does any good, and in the end there is no result; Wealth turning into Output, profit and emolument flow on without limit.

zh: 财化鬼兄无结果，
财之子象有收成。
yi: 财化成官鬼或兄弟，没有结果；
财化成子孙的象，有收成。
en: Wealth turning into Pressure or Peer comes to no result;
Wealth turning into an image of Output brings a harvest.

zh: 财为根本，不可更变。
若化鬼变兄，则财被耗散，两途无益，终难结果，
若财化子孙，则利禄津津，永久无缰。
yi: 财是根本，不能变动。
如果化成官鬼、变成兄弟，财就被耗散，两条路都没有好处，终究难有结果；
如果财化成子孙，就利禄滚滚，永远没有边际。
en: Wealth is the root and must not change.
If it turns into Pressure or changes into Peer, Wealth is consumed and scattered; neither way does any good, and in the end there is no result;
if Wealth turns into Output, profit and emolument flow on and on without limit.

title: 顿货先访脱期：近买近卖看本月财旺，置后再脱看以后财逢生旺之日

rule.yi: 囤货先推脱手的日期，有快有慢：近期买近期卖，要本月财旺相的日子才有利；现在买、以后再脱手，要等年里财逢生旺的日子才入袋。
rule.en: For stocking goods, first work out the time of sale, which may be quick or slow: buying and selling soon, profit comes this month when Wealth is strong; buying now for a later sale, wait for a day later in the year when Wealth meets Birth or strength and it can go into the purse.

note.yi: 「於经年值休囚而有利」一句，字面是说隔了整年、在休囚的时候反而有利，这里照字面译。「年馀」译成年里以后。
note.en: 'Over a full year, in the resting and trapped time, there is profit' is translated literally; 'the rest of the year' is rendered as 'later in the year'.

zh: (以妻财为主，
衰旺为凭。)
yi: （以妻财为主，
以旺衰为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief;
strength and weakness are the evidence.)

zh: 凡占顿货，先访脱期。
有迟速之不同，取旺衰之名异，
近买近卖，于本月当旺相而得财。
今置后脱，於经年值休囚而有利。
yi: 凡是占囤货，先要访问脱手的日期。
有迟有快的不同，取旺衰的名目也不一样；
近期买、近期卖的，在本月正当旺相的时候得财；
现在买进、以后再脱手的，隔了一年，在休囚的时候反而有利。
en: In any question about stocking goods, first look into the time of sale.
There is a difference between slow and quick, and the names taken from strength and weakness differ;
for buying and selling soon, money comes this month when Wealth is strong;
for buying now and selling later, over a full year, there is profit even in the resting and trapped time.

zh: 置买货物欲求利息，专看迟速之期，可觅厚薄子财。
近买即卖，求目下财旺之日而利入手。
今制后脱，待年馀财逢生旺之日而可入囊。
yi: 买进货物想求利息，专看快慢的时间，就能求得厚薄不同的利钱。
近期买了就卖，求的是眼下财旺的日子，利润才到手；
现在置办、以后脱手，要等到年里财逢生旺的日子，才能入袋。
en: To seek interest from buying goods, look only at the time, fast or slow, and you can find a thicker or thinner return.
Buying and selling at once, look for a day when Wealth is strong now, and the profit comes to hand;
buying now for a later sale, wait for a day later in the year when Wealth meets Birth or strength, and it can go into the purse.

title: 按买卖的季节看财爻：冬收夏发用巳午火，秋置春卖用寅卯木，夏养冬鱼用亥子水，春种秋收用申酉金

rule.yi: 按买进、卖出的季节，看那个季节里旺的五行：冬天收进、夏天卖出，看巳午的财爻，四五月有财；秋天置办、春天卖，看寅卯的财，正二月大吉；夏天养、冬天出鱼，见水，十月十一月亥子得利；春天种、秋天收，逢金，七八月申酉财可得。
rule.en: Follow the season of buying and of selling, and the element that is strong in that season: buying in winter and selling in summer, look for a Wealth line of Si or Wu, with money in the fourth and fifth months; buying in autumn and selling in spring, a Wealth of Yin or Mao, greatly auspicious in the first and second months; raising in summer and selling fish in winter, Water, with profit in the tenth and eleventh months, Hai and Zi; planting in spring and reaping in autumn, Metal, with money in the seventh and eighth months, Shen and You.

note.yi: 这一节和《易隐》「冬收夏化货，火财者吉……」是同一套配法（冬收夏卖看火、秋收春卖看木、夏收冬卖看水、春收秋卖看金）。
note.en: This pairing is the same scheme as the Yi Yin's 'bought in winter, sold in summer: a Fire Wealth is auspicious ...' (winter to summer, Fire; autumn to spring, Wood; summer to winter, Water; spring to autumn, Metal).

zh: 且如冬藏夏货，宜巳午之财爻。
秋放春收，喜卯寅之妻位。
夏育冬鱼利见水，
春培秋果要逢金。
yi: 比如冬天收藏、夏天出货，宜用巳午的财爻；
秋天放出、春天收回，喜欢卯寅的妻位（财）；
夏天养、冬天出鱼的，利在见水；
春天培、秋天出果的，要逢金。
en: For example, goods stored in winter and sold in summer suit a Wealth line of Si or Wu;
let out in autumn and taken in during spring, they like the Wealth position of Mao or Yin;
fish raised in summer for winter find profit in Water;
fruit tended in spring for autumn needs Metal.

hits.text: 遗曰：冬藏夏货，宜巳午之财爻
秋放春收，喜卯寅之妻位

zh: 假令冬收夏发，乃夏旺于火，在四五巳午之期有财。
秋置春卖，乃春旺于木，故正二月卯寅之期大吉。
夏养冬鱼，乃冬旺于水，是十月十一月亥子节而得利。
春种秋收，乃秋旺于金，在七八月申酉之令而财可得。
yi: 比如冬天收进、夏天发出，是因为夏天火旺，在四、五月巳午的时候有财；
秋天置办、春天卖出，是因为春天木旺，所以正、二月卯寅的时候大吉；
夏天养、冬天出鱼，是因为冬天水旺，在十月、十一月亥子的节令得利；
春天种、秋天收，是因为秋天金旺，在七、八月申酉的节令财可以到手。
en: For instance, buying in winter and selling in summer: Fire is strong in summer, so there is money in the fourth and fifth months, Si and Wu;
buying in autumn and selling in spring: Wood is strong in spring, so the first and second months, Yin and Mao, are greatly auspicious;
raising in summer for winter fish: Water is strong in winter, so profit comes in the tenth and eleventh months, Hai and Zi;
planting in spring and reaping in autumn: Metal is strong in autumn, so money can be had in the seventh and eighth months, Shen and You.

title: 买贱卖贵：买时世克财价贱，卖时财克世价高；兄临月将价不长宜收，财值提纲利兴可脱

rule.yi: 买的时候世克财，价便宜；卖的时候财克世，价高。兄弟临月将，价钱涨不起来，适合收进；财值月令，利润正旺，可以脱手。凡世克财爻、兄临月将、财休囚，价贱货宜买；财爻克世或财值月建，货价高、利润加倍，各要赶那个时候，不可错过。
rule.en: When buying, the Self controlling Wealth means cheap; when selling, Wealth controlling the Self means high. Peer on the month general: the price will not rise, a good time to buy; Wealth on the ruling line of the month: the profit is rising and it can be sold. Whenever the Self controls the Wealth line, Peer sits on the month general, or Wealth is resting or trapped, the price is cheap and the goods should be bought; when the Wealth line controls the Self, or Wealth is on the Month, the price is high and the profit doubled - catch each in its time and do not miss it.

note.yi: 「月将」在这里原文没有解释，按字面译成「月将」（当月的将）；下一句「财值月建」里的月建则译作 Month。
note.en: 'Month general' is not explained in the source and is translated literally; the Month in the next sentence, 'Wealth on the Month', is the usual month branch.

zh: 买时，世克财当贱；
卖时，财克世为高。
兄临月将，价不长而宜收。
财值提纲，利当兴而可脱。
yi: 买的时候，世克财，该便宜；
卖的时候，财克世，价就高。
兄弟临月将，价钱涨不起来，适合收进；
财值月令（提纲），利润正旺，可以脱手。
en: When buying, the Self controlling Wealth means cheap;
when selling, Wealth controlling the Self means high.
Peer on the month general: the price will not rise, a good time to buy;
Wealth on the ruling line of the month: the profit is rising and it can be sold.

zh: 但世克财爻、或兄临月将、或财值休囚，皆系价值贱而货宜买。
若财爻克世或财值月建，皆属货价高而利倍增，各赶其时不可挫也。
yi: 凡是世克财爻，或者兄弟临月将，或者财值休囚，都是价钱便宜、货宜买进；
如果财爻克世，或者财值月建，都是货价高、利润加倍，各要赶那个时候，不可错过。
en: Whenever the Self controls the Wealth line, or Peer is on the month general, or Wealth is resting or trapped, the price is cheap and the goods should be bought;
if the Wealth line controls the Self, or Wealth is on the Month, the price is high and the profit doubled; catch each in its time and do not miss it.

title: 内卦是眼下、外卦是将来：内强外弱先贵后贱，内弱外强先贱后贵

rule.yi: 内卦代表眼下、近期，外卦代表将来、远期。内卦旺相、外卦衰，一定是先贵后贱；外卦强盛、内卦没有气，一定是后贵先贱。
rule.en: The inner trigram stands for the present and near term, the outer trigram for the season to come and the far term. Inner strong and outer weak: dear first and cheap later; outer strong and inner without breath: cheap first and dear later.

note.yi: 经里说「前重后轻」，解里说「前贵后贱」，可见「重」指价钱高、「轻」指价钱低。
note.en: The verse says 'heavy first, light later' and the commentary 'dear first, cheap later', so 'heavy' means a high price and 'light' a low one.

zh: 内宫为目下之时，外卦乃未来之节。
内强外弱，必前重而后轻。
内弱外强，必前轻而后重。
yi: 内卦是眼下的时候，外卦是将来的节令；
内强外弱，必定先重后轻；
内弱外强，必定先轻后重。
en: The inner trigram (the source says 'inner palace') is the present time and the outer trigram the season to come;
inner strong and outer weak: heavy first and light later;
inner weak and outer strong: light first and heavy later.

zh: 凡内卦为近时，外卦为远期，
内卦旺相外卦衰，彼决见前贵后贱，
外象强盛内象无气，必然后重前轻。
yi: 内卦代表近期，外卦代表远期；
内卦旺相、外卦衰，那就一定是先贵后贱；
外卦强盛、内卦没有气，必然是后贵先贱。
en: The inner trigram stands for the near term, the outer trigram for the far term;
inner strong and outer weak, it will surely be dear first and cheap later;
outer strong and inner without breath, it will surely be dear later and cheap first.

title: 置脱货物：子孙发动最宜，子动生财，独忌兄弟交重

rule.yi: 囤货、脱货：要子孙发动，从头到尾嫌兄弟发动；贵贱要赶时机，盈亏凭这一卦。子孙动就生财，兄弟旺就克财。
rule.en: Stocking and selling goods: Output should move, and Peer moving is unwelcome from start to finish; catch the moment, dear or cheap, for profit and loss rest on the cast. Output moving generates Wealth, and Peer rising controls it.

note.yi: 「盈亏据卜大凡脱货制货」是一句连着的原文，前半属诗，后半「大凡脱货制货……」起是解，这里在那里切开。
note.en: The source runs the end of the verse into the start of the commentary without a break ('profit and loss rests on the cast in selling and buying goods ...'); it is cut there.

zh: 置脱用子孙发动，
始终嫌兄弟交重。
贵贱赶时，盈亏据卜
yi: 囤货、脱货，用子孙发动；
自始至终都嫌兄弟交重。
价贵价贱都要赶上时机，盈亏就凭这一卦。
en: For stocking and selling off, Output should move;
from start to finish Peer moving is unwelcome.
Dear or cheap, catch the moment; profit or loss rests on this cast.

zh: 大凡脱货制货，最宜子动，
子动生财，独忌兄兴，
兴则克财，大概如此据理推详。
yi: 大凡脱货、置货，最适宜子孙动，
子孙动就生财，只忌兄弟兴旺，
兴旺了就克财；大概就是这样，按道理去推详。
en: In selling off goods and buying them in, the best is Output moving;
Output moving generates Wealth, and the only taboo is Peer rising;
risen, it controls Wealth; that is the general rule, to be worked out by reason.

title: 托本求利：放债求息、出租房船车轿，同一个断法

rule.yi: 把本钱借给亲戚邻居、放债求息、把房屋车船轿子租给别人取利，都以妻财为主，看世应和内外卦来断。
rule.en: Lending capital to kin and neighbours, lending at interest, and letting houses, boats, carts and sedan chairs are all judged the same way: Wealth is the chief, and the Self and the Other, inner and outer, are the evidence.

zh: (以妻财为主，
世应内外为凭。)
yi: （以妻财为主，
世应内外为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief;
the Self and the Other, inner and outer, are the evidence.)

zh: 凡将资本借亲邻，
房室用车赁与人。
yi: 凡是把本钱借给亲戚邻居，
把房屋、车租给别人，
en: Whenever capital is lent to kin or neighbours,
or houses and vehicles are rented to others,

zh: 凡放债求息并物件与人取利者，
或将房船车轿赁与亲朋同断。
yi: 凡是放债求利息，以及把物件借给别人取利的，
或者把房子、船、车、轿租给亲戚朋友的，都同样来断。
en: whenever one lends at interest, or lets goods to others for profit,
or rents houses, boats, carts or sedan chairs to kin and friends, all are judged the same way.

title: 放债借出：有子孙、妻财旺相生世合世，有财有利；官鬼、兄弟发动冲世克世，多耗多是非

rule.yi: 借出本钱：卦里有子孙，遇到善良的客人；有官鬼，遇到强横的对手。妻财最喜欢落在生旺之地；兄弟只怕克世和卦身。爻上有子孙、妻财，旺相，或生世、合世、克世，有财有利；官鬼、兄弟发动，冲世、克世，多耗损多是非，即使只是发动也不是吉象，要忌讳。
rule.en: Lending out capital: Output in the hexagram means meeting a good customer; Pressure means meeting a domineering guest. Wealth is most glad to sit in a place of Birth or strength; Peer only worries about controlling the Self and the Body. Output or Wealth on the lines, strong, or generating, combining with or controlling the Self, means money and profit; Pressure or Peer moving to clash with or control the Self brings many losses and quarrels, and even merely moving is not auspicious and must be avoided.

zh: 卦有子孙逢善客，
爻逢官鬼遇强宾，
妻财最喜临生旺，
兄弟单忧克世身。
yi: 卦里有子孙，遇到的是善良的客人；
爻上逢官鬼，遇到的是强横的宾客；
妻财最喜欢落在生旺的地方；
兄弟只担心克了世和卦身。
en: Output in the hexagram means meeting a good customer;
Pressure on a line means meeting a domineering guest;
Wealth is most glad to sit in a place of Birth or strength;
Peer has only one worry: controlling the Self and the Body.

zh: 爻有子孙妻财，或旺相或生世合世克世者，有财有利。
若遇官鬼兄弟发动，冲世克世者，
多耗多非，
若动亦非吉象，切宜忌之。
yi: 爻上有子孙、妻财，旺相，或者生世、合世、克世的，有财有利；
如果遇到官鬼、兄弟发动，冲世、克世的，
多耗损、多是非；
即使只是发动，也不是吉象，一定要忌讳。
en: With Output or Wealth on the lines, strong, or generating, combining with or controlling the Self, there is money and profit;
if Pressure or Peer moves, clashing with or controlling the Self,
there are many losses and many quarrels;
even merely moving is not an auspicious sign, and it must be avoided.

title: 世空我心变，应陷他意不真；应克世爻、外伤内卦，对方狠心欺赖、忘恩负义

rule.yi: 世空，我自己不情愿；应空，对方灰心；世应两空，彼此都算了。应克世爻，他必定狠着心欺赖；外卦伤内卦，也是对方不好，必然忘恩负义。
rule.en: Self void: I am unwilling; Other void: he loses heart; both void: both are done with it. The Other controlling the Self line: he will harden his heart and cheat and default; the outer trigram hurting the inner is also bad on his part, and he will forget kindness and betray your trust.

zh: 世空我必心多变，
应陷他须意不真，
应克世爻遭虎噬，
外伤内卦被鲸吞。
yi: 世空，我必定心里多变；
应陷空，他的心意必然不真；
应克世爻，会被老虎咬噬（吃大亏）；
外卦伤内卦，被鲸鱼吞掉。
en: Self void: my own mind must be changeable;
Other sunk: his intention must be insincere;
the Other controlling the Self line: bitten by a tiger;
the outer trigram hurting the inner is swallowed by a whale.

zh: 世空则我不情原，应空则他必灰心。
世应两空，彼此皆休。
若应克世爻，他必狠心欺赖。
外伤内卦，亦彼不良，必致忘恩负义。
yi: 世空，我自己不情愿；应空，他必定灰心。
世应两空，彼此都算了。
如果应克世爻，他必定狠着心欺骗赖账。
外卦伤内卦，也是他不好，必然忘恩负义。
en: Self void, I myself am unwilling; the Other void, he must lose heart.
Self and Other both void: both are done with it.
If the Other controls the Self line, he will surely harden his heart and cheat and default.
The outer trigram hurting the inner is also bad on his part: he will surely forget kindness and betray your trust.

title: 上下彼我不相克、内外比和：应生世、外生内信义不忘，世生应、内生外义中取利

rule.yi: 借贷双方上下、彼我没有相克，内外比和、世应相合，是两个「我」和顺，和同胞兄弟没有两样；应生世、外生内，对方不忘信义，利钱不少；世生应、内生外，或者比和，也是情义中取利，两边心意缠绵长久。
rule.en: With no control between above and below, between him and me, inner and outer in harmony and Self and Other combined, the two sides are like two selves in accord, no different from brothers. The Other generating the Self and the outer generating the inner: he keeps faith and the interest is not small; the Self generating the Other and the inner generating the outer, or harmony: profit taken within good faith, the two minds entwined and lasting.

note.yi: 「贞悔」是内卦、外卦的旧称（内为贞，外为悔）。
note.en: 'Zhen and hui' is the old name for the inner and outer trigrams (by the usual account inner is zhen, outer hui).

zh: 上下彼我无相克，
异姓相交胜嫡亲，
应生身世外生内，
借主常思了债根，
贞悔比和世生应，
也主和谐无异心。
yi: 上下、彼我之间没有相克，
异姓相交也胜过亲骨肉；
应生卦身和世，外卦生内卦，
借钱的人常想着还清债的根由；
贞悔（内外卦）比和，世生应，
也主和谐，没有二心。
en: No control between above and below, between him and me,
and dealings between people of different surnames beat those of blood kin;
the Other generates the Body and the Self, the outer generates the inner,
and the borrower keeps thinking of clearing the debt at its root;
inner and outer trigrams in harmony and the Self generating the Other,
also mean harmony and no double heart.

zh: 内外比和，世应相合，乃两我和顺，同胞无异。
若应生世、外生内，是信义不忘，利资不少。
世生应、内生外，或比和，
亦主义中取利，两意绸缪永久耳。
yi: 内外比和，世应相合，是两个「我」和顺，和同胞兄弟没有两样；
如果应生世、外生内，是不忘信义，利钱不少；
世生应、内生外，或者比和，
也主在情义中取利，两边心意缠绵长久。
en: Inner and outer in harmony and Self and Other combined: two selves in accord, no different from brothers;
if the Other generates the Self and outer generates inner, he keeps faith and the interest is not small;
the Self generating the Other and inner generating outer, or harmony,
also means profit taken within good faith, the two minds entwined and lasting.

title: 借贷看六合六冲：六合鱼水相投，六冲冰炭不投；前合后冲不久，前冲后合尚可

rule.yi: 借贷往来看六合、六冲：六合的卦像鱼得水，六冲的卦像冰和炭合不到一起；先合后冲，聚了不久就分开；先冲后合，分了又合，往来还可以。
rule.en: For lending and borrowing, look at Six-Combine and Six-Clash: a Six-Combine hexagram is like fish in water, a Six-Clash like ice and coals that cannot unite; combining first and clashing after, they gather but not for long and then part; clashing first and combining after, they part and join again and dealings can go on.

zh: 六合百年颜带悦，
六冲旬日面生嗔，
前合后冲交不久，
今人却要细沉吟。
yi: 六合，一辈子面带喜色；
六冲，十天就翻脸生气；
先合后冲，交情不久；
现在的人却要仔细斟酌。
en: Six-Combine: a lifetime of a pleased face;
Six-Clash: within ten days the face turns angry;
combining first and clashing after: the friendship does not last;
people today should think it over carefully.

zh: 六合之卦，鱼水相投。
六冲之卦，冰炭不投。
前合后冲，聚而不久两分离。
前冲后合，分而再合交还可。
yi: 六合的卦，像鱼得水，互相投合；
六冲的卦，像冰和炭，合不到一起；
先合后冲，聚了不久，两下分离；
先冲后合，分开了又合，交往还可以。
en: A Six-Combine hexagram: like fish and water, they suit each other;
a Six-Clash hexagram: like ice and coals, they do not suit;
combining then clashing: they gather but not for long and then part;
clashing then combining: parted, then joined again, and dealings can go on.

title: 索债看世应：应生世肯还；世临兄弟被骗；应陷空亡，人逃亡或穷得没力量还

rule.yi: 讨债从世应上找：应爻生世，欢欢喜喜肯还；世临兄弟，财又休囚，必被骗；应落空亡，那人不是逃走、亡故了，就是穷得没力量还。
rule.en: To collect a debt, look to the Self and the Other: the Other line generating the Self, he is glad to pay; the Self on Peer with Wealth resting and trapped, you will be cheated; the Other fallen into void, he has fled or died, or else is too poor to repay.

zh: (以财爻为主，
应象为凭。)
yi: （以财爻为主，
应象为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief;
the image of the Other is the evidence.)

zh: 索债还从世应寻，
应爻生世必欢忻，
世临兄弟财难取，
应陷空中物送人。
yi: 讨债还是从世应上找；
应爻生世，一定欢欢喜喜（肯还）；
世临兄弟，钱难要回；
应陷入空亡，东西等于送了人。
en: To collect a debt, look to the Self and the Other;
the Other line generating the Self, he is sure to be glad to pay;
the Self on Peer, the money is hard to get back;
the Other sunk in void, and the goods are as good as given away.

zh: 放债本图利息，日久人心更变。
若应爻生世，不负信行遂有偿还之意。
世临兄弟，财亦休囚必然被骗。
应落空亡，彼非逃故，亦是贫乏无力而还也。
yi: 放债本来是图利息，日子久了人心会变。
如果应爻生世，不会辜负信用，就有偿还的心意；
世临兄弟，财又休囚，必然被骗；
应落空亡，那人不是逃走了、亡故了，就是穷得没力量还。
en: Lending is meant to earn interest, but with time hearts change.
If the Other line generates the Self, he will not betray his word and means to repay;
the Self on Peer with Wealth resting and trapped, you will surely be cheated;
the Other fallen into void, he has either fled or died, or else he is too poor to repay.

title: 应是官鬼或兄弟克世：对方口是心非、赖账，本利都亏；再加朱雀白虎更有祸非

rule.yi: 应是官鬼克世，或应临兄弟克世，都是对方不良善：嘴里说脏话，心里存奸险，不但没有利息，本钱也亏；再加朱雀、白虎，反而有祸事是非。
rule.en: The Other on Pressure controlling the Self, or on Peer controlling the Self, means he is not good: foul words in his mouth, a treacherous intent in his heart, no interest and the capital lost too; and with the Vermilion Bird or the White Tiger added, disaster and quarrel besides.

zh: 应值鬼爻如克世，
彼生恶计赖其银，
应逢兄弟伤身命，
口是心非定不仁。
yi: 应是官鬼又克世，
他会生出恶计赖掉银子；
应逢兄弟，伤害卦身，
口是心非，一定不仁义。
en: The Other on Pressure and controlling the Self,
he will hatch a wicked plan to default on the silver;
the Other meeting Peer and hurting the Body,
says one thing and means another, and is surely unkind.

zh: 应值鬼爻克世，应临兄弟克世者，皆主不良，
口吐出秽之言，心存奸险之意，
不惟无利，资本亦亏，
若加雀虎，反有祸非。
yi: 应是官鬼克世，或应临兄弟克世的，都主对方不良善，
嘴里说脏话，心里存着奸险的念头；
不但没有利息，本钱也亏掉；
如果再加朱雀、白虎，反而有祸事是非。
en: The Other on Pressure controlling the Self, or on Peer controlling the Self, both mean he is not good;
foul words come from his mouth and a treacherous intent lies in his heart;
there is not only no interest but the capital is lost too;
and if the Vermilion Bird or the White Tiger is added, there is disaster and quarrel besides.

title: 官鬼、兄弟临应而安静、不伤世：虽然迟延，终不抵赖

rule.yi: 即使官鬼、兄弟临在应上，只要安静、不伤卦身和世，就不用生气：虽然拖延，终究不会抵赖。
rule.en: Even with Pressure or Peer on the Other line, as long as it is still and does not hurt the Body and the Self, there is no need to be angry: he delays, but in the end he does not deny the debt.

zh: 纵若鬼兄临此应，
不伤身世静非嗔。
yi: 即使官鬼、兄弟临在这个应上，
只要不伤卦身和世、又安静，就不用生气。
en: Even if Pressure or Peer sits on this Other line,
as long as it does not hurt the Body and the Self and stays still, there is no need to be angry.

zh: 但应爻临兄、临鬼、静不伤世者，
虽见迟延，
终无抵赖。
yi: 只是应爻临兄弟、临官鬼，安静而不伤世的，
虽然看得到拖延，
终究不会抵赖。
en: But when the Other line sits on Peer or Pressure, still and not hurting the Self,
there is delay, to be sure,
but in the end no denial.

title: 应临父母不克世迟可得；应临财福称心；子兴财旺兄爻静，本利倍获

rule.yi: 应临父母（文书）而不克世，或再加勾陈，不过迟一点，终究有钱可得；应值财爻或临福德，即使不生世，钱也称心；子孙兴旺、财旺，兄弟休囚或安静，本钱不亏、利息加倍，是上等大吉的卦。
rule.en: The Other on Resource without controlling the Self, or with Hook Earth added, is merely late and the money can be had in the end; the Other on the Wealth line or on Output, even if it does not generate the Self, gives money as one wishes; Output rising and Wealth strong with Peer resting or still, the capital is not lost and the interest comes doubled - the best and most auspicious kind of hexagram.

zh: 如带文书迟可得，
应居财福遂吾心，
子兴财旺兄爻静，
本利无亏倍获金。
yi: 如果带文书（父母），迟一些可以得到；
应居财或福德，称我的心；
子孙兴旺、财旺、兄爻安静，
本利都不亏，还能加倍得到银子。
en: If it carries documents (Resource), it can be had late;
the Other in Wealth or Output suits my heart;
Output rising, Wealth strong and the Peer line still,
capital and interest are unharmed and the silver comes back doubled.

zh: 如应临父母不克世者，或加勾陈，不过迟迟而已，终久有财可得。
应值财爻或临福德，纵不生世，财亦如心。
若得子兴财旺，兄弟或休或静，本不亏而利倍获乃上分大吉之卦。
yi: 如果应临父母而不克世，或者再加勾陈，不过是迟一点罢了，终究有钱可得；
应值财爻或临福德，即使不生世，钱也称心；
如果子孙兴旺、财旺，兄弟或休囚或安静，本钱不亏、利息加倍，是上等大吉的卦。
en: If the Other sits on Resource without controlling the Self, or Hook Earth is added, it is merely late, and in the end the money can be had;
the Other on the Wealth line or on Output: even if it does not generate the Self, the money is as one wishes;
if Output rises and Wealth is strong, and Peer is resting or still, the capital is not lost and the interest comes doubled: the best and most auspicious kind of hexagram.

title: 兄动财空本利绝望；鬼化为财，须经官追讨才得

rule.yi: 兄弟发动或财落空，本钱和利息都没指望；官鬼化成财，一定要经官府追讨才能得到。
rule.en: Peer moving or Wealth void leaves no hope of capital or interest; Pressure turning into Wealth, the debt must go through the officials before it can be had.

zh: 兄动财空连本失，
鬼化为财须诉论。
yi: 兄弟动、财落空，连本钱都亏；
官鬼化成财，必须打官司争论。
en: Peer moving and Wealth void, even the capital is lost;
Pressure turning into Wealth, you must go to law to argue it.

zh: 兄弟动或财空，本利绝望。
若鬼化为财，必经官追诉，方可得之。
yi: 兄弟发动，或者财落空，本钱和利息都没指望。
如果官鬼化成财，一定要经官府追讨，才能得到。
en: Peer moving or Wealth void, neither capital nor interest can be hoped for.
If Pressure turns into Wealth, it must go through the officials to be recovered before it can be had.

title: 借本钱经营：财爻旺相不空，待日辰生合财爻的日子到手；六冲一场空

rule.yi: 借本钱经营：要靠财爻旺相、不落空，或者生世、克世，一定能借到、没有阻隔，但要等日辰生合财爻的那一天才到手；六冲的卦万事不成，不要指望。
rule.en: Borrowing capital to run a business: Wealth must be strong and not void, or generating or controlling the Self; then it is sure to be had without obstruction, but it comes to hand only on the day the Day generates or combines with the Wealth line; in a Six-Clash hexagram nothing succeeds, so do not hope.

zh: (以妻财为主，
世应为凭。)
yi: （以妻财为主，
世应为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief;
the Self and the Other are the evidence.)

zh: 借求资本要财兴，
财不空亡无改更，
生合日期方可得，
六冲爻象定虚名。
yi: 借钱做本，要财兴旺；
财不空亡、没有改变；
逢生逢合的日子才可以借到；
六冲的爻象，一定只是虚名。
en: To borrow capital, Wealth must thrive;
Wealth not void and unchanged;
it can be had only on a day of generating or combining;
a Six-Clash line image is surely an empty name.

zh: 借本经营，
须靠财爻旺相，或不落空或生世克世，
决然便得而无阻隔，
然待日辰生合财爻之日，方可到手。
六冲之卦万事无成，岂有得财之理者也，
休望！休望！
yi: 借本钱来经营，
要靠财爻旺相，不落空，或者生世、克世，
一定能借到、没有阻隔，
但要等日辰生合财爻的那一天，才能到手。
六冲的卦万事不成，哪有得财的道理？
不要指望！不要指望！
en: Borrowing capital to run a business
depends on the Wealth line being strong, not void, or generating or controlling the Self;
it will surely be had without obstruction,
but wait for the day the Day generates or combines with the Wealth line before it comes to hand.
In a Six-Clash hexagram nothing succeeds - how could there be any reason to get money?
Do not hope! Do not hope!

title: 世应不空、兄不动：无财有鬼也成；财爻值日是交割日

rule.yi: 借钱：世应都不落空、兄弟不发动，就没有阻隔；即使卦里没有财爻，只要有鬼爻出现，也一定得财；哪一天得，就是财爻当值的日子。
rule.en: Borrowing: Self and Other both not void and Peer not moving means nothing stands in the way; even with no Wealth line in the hexagram, a Pressure line showing means money is sure to be had; the day is the day when Wealth is on duty.

zh: 世应不空兄不动，
无财有鬼也须成，
后查何日财爻值，
便是人间交兑情。
yi: 世应不空、兄弟不动，
没有财、有官鬼，也一定能成；
再查哪一天财爻当值，
就是人间银钱交割的日子。
en: Self and Other not void and Peer not moving,
even with no Wealth, a Pressure that shows will make it succeed;
then check which day the Wealth line is on duty,
and that is the day the money changes hands.

zh: 世应俱不落空，兄弟又不发动，乃无阻隔之神，
虽无财爻上卦而有鬼爻出见，必主得财，
要知何日得财，财值之期是也。
yi: 世应都不落空，兄弟又不发动，这就是没有阻隔的神，
即使没有财爻上卦，只要有鬼爻出现，一定得财；
想知道哪一天得财，就是财当值的日子。
en: Self and Other both not void and Peer not moving: no spirit of obstruction stands in the way;
even if the Wealth line is not in the hexagram, as long as a Pressure line shows, money is sure to be had;
to know on what day, it is the day when Wealth is on duty.

title: 借贷的中保看间爻：旺相生合能帮忙，空绝无力，动来克世反生嫉妒阻挠

rule.yi: 借贷靠中保：一卦里的两个间爻就是居中作保的人；旺相、生合世，一定帮忙；落空落绝，没有力量帮不上；发动来克世，反而生嫉妒、阻挠。
rule.en: For a loan, the guarantor is the two between lines of the hexagram, the go-between who stands surety: strong, generating or combining, he will surely help; void or extinct, he has no strength and cannot assist; moving to control the Self, he breeds jealousy and obstruction.

note.yi: 「不能赞囊」的「囊」疑是「襄」（赞襄，帮助）之误。
note.en: 'Cannot assist' translates a phrase whose last character is probably a slip for 'assist'.

zh: 凡若间爻空与绝，
其间中保定无能。
yi: 凡是间爻落空或绝，
那中间的保人一定没有能力。
en: If the between lines are void or extinct,
the guarantor between is surely powerless.

zh: 一卦之中两间爻，系为中作保之人，
但得旺相生合，决然扶助，
若遇空遇绝，乃无力无能不能赞囊耳。
若动来克世者，反生嫉妒阻挠。
yi: 一卦当中的两个间爻，是居中作保的人；
只要旺相、生合，一定会帮忙；
如果遇空遇绝，就是没有力量、没有能力，帮不上忙；
如果发动来克世，反而生出嫉妒、从中阻挠。
en: The two between lines in a hexagram stand for the go-between who stands surety;
if strong, generating or combining, he will surely help;
if void or extinct, he has neither strength nor ability and cannot assist;
if he moves to control the Self, he breeds jealousy and obstruction instead.

title: 日辰冲应加朱雀动，被谗言破阻；日月生用神加青龙福德，财满钱袋

rule.yi: 日辰冲应，或再加朱雀交重（发动），一定被谗言破坏阻挠；日月生用神，或再加青龙、福德同在一处，一定财满钱袋。
rule.en: The Day clashing the Other, or the Vermilion Bird added and moving: it is surely wrecked and blocked by slander; the Day and Month generating the Subject, or the Azure Dragon and Output added on the same line: the purse is surely full of money.

zh: 日辰冲应遭人破，
月建扶财囊可盈。
yi: 日辰冲应，会被人破坏；
月建扶助财，钱袋可以装满。
en: The Day clashing the Other, someone wrecks it;
the Month supporting Wealth, the purse can be filled.

zh: 日辰冲应或加朱雀交重，必被馋言破阻，
日月生用或加青龙福德同宫，决然财盈囊门耳。
yi: 日辰冲应，或者再加朱雀交重，一定被谗言破坏阻挠；
日月生用神，或者再加青龙、福德同宫，一定财满钱袋。
en: The Day clashing the Other, or the Vermilion Bird added and moving: it will surely be wrecked and blocked by slander;
the Day and Month generating the Subject, or the Azure Dragon and Output added on the same line: the purse is surely full of money.

title: 借东西看用神：衣服文书舟车器皿用父母，飞禽走兽鳞介用子孙

rule.yi: 借东西各取各自的用神：帽子衣服、文书、船车、器皿这一类，以父母为用；飞禽走兽、鱼鳞介甲这些有生气的东西，以子孙为用。旺相兴隆大吉，空绝大凶。
rule.en: For borrowed goods each takes its own Subject: hats and clothes, documents, boats and carts and utensils take Resource; flying birds, running beasts, scaled and shelled creatures and other living things take Output. Thriving is greatly auspicious; void or extinct is greatly ill.

note.yi: 「器血」的「血」疑是「皿」之误，译作器皿。
note.en: 'Utensils' translates a two-character word whose second character is probably a slip for 'dishes'.

zh: 借贷衣舟寻父母，
那移禽兽子孙凭。
yi: 借贷衣服、船，找父母；
挪借禽兽，凭子孙。
en: For borrowing clothes and boats, look to Resource;
for shifting birds and beasts, rely on Output.

zh: 凡借贷之物，各取其用，
冠服文书舟车器血之类，父母为用。
飞禽走兽鳞介生气之物，子孙为用。
兴隆大吉，空绝大凶。
yi: 凡是借贷的东西，各取各自的用神；
帽子衣服、文书、船车、器皿这一类，以父母为用神；
飞禽走兽、鱼鳞介甲这些有生气的东西，以子孙为用神；
旺相兴隆大吉，空绝大凶。
en: For any borrowed goods, each takes its own Subject;
hats and clothes, documents, boats and carts, utensils and the like take Resource as the Subject;
flying birds, running beasts, scaled and shelled creatures and other living things take Output as the Subject;
thriving is greatly auspicious, void or extinct greatly ill.

title: 摇会：忌六冲；财官并见、生合世爻得利；财世两爻空破绝，会不成

rule.yi: 摇会（凑钱互助）：最忌六冲，冲就是散；只要财和官同时出现、生合世爻，一定得到自然的好处；财爻、世爻遇空、破、绝，是用爻被害没有用了，会不成，钱也周转不来。
rule.en: A rotating savings society: a Six-Clash is the great taboo, for clashing means scattering; all that is needed is Wealth and Pressure appearing together and generating or combining with the Self line, and the natural profit is surely had; with the Wealth and Self lines void, broken or extinct, the Subject line is harmed and useless, the society does not come off, and the silver cannot be raised.

note.yi: 摇会是民间的互助会：会员按期出银，用摇骰子的办法决定谁先得会银（这是通常的说法；本章原文只说「实银赴会，祈而得之」）。
note.en: A rotating savings society is a folk mutual-aid club: members put in silver at set times and dice decide who takes the pot first (this is the usual account; this chapter says only 'they go with real silver and pray to win it').

zh: (以财爻主为，
世象为凭。)
yi: （以财爻为主（原文写作「主为」，字序颠倒），
世象为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief (the source has the two words in reverse order);
the image of the Self is the evidence.)

zh: 摇会求财忌六冲，
财官不失便亨通，
世无空破财不绝，
管取其银入手中。
yi: 摇会求财，忌六冲；
财和官都不缺就亨通；
世不空不破、财不绝，
包管那银子到手。
en: For a rotating savings society, a Six-Clash is to be avoided;
with Wealth and Pressure both present, all goes smoothly;
the Self not void or broken and Wealth not extinct,
the silver will surely come into your hand.

zh: 摇会者乃实银赴会，祈而得之，
最忌六冲，冲者散也，岂能成会而得财乎？
惟要财官并见，生合世爻者必得自然之利。
财世两爻值空值破值绝，此乃用爻被害乃无用也，
会岂得成，而银岂得济哉？
yi: 摇会的人是拿着实在的银子去赴会，求着把会银摇到手；
最忌六冲，冲就是散，怎么能成会、得到钱呢？
只要财和官同时出现，生合世爻的，一定得到自然的好处；
财爻、世爻遇空、遇破、遇绝，这是用爻被害，没有用了，
会怎么能成？银子怎么能周济到手呢？
en: Those who join a rotating society go with real silver and hope to win the pot;
a Six-Clash is the great taboo: clashing means scattering, so how could the society hold and money be had?
all that is needed is Wealth and Pressure appearing together and generating or combining with the Self line, and the natural profit is surely had;
if the Wealth and Self lines meet void, break or extinction, the Subject line is harmed and useless;
how could the society come off, and how could the silver be raised?

title: 摇会：兄弟持世或发动，世空财空，会不成、钱不到

rule.yi: 摇会：兄弟是阻挡耗财的神，不宜持世，发动也是卦中大忌；世是主、财是用爻，不可落空，遇到这样，会成不了、钱得不到。
rule.en: A rotating savings society: Peer is the spirit that obstructs and consumes and should not sit on the Self, and moving is also a great taboo; the Self is the master and Wealth the Subject line and neither may be void; with these, the society does not form and no money is had.

note.yi: 最后一句「定是会不财不得」字序不顺，应是「会不（成）、财不得」，这里照此读。
note.en: The last sentence is garbled in word order and is read as 'the society does not (form) and the money is not had'.

zh: 兄爻持世兄爻动，
世或空亡财或空。
yi: 兄爻持世，或兄爻发动，
世落空亡，或财落空。
en: Peer on the Self, or Peer moving,
the Self void, or Wealth void.

zh: 兄弟者，乃阻耗之神，岂宜持世？
又或发动卦中大忌。
世为主者，财为用爻，安可落空？
爻中值此定是会不财不得。
yi: 兄弟是阻挡耗财的神，怎么宜于持世？
又或者发动，是卦中大忌；
世是主，财是用爻，怎么可以落空？
爻中遇到这样，一定是会成不了、钱得不到。
en: Peer is the spirit that obstructs and consumes; how could it suit sitting on the Self?
and moving is a great taboo in the hexagram;
the Self is the master and Wealth the Subject line; how could they be void?
if the lines show this, the society is sure not to form and the money not to be had.

title: 摇会：卦内无财无利，无鬼无人张罗，都不成事

rule.yi: 摇会：卦里没有财，就没有钱财利益；卦里没有官鬼，就没有人张罗做主；都办不成事，只是白费心机。
rule.en: A rotating savings society: with no Wealth in the hexagram there is no profit; with no Pressure in the hexagram there is no one to run it; neither gets done, and it is only wasted effort.

zh: 无鬼无财皆不实，
定然空去费心功。
yi: 没有官鬼、没有财，都不落实；
一定白白费心费力。
en: With no Pressure and no Wealth, nothing is solid;
you will surely spend effort for nothing.

zh: 卦内无财则无财利，卦中无鬼则无张主，
皆不成事，则枉费心机，徒然一番话柄耳。
yi: 卦里没有财，就没有钱财利益；卦里没有官鬼，就没有人张罗做主；
都办不成事，只是枉费心机，白白留下一番话柄罢了。
en: With no Wealth in the hexagram there is no profit; with no Pressure in the hexagram there is no one to run it;
neither gets done; it is only wasted effort and a mere topic of gossip.

chapter: 变产求财章第一百十一
title: 卖产业：财爻生旺月日可卖；世应相冲两退悔；勾陈持世或动，永远难变更

rule.yi: 变卖产业：只看财爻生旺的月份、日子，就可以卖出去，财爻衰弱终究难成交；世应相冲，双方都反悔，成交不了；勾陈是管田地的，又是迟滞之神，持世或发动，很难变更，永远搬不动。
rule.en: Selling property: look only at the months and days when the Wealth line is born or strong, and it can be sold; with a weak Wealth line the deal is hard to close; Self and Other clashing, both sides regret and the deal does not close; Hook Earth rules fields and is the spirit of delay, and sitting on the Self or moving it is very hard to change and stays put for good.

zh: (以应爻为主，
财象为凭。)
yi: （以应爻为主，
财象为凭。）
en: (the Other line is the chief;
the image of Wealth is the evidence.)

zh: 要知产业何时脱，
财值提纲便可抛，
世应相冲多退悔，
勾陈持世永坚牢。
yi: 想知道产业什么时候能脱手，
财值月令（提纲）就可以抛出；
世应相冲，多半反悔退出；
勾陈持世，永远牢固不动。
en: To know when the property will sell,
when Wealth is on the ruling line of the month it can be let go;
Self and Other clashing, there is often regret and withdrawal;
Hook Earth on the Self stays firm forever.

zh: 变卖产业，但看财爻生旺月日，便可卖去，
财爻衰弱终难交易。
世应相冲，彼此退悔两不成交。
勾陈者，乃职专田主，又为迟滞之神，
若持世或动者，决难更变，永久无移，
经云：勾陈职专田土，凡事终见迟留。
yi: 变卖产业，只看财爻生旺的月份、日子，就可以卖出去；
财爻衰弱，终究难成交。
世应相冲，双方都反悔，两边都成交不了。
勾陈是专管田地的，又是迟滞之神，
如果它持世或发动，很难变更，永远不动；
经上说：勾陈专管田土，凡事终究迟迟留滞。
en: To sell off property, look only at the months and days when the Wealth line is born or strong, and it can be sold;
with a weak Wealth line the deal is hard to close.
Self and Other clashing, both sides regret and the deal does not close.
Hook Earth is the ruler of fields and also the spirit of delay;
if it sits on the Self or moves, it is very hard to change and stays put for good;
the classic says: 'Hook Earth rules fields and soil; whatever is done ends in delay.'

chapter: 变产求财章第一百十一
title: 卖产业：应爻是买主，落空冲破无人买；应生合世、财旺，争抢价高

rule.yi: 卖产业：应爻是买主，落空亡就没有力量成交，被日辰冲破就被人阻挠；卦里没有官，也难成事；应爻生世、合世，或者财旺来生合，买主争抢，价钱立刻上涨。
rule.en: Selling property: the Other line is the buyer; fallen into void he has not the means to close, clashed and broken by the Day someone obstructs it; with no Pressure in the hexagram it is also hard to complete; the Other line generating or combining with the Self, or a strong Wealth coming to generate or combine, buyers scramble and the price shoots up.

note.yi: 「用户内外无官」的「用户」在这里读作占问的这一家（用神所在的内外），原文语焉不详。
note.en: 'The user's household, inner and outer, has no Pressure' is terse in the source; here it is read as no Pressure anywhere in the inner or outer trigram.

zh: 应居空破谁人买，
卦乏官爻孰与交，
应生合世妻财旺，
争夺相求价必高。
yi: 应落在空、破，谁来买？
卦里缺官爻，谁和你成交？
应生合世，妻财又旺，
争着抢着来买，价钱必定高。
en: With the Other in void or broken, who will buy?
With no Pressure line in the hexagram, who will deal with you?
The Other generating or combining with the Self and Wealth strong,
buyers scramble for it and the price must be high.

zh: 应爻为承买之人，若落空亡乃无力成交。
日辰冲破，被人挠阻。
用户内外无官，亦难成事。
应爻生世合世，又或财旺来生合，纷纷争夺产价顿增。
yi: 应爻是承买的人，如果落空亡，就是没有力量成交；
被日辰冲破，会被人阻挠；
内外卦里都没有官，也难成事；
应爻生世、合世，或者财旺来生合，买主纷纷争抢，产业价钱立刻上涨。
en: The Other line is the buyer; if it falls into void, he has not the means to close;
clashed and broken by the Day, someone obstructs it;
with no Pressure in the inner or outer trigram it is also hard to complete;
the Other line generating or combining with the Self, or a strong Wealth coming to generate or combine, buyers scramble one after another and the price of the property shoots up.

chapter: 变产求财章第一百十一
title: 卖产业：兄动财静或空衰，难脱手；官鬼加朱雀发动，招官司是非牵缠

rule.yi: 卖产业：兄弟兴旺、财爻安静，或又空又衰，一定难脱手，不必多疑；官鬼鼓动、朱雀噪闹，必有官司拖累、是非招来，牵缠不安宁。
rule.en: Selling property: Peer rising with the Wealth line still, or void and weak besides, is surely hard to unload, no need to doubt it; Pressure stirring and the Vermilion Bird clamouring bring lawsuits, burdens and quarrels, and entanglement with no peace.

zh: 兄动财安难脱卸，
鬼加雀动讼非招。
yi: 兄弟动、财安静，难脱手；
官鬼加朱雀发动，招来官司是非。
en: Peer moving and Wealth still, it is hard to unload;
Pressure with the Vermilion Bird moving, and lawsuits and quarrels are invited.

zh: 兄弟若兴，财爻安静，又或空衰，决然难脱，
不必多疑，
若鬼鼓雀噪，必有讼累非招，牵缠不泰。
yi: 兄弟若兴旺，财爻安静，或者又空又衰，一定难脱手，
不必多疑；
如果官鬼鼓动、朱雀噪闹，必有官司拖累、是非招来，牵缠不安宁。
en: If Peer rises and the Wealth line is still, or void and weak besides, it is surely hard to unload,
no need to doubt it;
if Pressure stirs and the Vermilion Bird clamours, there will surely be lawsuits, burdens and quarrels, and entanglement with no peace.

chapter: 博戏求财章第一百十二
title: 博戏：忌兄弟兴旺（被抽头暗耗）；子孙绝、财落空，钱如雪投汤

rule.yi: 赌钱博弈：兄弟兴旺，会被人抽头、暗中耗去，手气不顺、心里不快，钱财该输；子孙和财不空不绝，只是一般；一遇空，即使有万贯钱财，也像雪投进热汤。
rule.en: Gambling for money: Peer thriving means being skimmed in the open and drained in secret, luck running against you and an unhappy heart, and the money is lost; with Output and Wealth neither void nor extinct it is only slight; once void, even ten thousand strings of cash is like snow dropped into hot soup.

note.yi: 「抽筹窍码」两词都不常见，这里译作被抽筹码、在计数上做手脚，是照字面取的读法。
note.en: 'Chou chou qiao ma' are two rare terms; they are read literally as being skimmed of chips and cheated in the counting.

zh: (以财福为主，
世应为凭。)
yi: （以财福为主，
世应为凭。）
en: (Wealth and Output are the chief;
the Self and the Other are the evidence.)

zh: 呼卢博戏忌兄兴，
子绝财空赌不亨。
yi: 呼卢（掷骰子）赌博，忌兄弟兴旺；
子孙绝、财落空，赌就不顺。
en: For dice and gambling, Peer rising is the taboo;
with Output extinct and Wealth void, the gambling goes badly.

zh: 赌钱博奕之事，若兄弟兴隆，
必被抽筹窍码，明取暗耗色不顺而心不快，财物当输。
若子财不空不绝稍稍而已。
一逢空，纵有万贯囊资，浑如片雪投汤。
yi: 赌钱博弈的事，如果兄弟兴旺，
一定会被人抽筹、在计数上做手脚，明里被取、暗里被耗，手气不顺、心里不快，钱财该输；
如果子孙、财不空不绝，也只是稍稍而已。
一遇空，即使有万贯钱财，也像一片雪投进热汤。
en: In gambling for money, if Peer thrives,
you will surely be skimmed of chips and cheated in the counting, taken from in the open and drained in secret, the dice run against you and you are unhappy, and the money is lost;
if Output and Wealth are neither void nor extinct, it is only slight.
Once void, even ten thousand strings of cash in the purse is like a snowflake dropped into hot soup.

chapter: 博戏求财章第一百十二
title: 博戏：世克应爻我胜，应伤世我输；旺克休、静受克动难伤；世旺生休应带财子大胜；世应比和胜负无偏

rule.yi: 赌博输赢看世应：世克应爻，我全胜而归；应伤世，我大败，钱袋倒空。克的规矩：旺相能克休囚，休囚不能克旺相；安静的受克，发动的难伤，所以经上说静而休囚的要受克、兴旺的决难伤。世旺生休囚的应，再带财或子孙，大胜；不带，只得几文；应旺生衰弱的世，对方来追随我，没有不吉利的；世应比和相生，彼此谦让，胜负没有偏向。
rule.en: Win or lose in gambling by the Self and the Other: the Self controlling the Other line, I win outright and come home content; the Other hurting the Self, I lose badly and my purse is emptied. The rules of control: the strong can control the resting and trapped, and the resting and trapped cannot control the strong; one that is still takes the control and one that moves is hard to hurt, so the classic says that still and resting takes the control and thriving cannot be hurt. A strong Self generating a resting Other and carrying Wealth or Output is a great win, without them only a few coins; a strong Other generating a weak Self, the other side comes to follow me and all is auspicious; Self and Other in harmony and generating each other, both yield and win and loss lean neither way.

zh: 世克应爻我已胜，
应来伤世被他赢。
yi: 世克应爻，我已经赢了；
应来伤世，就被他赢。
en: The Self controlling the Other line, I have already won;
the Other hurting the Self, he wins.

zh: 世为自己应作他人，倘不伤克，彼我无异。
克有数端；旺相能克休囚，休囚不能克旺相。
安静者，受克。
发动者，难伤。
故经云：静休当受克，兴旺决难伤。
世克应爻者，我当全胜必满心积意而返。
应伤世象者，我必大败，尽囊倒卢而归。
若旺世而生休应，若带财子亦当大胜。
不带财子，稍得数文而已。
旺应而生衰世，则彼来随我，无不吉利。
世应比和相生，彼此谦让胜负无偏。
yi: 世是自己，应是别人；如果互不伤克，你我没有差别。
克有几种情形：旺相的能克休囚的，休囚的不能克旺相的。
安静的，受克；
发动的，难伤。
所以经上说：静而休囚的要受克，兴旺的决难伤。
世克应爻，我该全胜，一定心满意足而回；
应伤世象，我必大败，倾尽口袋、倒空钱囊而回。
如果世旺而生扶休囚的应，再带着财或子孙，也是大胜；
不带财、子孙，只得几文钱而已。
应旺而生扶衰弱的世，那么对方来追随我，没有不吉利的。
世应比和相生，彼此谦让，胜负没有偏向。
en: The Self is oneself and the Other another; if neither hurts or controls the other, he and I are alike.
Control comes in several kinds: the strong can control the resting and trapped, and the resting and trapped cannot control the strong.
One that is still takes the control;
one that moves is hard to hurt.
So the classic says: 'still and resting takes the control; thriving cannot be hurt.'
The Self controlling the Other line, I win outright and come home content;
the Other hurting the image of the Self, I lose badly and return with my purse emptied out.
If a strong Self generates a resting Other and carries Wealth or Output, it is also a great win;
without Wealth or Output, only a few coins are gained.
A strong Other generating a weak Self: the other side comes to follow me, and all is auspicious.
Self and Other in harmony and generating each other: both yield to each other, and win and loss lean neither way.

chapter: 博戏求财章第一百十二
title: 博戏：应空无对手，世陷本钱倾

rule.yi: 赌博：应值空绝，赌场里冷冷清清没有对手，遇不到输钱的人；世遇冲、陷，袖子里空空，只剩一双空拳，本钱倾尽。
rule.en: Gambling: the Other void or extinct, the gaming table is deserted, there is no opponent and no loser to meet; the Self clashed and sunk, the sleeves are empty, only bare fists remain and the capital is gone.

zh: 应空难遇输钱客，
世陷还遭资本倾。
yi: 应空，难遇到输钱的客人；
世陷，还会倾尽本钱。
en: The Other void, it is hard to meet a loser;
the Self sunk, the capital is overturned besides.

zh: 若应值空绝，场中寂寞而无对手。
世当冲陷，袖里空虚惟剩空拳。
yi: 如果应值空绝，赌场里冷冷清清，没有对手；
世遇冲、陷，袖里空空，只剩一双空拳。
en: If the Other is void or extinct, the gaming table is deserted and there is no opponent;
if the Self is clashed and sunk, the sleeves are empty and only bare fists remain.

chapter: 博戏求财章第一百十二
title: 博戏：官鬼静、兄弟衰绝、财爻旺相、子孙兴隆，大赢而归

rule.yi: 赌博大赢：官鬼安静，兄弟衰绝，财爻旺相，子孙兴隆，就能得大利，称心如意，说笑玩乐着回来。
rule.en: A big win at gambling: Pressure still, Peer weak and extinct, the Wealth line strong and Output thriving, and you win a great profit, content and pleased, and come home laughing and merry.

zh: 鬼静兄衰财福旺，
君回定唱凯歌声。
yi: 官鬼安静、兄弟衰弱、财和福神旺，
你回来时一定唱着凯歌。
en: Pressure still, Peer weak, Wealth and Output strong,
you will surely come home singing a song of triumph.

zh: 或遇官鬼安静，兄弟衰绝，财爻旺相，子象兴隆，
乃获大利，爽心遂意，复游笑乐而归矣。
yi: 或者遇到官鬼安静、兄弟衰绝、财爻旺相、子孙兴隆，
就能得到大利，称心如意，又说笑玩乐着回来。
en: Or meet Pressure still, Peer weak and extinct, the Wealth line strong and Output thriving,
and you win a great profit, content and pleased, and come home laughing and merry.

chapter: 捕猎畋渔章第一百十三
title: 渔猎：财官两备才有收获，缺一或遇空，鱼飞鸟走

rule.yi: 渔翁猎户占，只取财和官为用神：卦里缺一个就不好，要财旺官兴同时出现，才能打到大鱼、擒到大兽；财、鬼两爻有一个落空亡，就像鹅飞上天、鱼跳进深渊，白白张弓设网也捉不住。
rule.en: When fishermen and hunters ask, take only Wealth and Pressure as the Subject: if either is missing from the hexagram it is not good; a strong Wealth and a thriving Pressure must both appear, and then the fisherman lands great fish and the hunter seizes big game; if either the Wealth or the Pressure line falls void, the goose flies to the sky and the fish leaps into the deep, and drawing bow and spear is in vain.

zh: (以妻财为主，
世应内外为凭。)
yi: （以妻财为主，
世应内外为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief;
the Self and the Other, inner and outer, are the evidence.)

zh: 渔猎皆宜财旺相，
爻中无鬼莫兴张，
财官两备方能获，
一象逢空便不昌。
yi: 打鱼打猎都宜财旺相；
爻里没有官鬼，就不要张罗；
财和官两样齐备才能有收获；
有一样遇空，就不兴旺。
en: For fishing and hunting alike, Wealth should be strong;
with no Pressure among the lines, do not set out;
only with Wealth and Pressure both in place is there a catch;
if either falls void, there will be no success.

zh: 凡渔翁猎户来占，惟取财官为用，
卦中缺一便不为美，必得财旺官隆并见，
乃渔得巨鳞猎擒大兽。
若财鬼二爻一值空亡，则鹅飞戾天鱼跃于渊，空张戈矢而不能御。
yi: 凡是渔翁猎户来占，只取财和官为用神，
卦里缺一个就不好，一定要财旺官兴同时出现，
才能打到大鱼、擒到大兽；
如果财、鬼两爻有一个落空亡，就像鹅飞上天、鱼跳进深渊，白白张弓设网也捉不住。
en: When fishermen and hunters ask, take only Wealth and Pressure as the Subject;
if either is missing from the hexagram it is not good; a strong Wealth and a thriving Pressure must both appear,
and then the fisherman lands great fish and the hunter seizes big game;
if either the Wealth or the Pressure line falls void, then the goose flies to the sky and the fish leaps into the deep, and drawing bow and spear is in vain: nothing can be held.

chapter: 捕猎畋渔章第一百十三
title: 渔猎：世为人、应为物，内为人、外为物；我克物尽获，物伤我难捕

rule.yi: 渔猎：世代表人、应代表物，内卦代表人、外卦代表物。我克物，打鱼打猎都尽善，大获其利；物伤我，即使有强弓硬弩、密网张戈，也决难捕到。
rule.en: Fishing and hunting: the Self stands for the person and the Other for the quarry, the inner for the person and the outer for the quarry. If I control the quarry, fishing and hunting both go perfectly and win great profit; if the quarry hurts me, even with strong bows, crossbows, close nets and spears it is very hard to catch anything.

zh: 世克应爻内克外，
管教年得利非常，
外爻克内应伤世，
枉费心机空自忙。
yi: 世克应爻、内克外，
管保一年得利非常；
外卦克内卦、应伤世，
白费心机，空自忙碌。
en: The Self controlling the Other line, the inner controlling the outer,
will bring extraordinary profit over the year;
the outer controlling the inner and the Other hurting the Self,
wasted effort and busy for nothing.

zh: 世为人应为物，内为人外为物。
若我克物，渔猎尽善俱获大利。
若物伤我，纵有强弓硬弩密网张戈，决难捕捉。
yi: 世代表人、应代表物；内卦代表人，外卦代表物。
如果我克物，打鱼打猎都尽善，全都大获其利；
如果物伤我，即使有强弓硬弩、密网张戈，也决难捕到。
en: The Self stands for the person and the Other for the quarry; the inner stands for the person and the outer for the quarry.
If I control the quarry, fishing and hunting both go perfectly and both win great profit;
if the quarry hurts me, then even with strong bows, crossbows, close nets and spears it is very hard to catch anything.

chapter: 捕猎畋渔章第一百十三
title: 渔猎：世值旬空月破自无技能；兄弟发动，猎物灵异远遁难捕

rule.yi: 渔猎：世落旬空、月破，是自己没有好本事；兄弟发动，那一定是灵禽异兽、怪鱼智龟一类，终究高飞远逃，难以捕获。
rule.en: Fishing and hunting: the Self in Void or Month-break means one has no good skill; Peer moving means a spirit bird, a strange beast, a weird fish or a clever turtle, which in the end flies high and flees far and is hard to take.

zh: 世落旬空兄弟动，
纵然有物不收藏。
yi: 世落旬空、兄弟发动，
即使有猎物也收不到。
en: The Self falls into Void and Peer moves,
even if there is quarry, none is gathered in.

zh: 若世值旬空月破，乃自无良技奇能，
或有兄弟发动，定是灵禽异兽怪鳞智介，毕竟高飞远遁而难收捕。
yi: 如果世值旬空、月破，是自己没有好本事、特别的能耐；
或者有兄弟发动，那一定是灵禽异兽、怪鱼智龟一类，终究高飞远逃，难以捕获。
en: If the Self meets Void or Month-break, one has no good skill or special ability;
or if Peer moves, it must be a spirit bird, a strange beast, a weird fish or a clever turtle, which in the end flies high and flees far and is hard to take.

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：财爻安静、官衰子旺，货放别处无妨；兄兴世破应空有失

rule.yi: 把财货寄放在别人那里：要财爻安静，官鬼不动、子孙旺相最好，货放在他那里无妨；兄弟发动不好；世被冲、应落空亡，财物终究被消耗，这样寄托不好。
rule.en: Leaving money and goods at another's house: the Wealth line must be still, best of all with Pressure not moving and Output strong, and there is no harm in storing the goods there; Peer moving is not good; the Self clashed and the Other void, the goods will in the end be consumed and such entrusting is not good.

zh: (以妻财为主，
世应为凭。)
yi: （以妻财为主，
世应为凭。）
en: (Wealth is the chief;
the Self and the Other are the evidence.)

zh: 物寄他家宜财静，
官衰子旺，无妨货藏彼处。
畏兄兴世破应空有失。
yi: 东西寄放在别人家，宜财安静；
官衰、子孙旺，货放在他那里也无妨；
怕的是兄弟兴旺、世破、应空，会有损失。
en: For goods left in another's house, Wealth should be still;
with Pressure weak and Output strong, there is no harm in storing the goods there;
what is feared is Peer rising, the Self broken and the Other void: loss.

zh: 如占寄他家宜财静，官衰子旺，无妨货藏彼处。畏兄兴世破应空有失。
如占寄顿财货于他家，须要财爻安静，
官鬼不动子孙旺相为最，兄弟发动不美。
世爻被冲应落空亡，毕竟消耗财物，伏托岂为美哉？
yi: （解先把上面的诀重复了一遍：）如果占的是寄放在别人家，宜财静，官衰子旺，货放那里无妨，怕兄兴、世破、应空有损失；
如果占的是把财货寄存在别人家，要财爻安静，
官鬼不动、子孙旺相最好，兄弟发动不好；
世爻被冲、应落空亡，终究要消耗财物，这样寄托哪里好呢？
en: (The commentary first repeats the verse:) if the question is about leaving goods at another's house, Wealth should be still, Pressure weak and Output strong, and there is no harm in storing the goods there; the fear is Peer rising, the Self broken and the Other void: loss;
if the question is leaving money and goods at another's house, the Wealth line must be still;
best of all is Pressure not moving and Output strong; Peer moving is not good;
the Self line clashed and the Other fallen into void, the goods will in the end be consumed; how could such entrusting be good?

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：应伤衰世，他非善；世随官鬼入墓，我不祥；以财爻为主象，忌空亡，静久无损、动有变

rule.yi: 寄放：世是我、应是对方，世不可空；旺相的应伤克衰弱的世，他一定不是善良之辈；世跟着官鬼入墓，我不吉祥。货物一概以财爻为主象，忌落空亡、没有气；财明现而沉静，就长久没有损失，一兴发就有变动的兆头。
rule.en: Leaving goods with someone: the Self is me and the Other is him, and the Self must not be void; a strong Other hurting and controlling a weak Self, he is surely no good sort; the Self following Pressure into the tomb, it is not auspicious for me. Goods are all judged with the Wealth line as the main image, which must not fall void or lack breath; Wealth showing and still, there is no loss for a long time, and once it stirs there is a sign of change.

note.yi: 这一段的解在原书里跨了三行（中间有换行断开），这里连起来看。
note.en: The commentary here is broken across three lines in the source and is read as one passage.

zh: 应伤衰世他非善，
世随鬼墓我非祥。
yi: 应旺伤克衰弱的世，他不是好人；
世跟着官鬼入墓，我不吉祥。
en: A strong Other hurting a weak Self, he is not a good man;
the Self following Pressure into the tomb, it is not auspicious for me.

zh: 世为我应为彼，而世不可空，
若被旺应伤克衰世，他必非是善良之辈。
或世随官鬼入墓，而财为主象，忌入空亡，
静无后患之辞，动有变爻之论。
货物悉以财爻为主，当形象于六爻，切忌空亡无气。
财明沉静，则久久无损。
兴发则有变动之机兆也。
yi: 世是我、应是对方，而世不可以落空；
如果旺相的应伤克衰弱的世，他一定不是善良之辈；
或者世跟着官鬼入墓，而财是主象，忌讳落入空亡；
静就没有后患可说，动就有变爻的说法；
货物一概以财爻为主，要在六爻里看它的形象，切忌空亡、没有气；
财明现而沉静，就长久没有损失；
一兴发，就有变动的兆头。
en: The Self is me and the Other is him, and the Self must not be void;
if a strong Other hurts and controls a weak Self, he is surely no good sort;
or the Self follows Pressure into the tomb; and Wealth being the main image, it must not fall into void;
still, there is no aftertrouble to speak of; moving, there is the matter of the changed line;
goods are all judged with the Wealth line as the chief, its image to be seen among the six lines; void, extinct or without breath is above all to be avoided;
Wealth showing and still, there is no loss for a long time;
once it stirs, there is a sign of change.

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：财爻化绝化空终亏损；化兄化鬼被剥被侵

rule.yi: 寄放：财爻化成绝、化成空，终究亏损；化成兄弟，财被剥削砍伐，化成官鬼，财被侵占谋算，哪能不受伤害。
rule.en: Leaving goods: Wealth turning into extinction or void ends in loss; turning into Peer, Wealth is stripped and felled, turning into Pressure, Wealth is encroached upon and schemed against - how could there be no harm.

zh: 化绝化空，终遭亏损。
化兄化鬼，岂不成伤。
yi: 化成绝、化成空，终究亏损；
化成兄弟、化成官鬼，哪能不受伤害？
en: Turning into extinction or void, in the end there is loss;
turning into Peer or Pressure, how could there not be harm?

zh: 动者化机括，化者动之变迁，
如财爻一至于化绝则绝，无可生之理；
或财爻一至于化空则空，宁有盈实之肘，
故日终遭亏损。
兄弟乃克财之神，化兄则财遭剥伐，
鬼爻为泄气之辈，化鬼则财被侵谋，
故日岂不侵伤者也。
yi: 动是化的机关，化是动的变迁；
比如财爻一到化绝就绝了，没有可以再生的道理；
或者财爻一到化空就空了，哪里还有盈实的余地，
所以说终究遭到亏损。
兄弟是克财的神，化成兄弟，财就遭到剥削砍伐；
官鬼是泄气的东西，化成官鬼，财就被侵占谋算；
所以说怎么能不受侵害。
en: Moving is the mechanism of changing, and changing is the transformation of moving;
when the Wealth line turns into extinction it is extinct and there is no reason for it to be born again;
or when the Wealth line turns into void it is void, and where is there room to fill it;
hence 'in the end there is loss.'
Peer is the spirit that controls Wealth; turning into Peer, Wealth is stripped and felled;
Pressure drains the breath; turning into Pressure, Wealth is encroached upon and schemed against;
hence 'how could it not be encroached upon and harmed.'

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：财化子孙、化财、化生、化旺，吉庆平安

rule.yi: 寄放：财化成子孙、化成财，都吉庆；化生、化旺，永远平安。子孙是福神，是生财的母亲；财爻是主宰，管着安全寄放。
rule.en: Leaving goods: Wealth turning into Output or Wealth is all auspicious; turning into Birth or strength, lasting peace. Output is the spirit of fortune, the mother that gives birth to Wealth; the Wealth line is the master in charge of safekeeping.

zh: 化子化财咸吉庆，
化生化旺永平宁。
yi: 化成子孙、化成财，都吉庆；
化生、化旺，永远平安。
en: Turning into Output or Wealth, all is auspicious;
turning into Birth or strength, peace for ever.

zh: 子孙是福神，生财之母也。
财爻为主宰，安寄之司也。
咸皆吉庆，是为至理。
财化生源，物化旺相，永获平宁，而岂妄焉。
yi: 子孙是福神，是生财的母亲；
财爻是主宰，是掌管安全寄放的；
都吉庆，这是最正的道理；
财化到生的源头，物化到旺相，永远平安，怎么会是虚话呢。
en: Output is the spirit of fortune, the mother that gives birth to Wealth;
the Wealth line is the master, the one in charge of safekeeping;
all is auspicious, and this is the supreme principle;
Wealth turning to the source of life, the goods turning to strength: lasting peace - how could this be idle talk?

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：财化水，防上漏下湿（亥子、父母动同）

rule.yi: 寄放：财化成水，要防水神玄冥，上面漏、下面潮，以致腐烂；亥子、父母发动也是这样。
rule.en: Leaving goods: Wealth turning into Water, guard against the water god Xuanming, leaks above and damp below, and the goods rot; Hai, Zi and Resource moving are the same.

note.yi: 「或卦申水火发动」字有讹，读不通，这里按上下文读成卦里的水爻发动。
note.en: 'Or the hexagram's Shen Water Fire moves' is garbled and cannot be read; from the context it is taken as a Water line in the hexagram moving.

zh: 化水防上下之玄冥，
亥子父动皆然。
yi: 化成水，要防上下的玄冥（水神）；
亥子、父母动，也是这样。
en: Turning into Water, guard against Xuanming above and below;
Hai, Zi and Resource moving are the same.

zh: 玄冥，水神也。
财化水爻，或卦申水火发动，恐遭上漏下湿而致腐烂也。
yi: 玄冥是水神；
财化成水爻，或者卦里水爻发动（原文「卦申水火发动」有误），恐怕遭上漏下湿而腐烂。
en: Xuanming is the god of water;
Wealth turning into a Water line, or a Water line in the hexagram moving (the source's 'hexagram Shen Water Fire moving' is garbled), it is feared the goods suffer leaks above and damp below and rot.

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：财化火，防内外失火（巳午、火性官鬼动同）

rule.yi: 寄放：财化成火，要防火神祝融，里面走火、外面延烧；巳午、火性的官鬼发动也是这样。
rule.en: Leaving goods: Wealth turning into Fire, guard against the fire god Zhurong, fire breaking out within and spreading without; Si, Wu and a Fire Pressure moving mean the same.

zh: 化火防内外之祝融，
巳午鬼兴同意。
yi: 化成火，要防内外的祝融（火神）；
巳午、官鬼兴旺，也是同一个意思。
en: Turning into Fire, guard against Zhurong within and without;
Si, Wu and a thriving Pressure mean the same.

zh: 祝融，火神也。
财如化火，或爻中火鬼交重，应虑内失外延焚如之惨。
yi: 祝融是火神；
财如果化成火，或者爻里火性的官鬼发动，要担心里面走火、外面延烧的惨祸。
en: Zhurong is the god of fire;
if Wealth turns into Fire, or a Fire Pressure among the lines moves, beware the disaster of fire breaking out within and spreading without.

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：遇玄武常忧偷盗，逢朱雀常恐是非

rule.yi: 寄放：遇到玄武，总担心盗贼来偷钱财；碰上朱雀，常怕引出口舌是非。
rule.en: Leaving goods: meeting the Dark Tortoise, always fear thieves coming to steal; meeting the Vermilion Bird, often fear quarrels.

zh: 遇玄武，恒忧偷盗。
逢朱雀，每恐生非。
yi: 遇到玄武，总担心偷盗；
碰上朱雀，常怕生出是非。
en: Meeting the Dark Tortoise, always worry about theft;
meeting the Vermilion Bird, often fear quarrels.

zh: 玄武是贼人，恒者常也，常常忧盗贼侵偷子财。
朱雀唇吻也，每亦常也，每每恐怕激生口舌。
yi: 玄武是贼人；「恒」就是常，常常担心盗贼来偷钱财。
朱雀是嘴唇；「每」也是常，常常怕引出口舌。
en: The Dark Tortoise is the thief; 'always' means often, and you often fear thieves coming to steal your money and goods.
The Vermilion Bird is the lips; 'every time' also means often, and you often fear provoking quarrels.

chapter: 安寄财物章第一百十四
title: 寄放财物：六合、日辰合世应宜寄；六冲、日冲用神不可托

rule.yi: 寄放：六合的爻，或日辰合世、合应，最适合寄存财物，因为彼此心意相投；六冲的爻，或日辰冲用神，不能把财货安放托付给他，以后会有变卦。
rule.en: Leaving goods: with Six-Combine lines, or the Day combining with the Self and the Other, it is best to leave money and goods, because the two hearts agree; with Six-Clash lines, or the Day clashing the Subject, goods and money cannot be safely entrusted to him, for later there will be a change.

note.yi: 「大官寄财顿物」的「官」疑是「宜」之误，译作最适合。
note.en: 'Greatly official to leave money and goods' has a character that is probably a slip for 'suitable', and is translated as 'best'.

zh: 六合最宜寄顿，
六冲岂可安藏。
yi: 六合最宜寄存；
六冲怎么能安放收藏？
en: A Six-Combine is best for leaving things;
how could a Six-Clash keep them safe?

zh: 六合之爻或日辰合世应，大官寄财顿物因其彼此心口投机。
六冲之爻，或日冲主用，不得安货藏财为其付托，后有更变也。
yi: 六合的爻，或日辰合世、合应，最适合寄存财物，因为彼此心口相投；
六冲的爻，或日辰冲主要的用神，不能把货、财安放托付给他，以后会有变卦。
en: With Six-Combine lines, or the Day combining with the Self and the Other, it is best to leave money and goods, because the two hearts and mouths agree;
with Six-Clash lines, or the Day clashing the chief Subject, goods and money cannot be safely left and entrusted to him, for later there will be a change.

title: 趋利之占皆以妻财为用；干谒宜官，商旅忌鬼动

rule.yi: 凡是谋利的占卜，都以妻财为用神；因事而求，偶尔兼用别的象；所以求见权贵宜看官，财官都不能没有气，商旅忌鬼，官鬼哪里宜于发动。
rule.en: All divinations that pursue profit take Wealth as the Subject; they are sought for a particular matter and occasionally take in other images; so to petition a superior look to Pressure, neither Wealth nor Pressure may lose its qi, merchants and travellers avoid Pressure, and Pressure is in no way fit to move.

note.yi: 「雀武蛇虎」是朱雀、玄武、螣蛇、白虎的简写。第三段是本章开头的细目，列出这一章要讲的各种占问，本库按原文顺序译出。
note.en: 'Que Wu She Hu' abbreviates the Vermilion Bird, the Dark Tortoise, the Coiling Snake and the White Tiger. The third passage is the chapter's table of contents at its head, translated in the original order.

zh: 凡趋利之占，
皆以妻财为用，
因事而求，
偶兼他象，
是故干谒宜官，
财官不可丧气，
商旅忌鬼，
官鬼岂宜交重。
yi: 凡是谋利的占卜，
都以妻财为用神；
因具体的事而求，
偶尔兼用别的象；
所以求见权贵宜看官爻，
财、官都不能没有气；
经商旅行的人忌讳鬼，
官鬼哪里宜于发动。
en: All divinations that pursue profit
take Wealth as the Subject;
they are sought for a particular matter,
and occasionally take in other images as well;
so to petition a superior look to Pressure,
and neither Wealth nor Pressure may lose its qi;
merchants and travellers avoid Pressure,
and Pressure is in no way fit to move.

zh: 行商若财爻旺相，
或鬼动不值雀武蛇虎，
亦为有利，
倘妻财空破，
即应讼盗惊灾。
yi: 行商如果财爻旺相，
或者鬼发动，又没有遇上朱雀、玄武、螣蛇、白虎，
也是有利的；
如果妻财空破，
就应了官司、盗窃、惊恐、灾祸。
en: A travelling merchant, if the Wealth line is thriving,
or if Pressure moves without meeting the Vermilion Bird, the Dark Tortoise, the Coiling Snake or the White Tiger,
still profits;
but if Wealth falls Void or is broken,
there will be lawsuits, theft, fright and calamity.

zh: 内详干谒、囤积、贾肆、托本、寄货、公门、博戏、借贷、觅物、订会、巫医优娼工技缘募迎客、脱产、行险、索逋、夺报发伏造作、脱置诸问
yi: 本章细讲：干谒（求见权贵）、囤积、开店铺、托本、寄货、公门、博戏、借贷、觅物、订会、巫医、优娼、工技、缘募、迎客、脱产、行险、索逋、夺报、发伏、造作，以及脱货、置货的各种占问。
en: This chapter treats in detail: petitioning superiors, stockpiling, running a shop, entrusting capital, consigning goods, official channels, gambling, borrowing and lending, seeking things, forming savings clubs, shamans and doctors, entertainers and courtesans, craftsmen, temple fund-raising, receiving guests, selling property, risky ventures, collecting debts, seizing rewards, unearthing hidden things, fabrication, and the divinations of selling off or laying in goods.

title: 囤积：审看脱手时的衰旺；春脱宜木象乘财，冬售恶火爻为用；占时财神要有生扶、无破坏

rule.yi: 囤积货物，要看脱手那个时节财的衰旺，养殖种植也同这样看；春天出手的，宜木象的财旺；冬天卖出的，忌火爻作用神。注：要考察占卦当时，财神也要有生扶、无破坏，日后遇上那个时节才得厚利；如果占的时候本来破散、没有救援，即使日后遇上时节，利也薄。
rule.en: In stockpiling, examine the thriving or weakness of Wealth at the time the goods will be sold, and raising and planting are read the same way; for what is sold in spring a Wood image riding on Wealth is fitting, and for what is sold in winter a Fire line as the Subject is disliked.
